A strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion is essential.

The ideal candidate will have a deep familiarity of living and working in Europe, must reside and be authorized to work in the region, speak English and ideally one additional regional language. The Director - Partner Engagement & Institutional Relationships, Europe will report to the Head of Partner Engagement & Program - Europe and work closely with the Head of Region, Europe on external positioning and advocacy.

**Outcomes**

* Regional partner organizations are highly engaged with each other and the network and are dedicated to our mission and values, and to contributing to progress towards Teach For All's vision and intended outcomes, as measured by the annual network survey.
* Partner organizations in the region are better supported to develop and implement new, innovative and forward looking public sector partnerships that enable them to scale their programmes and increase their impact in the education system.
* There is growth in aggregate progress across the region, as demonstrated by relevant measures for the intended outcomes:
  + Our network is expanding in the region.
  + Collective leadership is strengthening within the communities and countries of network partners.
  + Students in our classrooms are developing holistically as leaders who can shape a better future.
  + Our network staff members, teachers, and alumni are a deeply interconnected, learning regional and global community.
  + Insights from our network inform the regional understanding of what will drive progress for marginalized children.
* Strengthened relationships with regional program stakeholders in the region generating new opportunities for impact and influence. Support the growing impact of alumni in the region as leaders in schools and the education ecosystem.

**Key responsibilities:**

Partner Support (40%)

* As a "portfolio lead," serve as the primary day-to-day relationship holder with a portfolio of current and prospective partner organization CEOs, cultivating relationships to build positive, long-term partnerships as a means to achieving shared and mutually beneficial goals and outcomes
* Co-create and manage the implementation of an annual partnership plan with each organization in the Network Engagement Director's portfolio, identifying how Teach For All will support them and how they will contribute back to the network on an ongoing basis. This plan will include the strategic engagement of other colleagues, teams and resources from across Teach For All
* Share insights, ask thoughtful questions, and provide support to partner and prospective partner organization CEOs and their leadership teams, to build their capacity, advance strategic clarity and impact, and foster learning and sharing across the network, in line with Teach For All's shared global vision and priorities

Public Sector Support (50 %)

* Work directly with CEOs and Head of Institutional Relationships in each partner organization to develop strong public sector strategies and action plans to identify new champions in government and identify new ways of partnering with the public sector to increase their ability to scale their programmes and increase their impact by leveraging regional, national and multinational opportunities
* Leveraging deep understanding of the educational landscape, develop and execute on strategies that build external champions and elevate awareness of our programmatic work in Ministries of Education and Ministries of Labour and Social Welfare, Regional and Local governments, and Universities across the region
* Continue to build more capacity across the region, in both partner organizations and Teach For All to develop and manage stronger public sector relationships in pursuit of sustainability and scale of our work in Europe
* Facilitate meaningful learning experiences for partner organizations in the region, virtual and in-person when possible, such as immersive experiences and peer-to-peer visits for network partner organizations and emerging social entrepreneurs, fostering collaboration, culture, and connection in line with our broader network vision and values
* Lead initiatives and strategies on region wide and global priorities to contribute to progress against our network intended outcomes
* Co-build public sector partnership collaboration and learning across the region and globally
* Support leadership development of key stakeholders in the region from alumni and senior partner staff through coaching and leadership development experiences

Contribute to Teach For All globally (10%)

* Work with the other global teams to contribute to global priorities and initiatives in particular in relation to our leadership development and program strategies
* Represent the global organization as needed at external opportunities

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience & Track Record: Minimum 10 years of professional experience, including demonstrable success leading senior-level public sector partnerships and navigating complex government or education systems across Europe.
* Contextual & Geographic Mastery: Deep familiarity with living and working within the European sociopolitical landscape, with current legal authorization to live and work long-term in an eligible hiring country.
* Strategic Systems Thinking: Proven ability to analyze educational landscapes, navigate bureaucratic systems, and design actionable public partnership strategies that achieve scale and sustainability.
* Executive Relationship Building: Exceptional interpersonal and political acumen, with a track record of building trusted relationships with senior leaders, government ministers, and diverse community stakeholders.
* Adaptive Leadership: Demonstrated experience navigating ambiguity, leading through influence across matrixed and cross-border teams without formal authority, and making sound decisions in complex environments.
* Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: Demonstrated commitment to DEI principles, with deep self-awareness and the ability to navigate racial, cultural, ideological, and power dynamics across countries.
* Linguistic Capability: Professional fluency in written and spoken English, paired with strong, professional-level communication skills.

**Additional Desirable Skills / Experiences**

* Fluency or professional working proficiency in French or an additional European language.
* Direct professional experience working inside schools, school networks, or national education ministries.
* Formal executive or leadership coaching experience supporting senior executives and social entrepreneurs.
* Prior hands-on experience designing or managing EU-funded programs (e.g., Erasmus+ projects).
* Familiarity with the Teach For All network model and theory of systemic change.

**What Teach For All Offers:**

* Commitment to cultivating a culture in which all staff members feel they belong, are valued for their contributions, and have an impact on our organization's progress
* Professional and personal development experiences and ample opportunities to make a positive impact on the work of Teach For All and beyond
* Comprehensive benefits package designed for your well-being and work-life needs
* Generous time off and flexible work arrangements
* And much more!

**Application Instructions**

If this opportunity sounds like the next best step in your career, please submit your resume or curriculum vitae (CV) and a one-page letter of motivation (in English) directly online. Your letter should summarize motivations for your application and how your skills and experience align with the terms of this opportunity. We look forward to learning about you and your passion for ensuring educational opportunity for all!

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Therefore, candidates are encouraged to apply at their earliest convenience.

**Work authorization**

This position does not offer employment visa sponsorship, immigration assistance, or support for work permits or residency applications. To be considered, candidates must already possess valid work and residency authorization to work in the country of hire at the time of application.

**Compensation**

Salary for this position is competitive and dependent on country of hire and prior work experience and includes a comprehensive benefits package.

**Travel and Hours**

Most work is delivered virtually. Up to 30% of travel may be required. Given that we work across different time zones, some non-traditional hours for early or later calls are an expectation of this role.

**About Teach For All**

Teach For All is a global network of over 60 independent, locally led organizations and a global organization united by a commitment to developing collective leadership to ensure all children can fulfill their potential. Each network partner recruits and develops promising leaders to teach in their nations' under-resourced schools and communities and, with this foundation, to work with others, inside and outside of education, towards a world where all children have the education, support, and opportunity to shape a better future. Teach For All's global organization works to increase the network's impact by supporting the development of new organizations; fostering network connectivity and learning; providing coaching and consulting; and enabling access to global resources for the benefit of the network.

title: Lead Deployment Strategist - EMEA
description:
**The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.**

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

* Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders
* Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects
* Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what *you* can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Your main goal will be to build and lead a high-performing Deployment Strategist team that helps n8n's enterprise customers turn automation opportunities into measurable business impact. You'll own the methodology that drives successful Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) engagements, accelerating customer adoption, getting high-value workflows into production, and enabling customers to become independent builders.

To achieve this, you'll focus on four key areas:

### **Build & Lead the Deployment Strategist Team**

* Hire, onboard, and coach a team of Deployment Strategists who partner with Forward Deployed Engineers to deliver high-impact customer engagements.
* Set a high bar for executive discovery, ROI definition, change management, and customer handovers, ensuring consistent delivery quality across the team.
* Stay hands-on by leading customer engagements yourself while building the team, creating a culture of ownership, continuous learning, and customer impact.

### **Own & Scale the Deployment Methodology**

* Build and continuously improve our four-phase engagement methodology (Define, Identify, Co-build, Handover), including ROI frameworks, discovery guides, opportunity assessments, and handover templates.
* Partner with CSMs, AEs, and Sales leadership to identify and qualify high-impact customer opportunities, define clear success criteria, and scope the right engagement model.
* Turn learnings from workshops, hackathons, on-site builds, and staff augmentation engagements into repeatable playbooks that scale across FDE, Customer Success, and partner teams.

### **Drive Customer Adoption & Business Outcomes**

* Lead executive discovery and ROI conversations to align customer stakeholders on high-value automation opportunities, success metrics, and organizational change.
* Measure engagement success through workflows deployed to production, customer adoption improvements, and measurable business outcomes, rather than services delivery alone.
* Ensure seamless handovers to Customer Success Managers and provide CS and GTM leadership with visibility into engagement results, customer ROI, and expansion opportunities.

### **Scale Delivery Quality & Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Partner with the Partner Delivery Manager and Partnerships teams to ensure external delivery partners follow the same engagement methodology and quality standards.
* Help define readiness, certification, and quality expectations for partner Deployment Strategists to enable consistent customer experiences at scale.
* Work closely with FDEs, Product, and Engineering to turn customer feedback, technical gaps, feature requests, and custom integration needs into actionable product insights.

**REQUIREMENTS**
----------------

### **Must-haves**

* **Enterprise Customer Experience:** You have 7+ years of experience in customer-facing roles such as professional services, solutions consulting, implementation, or customer success within a software company.
* **People Leadership:** You have 2+ years of experience leading, coaching, and developing customer-facing teams, with a track record of building high-performing teams.
* **0-to-1 Builder Experience:** You've built or scaled a deployment, implementation, or professional services function and know how to create structure and repeatable processes in an evolving environment.
* **Executive Stakeholder Management:** You're experienced in leading executive discovery, building compelling ROI cases, and securing buy-in from multiple stakeholders within enterprise organizations.
* **Technical Fluency:** You're comfortable discussing workflow automation, integrations, and AI use cases with technical stakeholders and collaborating closely with engineers without needing to write code yourself.
* **Operational Excellence:** You know how to define success metrics, build scalable methodologies, and turn customer engagement learnings into actionable playbooks.
* **Customer Outcome Mindset:** You're focused on driving measurable customer adoption and long-term value, rather than simply delivering projects or completing engagements.

### **Nice-to-haves**

* **Automation Platforms:** You're familiar with n8n or other workflow automation, integration, or low-code platforms.
* **Change Management:** You have experience helping enterprise organizations drive adoption, navigate organizational change, and embed new technologies into their ways of working.
* **Partner Ecosystems:** You've worked with systems integrators, consulting firms, or external delivery partners to deliver customer implementations or technical engagements.

**Why join us?**

At n8n, you'll have the opportunity to build a brand-new function at the heart of how we scale enterprise customer adoption. You won't just manage a team — you'll shape how we engage customers, demonstrate the value of automation, and turn high-impact use cases into production workflows that drive lasting business outcomes.

You'll work closely with leaders across Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Engineering, with significant visibility and influence over our enterprise growth strategy. As one of Europe's fastest-growing startups, we offer the opportunity to build from the ground up, experiment with new approaches, and create a scalable deployment model that helps customers become independent, successful builders.

You'll join a supportive, remote-first team that values autonomy, collaboration, and continuous learning, where your impact will be visible from day one.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

*n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

*We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.*

***Our company language is English.***

*You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our* *Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n* *(**https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35**).*

***Location disclaimer:*** *If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.*

**Benefits**
------------

* **Competitive compensation** – We offer fair and attractive pay.
* **Ownership** – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.
* **Work/life balance** – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

  + **Europe:** 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.
  + **US:** 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.
* **Health & wellness** –

  + **Europe:** We provide benefits according to local country norms.\*
  + **US**: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.
* **Future planning** –

  + **Europe:** We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.\*
  + **US:** 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.
* **Financial security** –

  + **Europe:** We provide benefits according to local country norms.\*
  + **US:** Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.
* **Career growth** – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.
* **A passionate team** – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!
* **Remote-first** – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.
* **Giving back** – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.
* **Transparency** – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.
* *Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement.*

title: Director of Field and Events Marketing
description:
**About Us**  
  
Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.  
  
We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.  
  
Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.  
  
At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.  
  
Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

**About the Role**
------------------

Perk is changing how companies manage travel and spend, and how we show up in front of our buyers, in person and inside their accounts, is one of the biggest drivers of how we win. We are looking for a Director of Field and Events Marketing to bring ABM, field marketing and every event we run together into one global team, and to build it into the engine that puts the right people from the right accounts in the room with our sales teams.

This is a global leadership role with real scale. You will lead the full events portfolio alongside our field marketing teams in every region, and you will work hand in hand with sales leaders on where pipeline is needed and how we go and get it. You will set the standard for how a fast-growing company runs events, and be measured on the pipeline you create and the retention and expansion you help drive. There is a lot to build in this role, and you will have the mandate and the budget to build it.

The right candidate is a strategic operator with deep ABM expertise, who loves the commercial side of events, gets energy from working shoulder to shoulder with Sales, and wants to build an events centre of excellence people in the industry talk about. It is an exciting time to join, with real momentum behind the business, in an AI-first company that expects its leaders to rethink how work gets done.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Build and scale ABM**

* Scale our account-based approach across regions, segments and the full sales cycle, from creating pipeline in target accounts to accelerating deals and growing existing customers, with a clear standard for how target accounts are chosen and engaged, agreed with Sales and Revenue Operations.
* Extend ABM beyond the field team, working with Product Marketing, Growth, Content and Brand so that campaigns across marketing are built around the same priority accounts.
* Define the milestones that show an account is moving through a long sales cycle, run regular account reviews, and shift resource towards the accounts and programmes that are making progress.

### **Build an events centre of excellence**

* Build and lead a centre of excellence that brings every type of event we run into one team, from demand generation events and trade shows to conferences, customer events and F1 hospitality, with a single planning calendar, shared standards, and the playbooks, templates and vendor approach that let every region deliver to the same quality.
* Set the events strategy in line with our business goals, go-to-market plans and integrated campaigns, and own the portfolio, deciding which events and sponsorships we invest in, scale or stop based on what each one delivers for pipeline and for our customers.
* Manage a global budget for events and field marketing, allocating it across regions, formats and programmes and moving investment towards what performs.

### **Partner with Sales**

Partnering with Sales is a critical part of this role. You will work with sales leadership in every region to decide where pipeline is needed and which programmes will deliver it.

* Build one alignment model for the global team, with field leads working inside each region's sales leadership, joining pipeline reviews and planning, so that priorities are shared and investment follows where pipeline is needed most.
* Create one front door for every event and field request from Sales, with clear intake, triage and funding rules.
* Equip sales teams and executives to get the most from every programme with target lists, outreach templates and follow-up plays, and own the pipeline plan for our biggest events, including invitations, meetings and executive sessions.

### **Drive pipeline and customer growth**

* Own the pipeline targets for ABM, field and events, partnering with Revenue Operations on attribution and reporting pipeline created and influenced, and cost per opportunity by programme and region.
* Make sure every programme you run contributes to growing our net revenue retention, using events and ABM to deepen relationships with existing customers and drive expansion alongside winning new business.
* Establish experimentation and testing frameworks across event types, turning what you learn into repeatable programmes and investment decisions.

### **Team and ways of working**

* Lead, coach and grow a global team of field marketing managers and events marketing managers, hiring where needed and building a culture of ownership, creativity and continuous learning.
* Be AI fluent and AI first in your approach, using automation for account research, event operations, follow-up and reporting so the team delivers more than its headcount would suggest.
* Work closely with Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, Brand, Content and PR so that events and field programmes support our major launches and company moments.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 10+ years in B2B marketing, with deep ABM and field marketing expertise and experience running events at scale.
* A proven track record of sourcing pipeline through account-targeted programmes, with the numbers to show it, ideally in a company with a meaningful enterprise or mid-market sales motion.
* Experience running a multi-format events portfolio, including conferences, trade shows, hospitality and customer events, and managing sponsorships and vendors.
* Strong credibility with sales leaders, built through partnering with them on pipeline reviews and regional planning.
* Experience using events and ABM to drive expansion and retention as well as new business.
* Experience building and leading teams, including managers and regional leads, across time zones.
* Experience managing and forecasting large budgets, and partnering with finance and RevOps to measure and report ROI.

### **Skills and traits**

* Strategic thinker who can turn vision into a global plan, with a roll your sleeves up approach to execution.
* Operational rigour, building target lists, funding rules and reporting before booking venues.
* A strong point of view and the confidence to make hard calls.
* Executive presence, with excellent written and verbal communication.
* One team mindset, collaborating with global teams while working closely with regional sales and marketing.
* A growth mindset, and willingness to travel as programmes require.

**AI at Perk**  
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

**How We Work**

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

**Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Fitness Program Director
description:
**Summary**
-----------

This position is assigned to the Non-Appropriated Fund (NAF) Fitness, Sports, and Deployed Forces Support Branch; Fleet Readiness; Commander, Navy Installations Command (CNIC); Naval Station Rota, Spain. Incumbent has oversight of the Fitness, Sports, and Aquatics programs at the installation. Additional programs (e.g. Deployed Forces Support) may be included based on need and installation size.

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

### **The public**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Military spouses**

Military spouses of active duty service members or whose spouse is 100 percent disabled or died on active duty.

### **Family of overseas employees**

Family members of a federal employee or uniformed service member who is or was, working overseas.

### **Clarification from the agency**

United States Citizens Worldwide, including local U.S. Citizens that are 1) Current permanent NAF/APF employees; or 2) Spouses of active duty military members; or 3) Family members of active duty military member; or 4) Family members of DoD civilians.

  

**Duties**
----------

**Program Management (includes but not limited to):**

* Plans, organizes, develops, implements, and manages a diverse and comprehensive fitness, sports, and aquatics program, within the scope of objectives and guidelines established at higher organizational levels, to include related facilities (e.g., group exercise classes; self-directed fitness sports, and aquatics programs; aquatics programs; incentive programs; special events; intramural, extramural and varsity sports; instructional programs; and awareness and education programs).

* Coordinates with city, state, other military bases, and pertinent organizations in establishing a well-rounded fitness and sports program and to effectively promote all aspects of health/wellness to the community.

* Coordinates with base organizations to ensure fitness advisory members are assigned and the bylaws and philosophy of fitness programs are thoroughly understood.

* Conducts meetings and hosts collaborated events/educational seminars/information fairs, etc.

* Maintains records of command participation and determines the winner of individual and base awards and makes arrangements for presentations.

* Interprets considerable data relating to program trends, costs, problems, and needs; refines ormodifies program methods and techniques based on findings.

* Prepares appropriated fund (APF) and NAF budgets, which include the expenditures required to conduct the fitness, sports and aquatics programs (categories A and B).

* Monitors contract services and properly performs quality assessment and evaluation (QAE) responsibilities.

* Completes local needs assessments and/or local surveys annually to determine customer needs and incorporates these finding into the annual program plan.

* Coordinates with marketing staff to plan and develop promotional advertising, commercial sponsorship, and publicity strategies.

* Assists local Command Fitness Leaders (CFL) in conducting and administering safe and proper Physical Readiness Tests.

* Solicits, interviews, selects, and directs volunteers and contract instructors for activities and specialty programs.

* Maintains appropriate records and submits deserving volunteers for recognition through the base volunteer recognition program.

* Reviews research publications and health journals to ensure currency in methodology and philosophy in the area of health and fitness (e.g., exercise physiology, life-style management, nutrition, and physical conditioning).

* Ensures the program meets or exceeds industry standards as established by governmental and private organizations such as the Cooper Institute, Presidents Council on Physical Fitness, Occupational Safety and Health Administration, Department of Defense (DoD), American College of Sports Medicine, etc

  
**Facility Management (includes but not limited to):**

* Coordinates the use and maintenance of indoor and outdoor facilities, which may include but is not limited to, gymnasium(s), fitness center(s), tennis court(s), swimming pool(s), softball field(s), jogging track(s), football field(s) and soccer field(s) to accommodate the comprehensive installation fitness, aquatics, and sports programs.

* Coordinates with and assists engineers on requirements related to construction of all new indoor and outdoor fitness and athletic facilities.

* Coordinates with Naval Facilities Engineering Command, and other base agencies (e.g., Safety Office) regarding requirements for maintenance and repair of fitness, sports and aquatic facilities and purchase and installation of new equipment.

* Develops a five-year facility improvement program to maintain a state of the art program, prepares construction plans for renovations/additions or expansion and submits work orders for all minor construction projects from inception to completion.

* Ensures inventory control of all property, equipment and supplies to protect government assets and determines replacement requirements levels.

* Takes timely and appropriate action to comply with safety, fire and environmental directions and ensures safe, healthy, contemporary, comfortable, and adequate facilities.

  
**Supervisory duties comprise 25% of incumbent's time and include but are not limited to:**

* Directs work to be accomplished by a staff that includes Fitness Coordinator, Sports Coordinator Aquatics Coordinator, Fitness Facility Coordinator, Outdoor Maintenance Supervisor and other subordinate staff.

* Assigns work based on priorities, difficulty and requirements of assignments, and staff capabilities.

* Conducts annual performance reviews of staff.

* Participates in MWR Fitness staffing decisions.

* Ensures staff receives proper training to fulfill requirements of their positions.

* Addresses potential disciplinary and/or performance issues timely and takes appropriate, corrective action(s) as necessary.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

* Occasional travel of less than 10% may be required.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a valid state driver’s license.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation and First Aid certification.
* Must have ability to maintain fitness/health certification from a National Commission for Certifying Agencies (NCCA) or Distance Education Accrediting Commission (DEAC).

### **Qualifications**

**KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED BY THE POSITION**
  
  
Knowledge of a wide range of principles, concepts and techniques that govern physical fitness programs which includes knowledge of exercise science, strength conditioning, nutrition, weight loss/control, cardiovascular endurance, exercise requirements and projected results.
  
  
Knowledge of bio-mechanics, fitness testing and exercise prescription supplemented with a knowledge of proper procedures in the use of strength training equipment, nutrition, exercise, physical fitness programming and testing equipment.
  
  
Skill in planning and executing a comprehensive fitness, aquatics, and/or sports program that includes a variety of fitness and aquatics activities and individual and team sports.
  
  
Knowledge of anatomy, physiology, and kinesiology as related to exercise and physical fitness.
  
  
Knowledge of military physical fitness standards and testing procedures.
  
  
Knowledge of the physical and psychological factors that impact training, performance and recovery of individuals and team sports.
  
  
Knowledge of CNIC's EEO policy and procedures.
  
  
Knowledge of NAF and/or APF budgeting processes including ability to prepare budgets.
  
  
Skill in the use of Microsoft Office Programs (e.g., Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook).
  
  
Knowledge of safety, fire and environmental regulations and procedures.
  
  
Ability to develop and effectively deliver presentations and/or training.
  
  
Skill in developing and adapting new methods, approaches and procedures for the most effective
  
management of a fitness program.
  
  
Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing

### **Education**

Per DoD MWR Fitness Standards (issued 21 July 2016) this is a supervisory position responsible for total facility oversight including operation, programming and staffing. While elements (a) through (c) are preferred, a combination of two of these elements may sufficiently qualify an individual to perform their duties as program director:
  
  
a) professional certification from a National Commission for Certifying Agencies (NCCA) or Distance Education Accrediting Commission (DEAC) accredited health/fitness organization.
  
  
b) competency in business and the design and delivery of exercise programs; and
  
  
c) at least three years of experience in the fitness industry/field for civilian personnel.

### **Additional information**

Salary is dependent on experience and/or education.

Some positions have special requirements. Selection may be tentative pending the completion of these requirements. Applicants may be required to submit proof of education, participate in medical screening, drug testing, etc. All selections are contingent upon satisfactory employment reference checks. title: Process Automation Engineer
location: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, CN, Spain
description:
##### ***-******Las Palmas De Gran Canaria******-***

**Alien Technology Transfer** empowers top-class innovators to transform visionary product concepts into commercial realities. We do this by helping companies with concrete growth ambitions to secure funding for their product development through our innovation consulting expertise. To date, we have raised more than $700 million for our clients - Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) - across many domains, including agri-tech, artificial intelligence, biotechnology, clean-tech, cyber-security, quantum computing, space, and transport.

We’re looking for a versatile **Process Automation Engineer** to join Alien Technology Transfer at **our office in Las Palmas**. Working closely with and reporting directly to our CEO, you will play a central role in a company-wide review of how each of our departments operates. Your job is to understand how work actually gets done, identify where time, quality and effort are being lost, and then design, build and maintain the tools that fix it. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role that combines process analysis with full-stack engineering. You will spend time with department heads and their teams to map workflows and pinpoint inefficiencies. You will turn your findings into standardised processes and reliable software that is easily adopted. We are not looking for a specialist in a single layer, nor for someone who only writes code to a specification. We need a strong generalist who can diagnose a business problem, decide what should be standardised, automated or eliminated, and then deliver a working solution end-to-end.

To join our team, you must possess a genuine interest in technology and business, be fluent in English, and take a highly analytical, articulate, and well-organised approach to your work. We are seeking a self-motivated team player with a strong startup attitude and the stamina to thrive within an ambitious, goal-driven environment. The ideal candidate is eager to take on high levels of responsibility, possesses sharp problem-solving skills, and is proactive about staying up to date on the latest tools — AI or otherwise — to ensure top performance. You are energised by wearing multiple hats—effectively managing priorities and diverse deliverables autonomously without needing a detailed playbook. If you are ready to make a meaningful impact in this dynamic role, we would be excited to hear from you.

* **Contract Type:** Permanent.
* **Hybrid Work Modality:** Monday to Thursday at the Office (Las Canteras area) and Friday Work from Home.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

Process Diagnosis & Standardisation

* Work with each department to map current workflows and understand how work is actually done.
* Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, duplicated effort, error-prone manual steps and activities that add little value, and quantify their impact where possible.
* Define standardised processes, templates and quality checks that reduce variability and prevent quality issues before they reach clients.
* Present findings and recommendations to the CEO and department heads, and prioritise improvements by impact and effort.

Tool Development & Platform Engineering

* Design, build and maintain internal tools and applications that enhance the performance of each department, from data layer through to API and user interface.
* Integrate tools with the systems our teams already use, such as Google Workspace, Odoo, and other AI-powered tools, so that solutions fit naturally into existing workflows usable by department personnel.
* Write clean, tested, maintainable code, and keep internal tools documented and easy to hand over.

Infrastructure & Deployment

* Set up, maintain, and improve our deployment pipelines, infrastructure, and environments.
* Handle the operational side of running the platform: CI/CD, monitoring, and keeping things stable and secure.

Adoption & Continuous Improvement

* Support teams in adopting new tools and processes through clear documentation, training and hands-on support.
* Define and track metrics that show whether each change is improving department performance, and iterate based on results and user feedback.
* Continuously identify new opportunities for standardisation and automation as the business evolves.

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrable full-stack breadth.
* Strong backend engineering skills, with proficiency in Python.
* Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM or other AI/ML-based solutions.
* Proven ability to analyse business processes and translate them into practical software or automation solutions.
* Ability to translate user needs into clear UI/UX requirements (user flows, screens, states, edge cases) and to evaluate and refine interfaces until they are intuitive for non-technical users.
* Practical experience with infrastructure, deployment, and DevOps practices (CI/CD, cloud environments, containerisation).
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work with non-technical colleagues, understand their needs, and explain technical trade-offs clearly.
* A generalist mindset: comfortable owning a problem from diagnosis through to a deployed, maintained solution.
* Fluency in English (C1/C2 level) with strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with AWS or Google Cloud.
* Experience building AI tools that work with documents, such as searching, summarising, extracting or checking text (e.g. RAG, vector databases, NLP).
* Experience with Google Workspace APIs and workflow-automation platforms (e.g. Zapier, n8n, Make).
* Knowledge of process-improvement methods such as Lean, Six Sigma or business process mapping.
* Experience in consultancy or professional-services environments, particularly in document-heavy work such as proposal or report writing.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive Fixed Salary
* Relocation & Bureaucracy Support: Dedicated guidance and administrative assistance for obtaining your Spanish NIE, social security, and local residency registration in Las Palmas.
* Work Flexibility: Hybrid work model (4 days onsite / 1 day WFH) + 20 extra remote working days per year to use at your convenience.
* Health & Wellbeing: Private health insurance coverage.
* Time Off: 30 days of paid annual leave.
* Company Culture: Regular team-building events, social activities, and a vibrant work environment in a co-working space just 50 meters from the beach in Las Palmas de Gran Canaria.

Please note: Due to the high volume of candidates, we are unfortunately unable to provide individual feedback on the outcome of every application.

title: Onboarding Analyst
description:
**About us:**

BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.

We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.

Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.

Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today

By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.

We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.

We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:

* CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)
* FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)
* Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)
* LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)

**About this role in the team:**

Due to our expanding business, there is an increased demand for a Compliance Onboarding Analyst to join the Team. The role requires a high level of initiative, as well as expertise in a FinTech environment and cooperation with corporate and individual clients. This role requires high attention to clients needs, self education and self organization. This role will form part of our global team, and will work closely with Operations, Trading Team, Sales, and Management.

**Key Areas of Responsibilities:**

* Manage the onboarding and due diligence process for the Company's Corporate clients, ensuring adherence to best practices in onboarding, compliance, and risk management
* Oversee the end-to-end Corporate customer application process, including collection and verification of required documentation
* Accurately identify Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBOs) and Directors of Corporate clients, and gather all relevant details in line with internal policies
* Collect, review, and verify all required documentation for Corporate applications in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements
* Conduct screening and due diligence checks (e.g. Sanctions, PEPs, Adverse Media), and resolve any potential matches or flags
* Ensure compliance with all relevant laws, regulations, and internal standards, as well as external industry best practices
* Make case-by-case decisions regarding the need for further investigations or escalations, and follow through on appropriate actions
* Perform risk assessments for all customers and follow the company's approval and escalation protocols
* Identify and suggest improvements to onboarding processes to enhance efficiency, compliance, and customer experience
* Support the onboarding of Private Individuals on the BVNK platform across various products, ensuring processes are applied consistently

**What we need from you:**

* Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills
* Minimum 2 years of experience in B2B (corporate) customer onboarding within the payments or crypto industry
* Previous experience in a fintech or payments environment, with a good understanding of KYC/AML onboarding practices
* Demonstrated experience onboarding clients with complex ownership structures and from high-risk industries
* Proven ability to onboard and manage various legal entity types, including private limited companies, partnerships, trusts, and foundations
* Strong research and analytical skills, with the ability to identify UBOs and assess corporate documentation
* Hands-on experience using Salesforce or similar CRM tools for customer management and onboarding workflow tracking
* Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced, high-growth environment while maintaining high standards for accuracy, productivity, and compliance
* Comfortable managing multiple onboarding cases simultaneously, with strong organizational and time management skills

**What you can expect from us:**

* Fair and **competitive salary** at every stage of your growth
* **Flexible working** hours, with hybrid working at its heart
* A **culture** built on passionate, growth-minded people
* A **flexible approach to holiday**
* Opportunities to travel to our **offices around the world**
* An **open and creative environment** where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets

*At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we'd encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team.*

title: Group Product Manager (Core)
description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

**Our vision:** A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

### **About the Role:**

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. We're looking for a Group Product Manager to lead Wrike's Core unit - the product area at the heart of how customers plan, structure, manage, and scale work in Wrike.

In this role, you will lead a unit of five product teams and manage a team of five Product Managers. You will define the vision and strategy for Core Wrike going forward, balancing three critical forces: increasing product power, preserving ease of use, and evolving the experience to be suitable for the AI-native future.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who can combine strong product judgment, people leadership, customer empathy, and strategic prioritization. You will help shape the foundation of Wrike's product experience while developing a team of PMs into stronger strategic product leaders.

### **Your Impact:**

* Set the Core strategy: Define and evolve the vision, strategy, and priorities for Wrike's Core unit, ensuring the product remains powerful, scalable, easy to use, and ready for AI agents collaboration as well as for human.
* Lead a multi-team product area: Manage five Product Managers across five teams, ensuring clarity of ownership, strong decision-making, and consistent product quality across the unit.
* Prioritize ferociously: Balance customer requests, enterprise needs, technical investments, usability improvements, and long-term strategic bets — with a clear view of what matters most.
* Enable AI-native R&D: Contribute to building the processes, tooling, and mindsets needed for the R&D organization to scale output and outcomes by 10x with AI-native ways of working.
* Develop the PM team: Coach, mentor, and grow Product Managers, helping them to achieve the next level.

### **Your Qualifications:**

* Product leadership experience: Proven experience leading product managers or managing a complex product area with multiple teams and stakeholders.
* Strong core PM craft and customer-centric mindset: Deep understanding of product discovery, customer validation, roadmap strategy, prioritization, metrics, and product delivery.
* Enterprise SaaS experience: Strong knowledge of B2B SaaS and enterprise customer needs, including scalability, adoption, usability, configurability, and change management.
* Strategic prioritization: Ability to make hard trade-offs across incomparable investments, customer escalations, technical complexity, and long-term platform direction.
* Cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management: Ability to align teams and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, GTM, and executive leadership.
* People management skills: Experience coaching, mentoring, hiring, developing, and managing performance of product managers.
* Excellent UX judgment: Ability to balance power and simplicity in complex product experiences.

### **Standout Qualities:**

* Experience in B2B SaaS enterprise products in collaboration or productivity area
* Practical understanding of AI-native product development and agentic workflows.
* Visionary mindset and ability to redefine complex products vision
* Strong technical fluency and ability to partner effectively with engineering leaders.

### **Our Work Style:**

* Core product impact: You will shape the foundational Wrike experience used by customers every day to manage work at scale.
* Strategic complexity: The role requires balancing power, simplicity, customer demand, technical depth, and AI-readiness in one of Wrike's most important product areas.
* People leadership scope: You will directly develop a team of five PMs and influence the product culture of a larger R&D unit.
* AI-native transformation: You will help define how Core Wrike evolves for a future where AI changes how teams create, structure, and manage work.
* High visibility: Your decisions will influence Wrike's product direction, customer value, and long-term competitiveness.

### **What's Next?**

* Exploratory call with a Recruiter
* Meeting with the hiring manager - Product Director
* Panel interview with Product, Engineering, and Design representatives
* Home task
* Final interview with the CPO

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.  
  
#LI-AV1

### **Who Is Wrike and Our Culture**

We're a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

**Hybrid work mode**

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.

While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

#### **Our persona**

**Smart:** We love what we do, and we're great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.

**Dedicated:** We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We're committed to helping our teammates win, too!

**Approachable:** We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

#### **Our culture and Values**

**Customer-Focused**

**We care about our customers.** We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

**Collaborative**

**We work as one and win together,** each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

**Creative**

**We strive to succeed through continuous innovation.** It's our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

**Committed**

**We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization,** by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

description:

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Marketing Manager is responsible for developing and implementing marketing strategies and plans that drive revenue and support the hotel's business objectives. This role oversees the execution of marketing initiatives, including digital marketing, advertising, public relations, social media, promotions and collateral, ensuring alignment with brand standards and commercial priorities.

The Marketing Manager is committed to bringing to life a distinctive luxury boutique hotel shaped by arts, creativity and curiosity. From its distinctive suites to its singularly designed restaurants, bars, spaces and experiences unfolding across a dedicated floor, every touchpoint presents an opportunity to provoke, inspire and indulge, revealing a new expression of Barcelona through a oneiric, enigmatic and cosmopolitan lens.

The role is committed to elevating every touchpoint to its fullest potential, curating a world that feels mythic and mysterious, protecting the concept's secrets and integrity, and embodying the spirit of a gracious host throughout every space, communication and encounter. Deeply connected to local culture and its artistic excellences, the Marketing Manager ensures that every expression of the hotel remains distinctive, meaningful and authentic.

The Marketing Manager supports the Director of Marketing & Communications in translating the hotel's marketing strategy and positioning into effective plans, campaigns and day-to-day execution. The role is hands-on and highly transversal, partnering closely with hotel departments and external agencies to ensure consistency, creativity and excellence across every guest-facing touchpoint.

The position begins during the pre-opening phase, supporting the preparation and delivery of opening marketing initiatives, launch communications and brand-building activities, and continues into the hotel's ongoing operational marketing.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

  

* High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in marketing, public relations, communications or related professional area.
* OR 2-year degree from an accredited university in Marketing, Public Relations, Business Administration or related major; no work experience required.
* Experience in luxury hospitality, lifestyle brands or creative environments is highly valued.
* Strong project management, organisational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Creative sensibility, editorial judgement and attention to detail; able to translate brand direction into compelling content and executions.
* Fluency in English is mandatory. Spanish is preferred; Catalan is valued.
* Proficiency in digital marketing platforms, social media, content management and common creative tools; Adobe Creative Suite knowledge is required.

**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

**Marketing & Digital**

  

* Develops and executes marketing plans and campaigns in alignment with the hotel's business objectives and brand standards.
* Coordinates the execution of marketing campaigns across Rooms, Suites, Food & Beverage and the hotel’s broader experiences, happenings and brand activations, ensuring appropriate messaging, creative assets, timelines and channel integration.
* Supports the Director of Marketing & Communications in translating strategic priorities into actionable campaign plans, briefs, calendars and deliverables.
* Coordinates digital marketing initiatives across the hotel's website, email marketing, paid media, search, CRM and relevant digital platforms, in collaboration with internal teams and agencies.
* Monitors campaign performance, digital results and relevant marketing KPIs; prepares reports and recommendations to optimise future activity.
* Ensures marketing content, offers and information are accurate, current and consistent across owned and third-party channels.

**Content Management & Storytelling**

  

* Manages the development, production, adaptation and distribution of marketing content and collateral.
* Coordinates photography, video, copywriting and creative production to support campaigns, hotel experiences, Rooms and Suites, Food & Beverage and brand storytelling.
* Ensures content reflects the hotel's distinctive positioning, creative universe, cultural references and tone of voice across all guest touchpoints.
* Maintains content calendars and supports the timely delivery of editorial, promotional and seasonal content.
* Collaborates with hotel departments to identify stories, experiences and moments that can be translated into compelling content.

**Partnerships, Public Relations & Media**

  

* Coordinates marketing and public relations activities with appointed agencies and relevant internal stakeholders.
* Supports the development and management of brand partnerships, cultural collaborations and creative relationships that reinforce the hotel's positioning.
* Coordinates media relations activity, press materials, media visits, hosting and follow-up in collaboration with PR agencies and hotel teams.
* Supports the preparation of press releases, media pitches, briefing documents, fact sheets and other communications materials.
* Maintains relationships with media, influencers, creators and relevant industry contacts, ensuring professional and consistent engagement.

**Outlet & Ancillary Marketing**

  

* Works closely with Food & Beverage and other operational teams to support outlet marketing, promotions, storytelling and commercial initiatives.
* Coordinates marketing activity for restaurants, bars and hotel experiences, ensuring each is presented in a way that strengthens the overall hotel positioning.
* Supports the development of campaigns, content and collateral for outlet launches, seasonal moments, special menus and signature experiences.
* Ensures consistency of messaging and visual identity across outlet communications and guest-facing materials.

**Social Media**

  

* Manages the hotel's social media channels and content calendar in line with brand standards and marketing priorities.
* Coordinates content creation, copywriting, community engagement, publishing and channel optimisation across relevant platforms.
* Identifies opportunities to amplify hotel stories, cultural moments, happenings, partnerships and guest experiences through social channels.
* Monitors social performance, audience engagement and relevant trends, providing regular reporting and insights.
* Ensures timely responses and appropriate escalation of guest comments, messages and online feedback.

**Creative Production & Graphic Design**

  

* Coordinates the creation and adaptation of marketing collateral, presentations, digital assets and guest-facing communications.
* Supports graphic design and artwork development, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines and the hotel's visual identity.
* Liaises with creative agencies, photographers, videographers, printers and other suppliers to deliver high-quality work on brief, on time and within budget.
* Reviews proofs, copy, layouts and final assets for accuracy, consistency and quality.

**Brand Activations, Happenings & Experiences**

  

* Supports the planning and execution of brand activations, cultural happenings, creative collaborations, previews and launch moments.
* Coordinates marketing requirements, creative assets, communications, guest invitations and follow-up for activations and hotel happenings.
* Works cross-functionally with hotel departments and external partners to ensure each activation is coherent, distinctive and aligned with the hotel's brand universe.
* Captures and extends the impact of happenings and activations through content, social media, PR and post-event reporting.

**General**

  

* Maintains strong working relationships with hotel departments, corporate teams, agencies and external partners.
* Manages marketing timelines, project trackers, budgets, purchase orders and administrative requirements as assigned.

title: KAM Senior
description:
Somos una de las marcas de mayor crecimiento en España en el cuidado del hogar.

Buscamos un/a **Key Account Manager (KAM) Senior** para liderar nuestra expansión en el canal moderno en España. Una oportunidad para construir, con mucha autonomía, el siguiente capítulo de una marca que está cambiando las reglas de la categoría.

Fabricamos en España, tenemos presencia en varios países europeos y ya trabajamos con cadenas de supermercados e hipermercados. Ahora toca ir a por más: nuevos lineales, más referencias y más cuota de lineal en las cuentas actuales.

**Por qué este puesto es especial**
-----------------------------------

* **Impacto real y visible:** tu trabajo se traduce directamente en crecimiento de la marca, desde el primer trimestre.
* **Marca con producto diferencial:** vendes un producto innovador, con una historia potente y diferente a todo lo que hay en el lineal.
* **Autonomía y confianza:** equipo pequeño, decisiones rápidas y acceso directo a la dirección. Nada de burocracia.
* **Visión completa:** trabajarás codo con codo con el Director Comercial en la estrategia de trade marketing, y con datos de mercado para argumentar cada negociación.
* **Crecimiento:** una marca en expansión europea que necesita a alguien que crezca con ella.

**Tus responsabilidades**
-------------------------

* Gestionar y desarrollar la cartera de cuentas clave del canal moderno (supermercados, hipermercados y cadenas regionales), con revisiones comerciales periódicas para supervisar el rendimiento y la ejecución.
* Negociar y cerrar acuerdos comerciales y contratos, y hacer seguimiento de la facturación.
* Abrir nuevas cuentas y conseguir la entrada en nuevos lineales, así como ampliar referencias y cuota de lineal en las cuentas existentes.
* Preparar presentaciones para compradores apoyadas en datos de mercado para demostrar potencial de ventas y distribución.
* Analizar de forma continua la posición competitiva y del cliente, y definir junto al Director Comercial la estrategia y acciones de trade marketing a corto y largo plazo.
* Definir y dar seguimiento a los KPIs de los distintos canales de distribución.
* Coordinarte con finanzas, operaciones y administración para asegurar un servicio excelente al cliente.

**A quién buscamos**
--------------------

**Requisitos**

* Mínimo **4 años de experiencia como KAM** (o rol equivalente) en **productos de droguería / limpieza del hogar en canal moderno**.
* Conocimiento del sector y relación con compradores de cadenas de supermercados e hipermercados en España.
* Experiencia demostrable en negociación comercial y cierre de acuerdos con retail.
* Capacidad analítica para trabajar con datos de ventas y construir argumentos comerciales.
* Residencia en **Barcelona o Madrid**.

**Competencias**

* Dominio de técnicas de venta y negociación.
* Gran capacidad para gestionar el tiempo y priorizar; automotivación.
* Capaz de asumir responsabilidad y resolver retos de forma creativa.

**Cómo trabajamos**
-------------------

Somos un equipo joven, ambicioso y con ganas de hacer las cosas bien. Tenemos base en Barcelona y trabajamos con un modelo remote-first: buscamos a la persona en **Barcelona o Madrid**, con encuentros presenciales con el equipo que acordaremos juntos.

Aquí cada persona es una pieza clave en su función. Si quieres jugar en la liga grande de una marca que está creciendo rápido, ¡queremos conocerte!

title: Cuentas (Barcelona) - Moda & lifestyle y Gran consumo & Lifestyle.
description:
**Queremos conocerte en el equipo de Cuentas Barcelona**

Somos una agencia de comunicación creativa.

Nuestro propósito es conectar a las marcas con sus audiencias de forma genuina, memorable y hecha para durar.

Estamos cerca de la cultura y conectados a las conversaciones que marcan la vida de las personas. Entendemos qué le importa a cada audiencia, y quién la inspira, para ayudar a las marcas a crear contenido relevante y a ganarse un lugar con sentido en la mente de la gente.

Nuestra fórmula: experiencia, curiosidad y trabajo en equipo.

Queremos conocer a profesionales de **dirección de cuentas** que quieran formar parte de nuestro equipo en Barcelona. Abrimos 2 posiciones para liderar la comunicación de marcas de **Moda y Gran consumo. (Moda & lifestyle y Gran consumo & Lifestyle)**

**Cómo es un rol de cuentas en Equipo Singular**

En Equipo Singular, el director/a de cuentas es quién conoce a la marca, el entrono y las tendencias. Quien define la estrategia de comunicación y lidera al equipo para trabajar un buen plan en tiempo y forma, con los mejores resultados para el cliente y la agencia.

* Es el interlocutor principal del cliente y su socio estratégico.
* Define las estrategias de comunicación y relaciones públicas del sus marcas y vela por que cada acción responda a ellas.
* Dirige al equipo multidisciplinar que formamos (prensa, social media, influencers, eventos, contenidos, creatividad, video..) y coordina su trabajo.
* Gestiona la rentabilidad del proyecto: desde el presupuesto y la facturación hasta su cierre de resultados.
* Detecta oportunidades y participa en propuestas a nuevos clientes.
* Tiene un pensamiento crítico para mejorar su día a día, para tomar decisiones, par implementar procesos y herramientas (incluidos la IA) que le ayuden a mejorar a si mismo/a, y al equipo.

**¿Que ofrecemos?**

* **Modelo híbrido:** lunes, martes y jueves en oficina, y miércoles y viernes de teletrabajo voluntario. También se teletrabaja en agosto, Navidad y Semana Santa.
* **Horario:** flexible de entrada y salida, con jornada intensiva todos los viernes y en julio y agosto.
* **Vacaciones:** 22 días más 3 de convenio (24 y 31 de diciembre y el Día de la Publicidad).
* **Beneficios:** seguro médico y ticket guardería.

  

* Experiencia demostrada (Mínimo 4 - 6 años) en agencia de comunicación y/o relaciones públicas.

* Experiencia liderando equipos multidisciplinares.
* Experiencia en la gestión económica de clientes.
