title: Product Director (Midcore Direction)
description:
**Who are we?**
---------------

**Tripledot** **Studios** is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who **LOVE** making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

**This role is based within our studio, Belka Games**
-----------------------------------------------------

Belka Games is a game development company ranked by Sensor Tower among the top 30 highest-grossing game developers in Europe. Our games have reached more than 110 million players worldwide

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for a **Product Director** to lead and strengthen our **Midcore Direction**. The key goal at the current stage is a successful global launch of our game Train of Hope and its further scaling.

As part of the Belka Games leadership team, you will contribute to the company’s broader product strategy and long-term development.

The role includes responsibility for the product strategy and business performance of Train of Hope, including its revenue, profitability, long-term product value, and investment efficiency. You will also build a strong product team and look for new growth opportunities for the game, from the best solutions on the market to IP collaborations and partnerships.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Part 1 - Product ownership and global launch**

* Define and implement the product strategy and long-term vision for Train of Hope: target audience, positioning, core gameplay pillars, and a 1-3 year development horizon
* Own the preparation and execution of the global launch: target KPIs and readiness criteria, go/no-go decisions, the launch plan together with Marketing and Development, and post-launch scaling
* Drive the business performance of the direction, including revenue growth, profitability, long-term product value, and investment efficiency
* Drive improvements in long-term retention, engagement, payer conversion, ARPPU, monetization, LTV, and other key product and business metrics
* Drive an AI-first approach to content production: introduce AI tools to automate and optimize the creation of locations, characters, art, text, and localization, reducing production time and cost without compromising quality
* Grow higher-margin monetization and distribution channels, including direct-to-consumer sales
* Balance short-term priorities with long-term product investments and allocate team resources accordingly
* Make decisions on the launch, scaling, iteration, or termination of in-game features and product initiatives
* Ensure high-quality and timely delivery of product updates together with the Development Director and Producers, and reduce product and technical risks of server-side and social features
* Build transparent cross-functional decision-making processes and align Product, Game Design, Narrative, Art, Development, Analytics, Marketing, and Finance around shared goals and priorities
* Partner with the CMO on player acquisition and re-engagement economics and UA scaling decisions for the global launch, taking into account the longer payback of midcore audiences
* Partner with the Belka Games leadership team on the company’s product strategy and long-term development
* Hire and develop strong product leaders and key specialists with midcore expertise (meta and combat design, competitive economy, narrative), and build an autonomous and scalable team

### **Part 2 - Market research and new growth opportunities**

* Continuously research the midcore market, audience, and competitors: successful mechanics, LiveOps and monetization practices, genre and setting trends, and changes in user acquisition costs
* Identify successful solutions on the market and adapt them for Train of Hope, managing a pipeline of in-game hypotheses and experiments
* Source and evaluate IP collaborations for Train of Hope: selecting IPs and partners, building the business case, integrating collaborations into content and LiveOps, and measuring their impact on acquisition, retention, and revenue
* Evaluate other growth opportunities for the game: new markets and localizations, new platforms, partnerships and cross-promotion, new game modes and content formats
* Apply a data-informed and hypothesis-driven approach to prioritizing and validating new opportunities
* Define success criteria in advance and evaluate initiatives against relevant midcore product, market, and business benchmarks
* Develop business cases for major initiatives and partnerships, including the opportunity, expected impact, required resources, timelines, and key risks
* Systematize learnings from experiments, collaborations, and post-release analysis of content and features, scale effective practices, and eliminate ineffective approaches

**Required Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
--------------------------------------------

* Senior product leadership experience in the games industry as a Product Director, Head of Product, Executive Producer, or in a comparable role
* Strong experience with live mobile F2P midcore games (e.g. RPG, strategy, 4X, battlers), including soft launch, global launch, and subsequent scaling
* Proven experience defining and implementing product strategy
* Experience owning product business performance and allocating investment and resources
* Strong analytical and business skills, including experience building business cases and making data-informed product and investment decisions
* Deep understanding of midcore meta, progression, hero and collection systems, game economies, social and competitive features (guilds/alliances, PvP), LiveOps, and F2P monetization, with proven experience improving long-term retention, monetization, revenue, profitability, and product health
* Experience building autonomous cross-functional teams and hiring and developing senior Product Managers, Game Producers, or other product leaders
* Excellent leadership, communication, cross-functional management, and stakeholder alignment skills
* Ability to make clear decisions in uncertain conditions and take ownership of their business consequences
* Fluent in English and Russian

**Would Be a Plus**

* Experience with narrative-driven or content-heavy games and managing a regular content production pipeline
* Experience with IP collaborations, partnerships, or licensed projects
* Hands-on experience introducing AI tools into game content production

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* A successful global launch of Train of Hope that meets target product and business metrics
* Sustainable growth of key metrics after launch
* A predictable content and LiveOps cadence with production costs that pay off
* An established process for finding and implementing new growth opportunities for the game, including IP collaborations
* A strong, autonomous product team with midcore expertise
* Increased maturity and effectiveness of the product function across the company

**Working at Tripledot**
------------------------

* **Hybrid Working:** We work in the office 4 days a week
* **25 days paid holiday** in addition to bank holidays to relax and refresh throughout the year
* **20 days remote working:** Work from anywhere in the world, or use the time to cover mandatory office days to WFH, 20 days of the year
* **Regular company events and rewards:** Join in regular events and rewards that celebrate cultural events, our achievements and our team spirit
* **Private Medical Cover:** Have peace of mind with private medical cover, ensuring your health is in good hands
* **Life & Critical Illness Cover:** Protect your future with our life and critical illness cover
* **Family Forming Support:** Receive vital support on your family forming/ fertility journey with our support program [subject to policy]
* **Employee Assistance Program:** Access confidential support anytime through our Employee Assistance Program
* **Sport Compensation:** Stay fit and active with our sport compensation benefit
* **Meal and Transport Vouchers:** Save on meals and transport with our convenient vouchers
* **English & Spanish Classes:** Enhance your English and Spanish skills with our provided language classes
* **Continuous Professional Development:** Propel your career with continuous opportunities for professional development

title: Senior Manager, Antibot Engineering
description:
**Company Description**

At NIQ Digital shelf, scraping isn’t just about collecting data, it’s about **outsmarting the obstacles** that stand in the way of visibility. Every day, we process **tens of billions of data points** from thousands of sources, both web and mobile, and transform them into actionable insights for the world’s top retailers and brands.

You'll join a team of **60+ scrapers**, engineers, analysts, and data lovers from across the globe. As part of our scraping and R&D team, you’ll have space to **experiment, push boundaries**, and bring bold ideas to life. You’ll collaborate closely with **Customer Success**, **Operations**, and **Data** to ensure we extract high-quality, actionable data — fast and at scale.

 **Job Description**

**The Role**

The Senior Manager, Antibot Engineering takes leadership responsibility for a defined part of the Antibot Engineering organization. Based in Spain and reporting to the Director of Antibot Engineering, this leader manages a distributed team located in Western Europe and Algeria. The geographic footprint describes where the team is located, not a regional mandate: the role contributes to the global Antibot Engineering mission and priorities.

This is a senior people-leadership role with three core accountabilities: building and developing a strong engineering team; prioritizing retailer work in line with business requirements; and driving an R&D roadmap that improves the effectiveness, durability, and scalability of Antibot capabilities. The leader works across Web Data Acquisition, Product, Engineering, Operations, and business stakeholders to turn demand into clear engineering choices and measurable outcomes.

**What You Will Do**

**Lead part of the global Antibot Engineering organization**

* Own the people, delivery, and technical outcomes of an assigned part of the global Antibot Engineering organization.
* Translate the Director of Antibot Engineering’s strategy into clear team objectives, priorities, roadmaps, and execution plans.
* Balance retailer unblocking and long-term R&D projects.
* Provide clear visibility into retailer priorities, R&D progress, capacity, dependencies, risks, and trade-offs.

**Drive retailer prioritization and engineering execution**

* Establish a transparent prioritization process that converts business requirements, customer impact, operational risk, and technical dependencies into an executable retailer backlog.
* Partner with business, product, delivery, and operations stakeholders to clarify demand, challenge assumptions, resolve priority conflicts, and communicate trade-offs.
* Ensure prioritized retailer unblocking work is planned, staffed, tracked, and delivered with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.
* Balance urgent retailer needs with platform development, solution durability, technical debt, and longer-term engineering capacity.

**Lead, develop, and retain the team**

* Lead, coach, and develop engineering managers, technical leads, and engineers across the distributed team in Western Europe and Algeria.
* Set clear expectations, strengthen accountability, and create an inclusive environment that supports learning, collaboration, and retention.
* Own team workforce and capability planning, including hiring, onboarding, succession, and development of critical Antibot expertise.
* Create effective operating rhythms for planning, reviews, risk management, and communication.

**Drive the Antibot R&D roadmap**

* Own and drive an R&D roadmap for the assigned Antibot scope, aligned with the technical direction set by the Director of Antibot Engineering.
* Identify research and engineering opportunities that improve capability, automation, scalability, maintainability, and resilience.
* Turn experiments and technical learning into clear investment recommendations, reusable solutions, and production adoption plans.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, web data acquisition, applied R&D, or a related technology field.
* 3+ years of people-management experience, including leadership of experienced engineers, technical leads, managers, or multiple teams.
* Demonstrated accountability for engineering delivery and production services in a complex, high-change environment.
* Experience with distributed systems, cloud platforms, automation, observability, incident management, and engineering quality practices.
* Strong organizational leadership, prioritization, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to lead across countries and cultures and to influence teams outside the direct reporting line.
* Professional fluency in English.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with web scraping, reverse engineering, or large-scale data collection.
* Experience leading geographically distributed engineering teams in Europe and/or North Africa.
* Knowledge of antibot solutions, CDN or WAF.
* Experience driving operating-model change, automation, platform adoption, or engineering transformation.

**Success Measures**

* A capable, engaged, and accountable engineering team with clear goals, development plans, and succession coverage.
* Retailer priorities that are traceable to business requirements and delivered with transparent trade-offs and predictable execution.
* An R&D roadmap that produces reusable improvements in Antibot capability, automation, durability, and scale.
* Clear ownership, metrics, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communication.
* Effective adoption of global platforms and reduction of avoidable regional duplication.

  
**Additional Information**

**Our Benefits**

* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning

title: Especialista en Integraciones Laborales
description:
DESCRIPCIóN

Desde ISPROX, buscamos un/a **Especialista en Integraciones Laborales.**

Formarás parte del Core Team de integraciones de un importante grupo de servicios profesionales consolidado con más de 60 años de trayectoria que, respaldado por un fondo americano, se encuentra en un momento clave de expansión.

Con un plan de crecimiento de unas 10-15 adquisiciones de despachos al año, tu misión será gestionar la transición, homogeneización y migración operativa del área laboral de las compañías adquiridas hacia la estructura central del grupo.

  

No es un rol de gestión de nóminas del día a día; es un puesto estratégico-operativo de consultoría interna enfocado en proyectos de absorción y despliegue tecnológico.

**Tus principales retos y funciones:**

* Mapeo y Migración de Datos: Coordinar y ejecutar el traspaso masivo de históricos, fichas de trabajadores, conceptos salariales y variables desde los sistemas de los despachos adquiridos hacia el entorno centralizado del grupo.
* Estandarización Tecnológica: Asegurar la correcta implantación y configuración del ecosistema A3 en las nuevas delegaciones, optimizando los flujos de trabajo e integrando herramientas de control horario o portales del empleado.
* Auditoría Laboral (Due Diligence Operativa): Analizar el estado de las plantillas absorbidas, convenios colectivos de origen, pactos de empresa y contingencias para asegurar el cumplimiento del Art. 44 del Estatuto de los Trabajadores (Subrogación).
* Soporte Operativo Crítico: Dar apoyo directo en la confección y validación de nóminas, seguros sociales (Sistema RED) y declaraciones durante los meses críticos de transición para garantizar impacto cero en los trabajadores.
* Gestión de Proyectos (PMO): Asegurar el cumplimiento de los deadlines de cada integración, reportando hitos y riesgos al Director de Integraciones.

**¿Qué pueden ofrecerte?**

* Incorporación a un grupo empresarial con más de 60 años en activo, en un momento clave de crecimiento, expansión y automatización.
* Contrato indefinido a jornada completa de 9h a 18h y viernes hasta las 15h con 1 día de teletrabajo a la semana.
* Retribución hasta 40.000€ brutos anuales, según perfil

REQUISITOS

**¿Qué buscamos en ti?**

* Experiencia: Mínimo 3-5 años en departamentos de Laboral Outsourcing, BPO Laboral en Big4/Tier 2 o asesorías de gran volumen, gestionando migraciones o integraciones de carteras.
* Dominio experto del ecosistema A3 (A3innuva / A3asesor). Valorable conocimiento en otras plataformas del mercado.
* Conocimientos técnicos: Sólida base en legislación laboral (subrogaciones, homogeneización de condiciones, cálculo de nóminas y finiquitos) y gestión de plataformas públicas (Sistema RED, Contrat@, Delta).
* Metodología: Familiaridad con gestión de proyectos y herramientas de seguimiento. Excel avanzado (tablas dinámicas, fórmulas de cruce de datos masivos). Muy valorable conocimientos de PMP y Agile.
* Soft Skills: Orientación a hitos y resultados, alta capacidad de adaptación al cambio, interlocución fluida y resiliencia.

title: Global Head of Social
description:
**About Revolut**

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 15,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

**About the role**

Marketing at Revolut is all about clarity, creativity, and commercial impact. Our Social Media team turns bold ideas into campaigns that connect with millions. We work across channels and teams to build a brand that earns attention and drives results, shaping how people see, understand, and engage with our products.

We're looking for a Global Head of Social to own the social media strategy for the company as well as lead community development.

You’ll plan and execute campaigns across our global social channels, boosting community management efforts across new and existing customers to drive customer acquisition, engagement, and brand awareness. You’ll also be responsible for devising the local channel playbook to launch in priority markets.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

**What you'll be doing**

* Devising and deploying the global social media strategy across central platforms, with accountability for connecting social activity to commercial outcomes
* Setting KPIs that go beyond industry standards and link directly to commercial impact
* Building and managing the editorial and content calendar whilst balancing business needs and cultural moments
* Developing the local strategy and relevant playbooks to deploy new channels in priority markets, including supporting hiring efforts in the market
* Managing the global Social Media team to govern asset quality for content calendars, ensuring all assets are high quality and adhere to brand guidelines with timely approvals
* Partnering with Growth, Communications, Product, and Marketing teams to inform and deliver GTMs and 360 integrated campaigns
* Leading and managing a high-performance creative culture across social media teams
* Managing stakeholders across senior leadership, gaining trust to support creative initiatives

**What you'll need**

* Experience in global social media, encompassing both operations and strategy, while remaining hands-on with campaign execution
* The ability to run a global strategy that's hyper-localised to support community management
* Gravitas and experience presenting to C-level executives on global social media strategies
* A proven track record of scaling social media followers across a variety of channels, with a focus on driving engagement and growth in competitive markets
* Expert-level proficiency in social media listening, tracking, and analytics tools to drive data-driven strategies and optimise content performance
* Experience leading and developing high-performing teams across multiple regions

**Nice to have**

* Experience working on 360 campaigns as part of an omni-channel marketing team

* Krakow: PLN18,000 - PLN22,200 base gross monthly\*
* Poland: PLN18,000 - PLN22,200 base gross monthly\*
* Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process
* Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience

title: Key Account Regional (Ciudad Real, Toledo, Guadalajara)
description:
**Life tastes better with ice cream**

With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.

We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.

What truly sets us apart is how we work.

We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.

We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.

**The role:**  
  
If you are a social person, with analytical abilities, a results-oriented focus, and a Win-Win mindset then this role is just for you!  
  
It's a great opportunity to develop and execute the customer-focused regional business strategy and plan. You will be responsible for the deliveries, as well as the profits and losses that occur in different categories, along with the implementation and optimization of the strategy within each category.  
  
You will work with the Channel Head to maximize business opportunities and sales in the area.  
  
**What you'll be responsible for:**

Business Strategy and Plan

* Develop the strategic business plan in their respective categories. In some accounts, you may create a joint business plan for the corresponding categories.
* Optimize collaboration and communication with managers for customer entry and channel marketing to generate the best business plan.
* Optimize administrative and logistical efficiencies with an impact on resources and investments from various areas of the company.
* Develop an optimal integrated promotion plan (including selling the plan to the consumer) and manage promotion investments. Customer P&L management.
* Deliver the agreed plan and monitor the success of the established counterparts in the agreement.

Negotiation

* Close deals with the customer through negotiation of commercial terms, financing, and the agreement of the strategy among all involved parties.
* Oversee customer investments in their category in a general sense.
* Monitor customer performance by tracking customer contribution and market share for key categories when available.
* Work together with CD Finance to define the best negotiation strategies.

Active Ambassador Role

* Highly active ambassador role with the customer.
* Develop a strong team spirit with other coordinators and account managers, seeking the best solution for the business, even if it is not aligned with your customer.

**We're looking for someone who:**

* Holds a degree in Business Administration, Economics, or a related field, with 2–3 years of experience managing accounts within the HORECA channel
* Has a good level of English
* Demonstrates strong interpersonal and social skills, combined with solid analytical and organizational capabilities
* Is energetic, results-driven, and brings a proactive mindset with leadership potential
* Adopts a win-win approach when negotiating with clients
* Thrives under pressure and is able to work effectively within tight deadlines
* Has strong influencing and persuasion skills

**What you'll get:**  
  
Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes

* Market-competitive pay and performance-related rewards
* Flexible ways of working
* Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work
* Time off to rest and recharge
* Ongoing learning and development opportunities
* 100% remote working model
* Daily allowances (meal expenses)
* Company car
* Private health insurance option, with Magnum covering 40% of the policy cost
* Pension plan
* Wellhub (gym & wellbeing platform) access
* And much more!

**Why join us?**

This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!

You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.

**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**

If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.

If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.

**Additional information**

The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

description:

Cadiz, ES

Inspired Education is the leading global group of premium schools, with a portfolio of 125 premium private schools spanning 6 continents which utilise proven educational practices from every corner of the globe, ensuring over 95,000 students receive a world-class learning experience from Kindergarten to Year 13.

In 28 countries, Inspired schools are individually developed and anchored in the vibrant cultures of their respective locations. They collectively form an international family of schools that nurtures each student's academic and personal development in a progressive, dynamic, and innovative learning environment.

By joining our award-winning team of over 14,000 employees, you can work in state-of-the-art facilities alongside industry-renowned educators and leaders in some of the world's most desirable locations. We invest heavily in our team members who enjoy industry-leading professional development, exceptional career opportunities, and mobility across our group.

**ROLE SUMMARY:**
-----------------

Sotogrande International School, part of the Inspired Education Group, is seeking to appoint an outstanding Vice Principal of Performing & Creative Arts to join our Senior Leadership Team from August 2027. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Drama specialist, senior educational leader and practising artist to lead the development of Performing and Creative Arts across the whole school, while launching and directing our new Elite Pathway in Performing Arts & Film for students aged 16–18.

  

Based at our new SIS Global Arts Centre, featuring a 400-seat professional theatre, dance and drama studios, music facilities and film editing suites, the successful candidate will play a key role in establishing Sotogrande International School as a leading destination for aspiring performers, artists and filmmakers.

  

In addition to this position, you may also be interested in our in-person Inspired Careers Event in London on Saturday 23rd January 2027. This school and over 30 other UK and international Inspired schools will be attending to connect with teachers seeking new roles starting from August 2027. For more information and to register, please click here: https://jobs.inspirededu.com/job-invite/10814/

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**
-------------------------

* Provide strategic leadership for Drama, Music, Dance, Film & Media and Visual Arts across the whole school.
* Lead the development and implementation of a coherent arts curriculum across the IB and UK pathways.
* Design, launch and lead the new Elite Pathway in Performing Arts & Film for 2027/28, including specialist training, external qualifications and industry partnerships.
* Oversee teaching standards, curriculum development, assessment and student outcomes across the arts departments.
* Personally teach Drama on a reduced timetable, modelling outstanding teaching and professional artistic practice.
* Lead an ambitious programme of productions, performances, concerts, exhibitions, screenings and creative events.
* Build partnerships with drama schools, conservatoires, universities, theatres and creative industry organisations.
* Recruit, lead and develop teaching staff, specialist tutors, visiting practitioners and technical teams.
* Manage departmental budgets and oversee the strategic use of the SIS Global Arts Centre.

**THE IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:**
----------------------------------

* A degree in Drama, Theatre, Performing Arts or a closely related subject.
* A recognised teaching qualification and QTS or equivalent.
* Extensive experience teaching Drama within the IB and UK curriculum, ideally MYP, DP Theatre and A Level.
* Proven senior leadership experience in Performing Arts or Drama.
* A strong track record of academic results, directing productions and preparing students for LAMDA, Trinity and drama school auditions.
* Professional experience in theatre, film, television or the wider performing arts, with established industry contacts.
* A practising artist with recent experience as a performer, director, writer or creative practitioner.
* Excellent leadership, communication and organisational skills, with the ability to inspire students and colleagues.
* Fluent English, both written and spoken. Previous international school experience and Spanish language skills would be an advantage.
* Visa sponsorship can be arranged for the right candidate.

**SAFEGUARDING STATEMENT:**
---------------------------

Inspired Education Group is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment. Safer recruitment practices and pre-employment background checks will be undertaken before any appointment is confirmed.

Visit our careers site for more information; https://jobs.inspirededu.com

title: Continous Improvement Specialist
description:
**Position Summary**

  

The Supply Chain Continuous Improvement Process Analyst drives continuous improvement across supply chain international operations, identifying inefficiencies and leading small-to-medium improvement projects across the APAC, EMEA, and LATAM regions. This role applies Lean methodologies to reduce waste, cost, and lead times, while working closely with regional teams that operate across different time zones, languages, and business cultures. It works to harmonize processes across regions, ensuring consistent standards and ways of working while respecting local operational realities.

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

  

Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  

* Work with regional teams across planning, and logistics (transport and warehousing) in APAC, EMEA, and LATAM to identify process improvement opportunities, and align with the Supply Chain Director to prioritize and lead small-scale improvement projects.

* Apply Lean tools (5S, Value Stream Mapping, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis, PDCA) to diagnose inefficiencies and design solutions adapted to regional constraints.

* Map current-state processes and design future-state workflows with measurable KPIs (cost, lead time, quality, service level, etc.), consistent across regions but flexible to local realities.

* Facilitate Kaizen events and improvement workshops with cross-functional, cross-regional, and often virtual teams.

* Track and report project progress, savings, and impact to global and regional management.

* Support standardization of best practices and documentation (processes, work instructions, etc.) while allowing for necessary regional adaptations.

* Coach and train regional team members on Lean principles and a continuous-improvement mindset, considering cultural and language differences.

* Collaborate with other departments’ teams (IT, Sales, Finance, etc.) to identify opportunities.

* Monitor post-implementation results across regions to ensure sustained improvements (control phase).

* Manage stakeholder communication across multiple time zones, adjusting meeting schedules and communication style as needed.
  

Note: *The responsibilities listed above are not exhaustive and may be subject to updates or periodic review.*

  

**Education & Experience**

  

**Educational Requirements & Skills:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or related field.

* Solid knowledge of Lean/Continuous Improvement methodologies

* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt Certification (or working toward it) is a plus.

* Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with Excel, data analysis tools, and process mapping software (Visio, Bizagi, etc.).

* Good project management skills — able to plan, execute, and close small projects independently, often remotely.

* Strong cross-cultural communication and facilitation skills; comfortable working with stakeholders across APAC, EMEA, and LATAM.

* Proactive, hands-on, and detail-oriented, with a structured problem-solving approach
  

**Professional Experience**

  

More specifically, we are looking for the following attributes and competencies:

  

* 5+ years of experience in supply chain, operations, or process improvement roles.

* Prior experience working in or with international/multi-regional teams is a strong plus.

* Proven experience leading or supporting small improvement projects.

* Experience with ERP systems (SAP and Sage) used across multiple regional entities, is a plus, but not required.

* Exposure to digital transformation / automation projects in supply chain, is a plus, but not required.

* Languages: Candidates must be fluent in both English and Spanish. Additional languages relevant to APAC or EMEA operations (e.g., Mandarin, German, French) are a plus but not required.
  

**Pay and Benefits**

  

The estimated base pay for this position is EUR 36.000 annually.

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

  

Vantage is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or any other protected category.

  

**About Vantage**

  

Vantage provides natural solutions to our customers’ technical performance and marketing needs through a unique combination of chemistry, application expertise and service. Underpinned by our broad portfolio of formulations, ingredients and actives that are built on a backbone of sustainable oils, fats and their derivatives, Vantage targets selected markets and applications including personal care, food, surface treatment, agriculture, pharma, and consumer and industrial performance. Vantage is headquartered in Deerfield, IL., operates in 11 countries worldwide and employs more than 1,000 talented professionals focused on delivering exceptional customer experiences with every interaction.

  

We are a dynamic people-centered organization where you’ll be part of a collaborative global team. Embracing our cultural diversity, we learn from each other to constantly improve, adapt and iterate. We value the voices and talents of our colleagues, empowering them to drive their unique ideas to completion. We’re convinced that exceptionally motivated employees produce outstanding results and we celebrate them by fostering a culture of recognition, development, learning, excellence and shared achievement. Most importantly, we know you’re going to like it here. For more information visit: vantagegrp.com or LinkedIn/vantage.

title: CAPEX & INVESTMENT TECHNICAL OF MANAGER
description:
Would you like to join an international team working to improve the future of healthcare? Do you want to enhance the lives of millions of people? Grifols is a global healthcare company that since 1909 has been working to improve the health and well-being of people around the world. We are leaders in plasma-derived medicines and transfusion medicine and develop, produce and market innovative medicines, solutions and services in more than 110 countries and regions.

**We believe that diversity adds value to our business, our teams, and our culture. We are committed to equal employment opportunity fostering an inclusive environment where diversity makes us be outstanding.**

Help us lead one of the world’s largest pharmaceutical companies. We are a world leader in plasma-derived medicines with a presence in more than 100 countries, and a growing global team of over 20.000 people. That’s why we need a **CAPEX & INVESTMENT TECHNICAL OF MANAGER** like you.

Responsible for establishing, governing, and executing the corporate Capital Expenditure framework across all global operations. This role oversees the entire investment lifecycle—from 5-year Long-Range Planning (LRP) and annual budgeting to monthly execution monitoring, post-investment benefit reviews, and asset capitalization. Acting as a strategic bridge between Executive Management, Corporate Finance, Engineering (GE), and Local Manufacturing Plants, this position ensures optimal capital allocation, strict financial control, and process excellence across all capital investment categories.

**What are your responsibilities:**

**Corporate Governance & Procedure Implementation**

1. Corporate Procedure Definition & Rollout: Design, update, and enforce the corporate procedure for monitoring major capital investments across all business units.

2. Stage-Gate Governance: Enforce mandatory Stage-Gate reviews (Gates 1 to 4) for major projects, ensuring technical and financial maturity before approving budget releases or Phase transitions.

3. Delegation of Authority (DOA) Enforcement: Administer the corporate approval matrix for investment authorization, supplements (AFE Overrun Requests), and contingency releases.

**Long-Range Planning (LRP) & Annual Budget Preparation**

1. Corporate 5-Year LRP Preparation: Lead the annual multi-year investment planning process (LRP), prioritizing candidate projects aligned with corporate strategic objectives and cash flow capabilities

2. Annual CAPEX Budgeting: Consolidate and build the annual global CAPEX budget, integrating inputs from Global Engineering, site-level operational teams, and executive stakeholders.

3. Capital Allocation & Cash Flow Alignment: Coordinate with Treasury and Corporate FP&A to align monthly cash-out trajectories with corporate liquidity limits.

**Monthly CAPEX Monitoring & Comprehensive Reporting as a complement of the financial report**

1. Global CAPEX Tracking from technical approach: Execute detailed monthly monitoring across all investment streams (Grifols Engineering, Local CAPEX, Master Projects)

2. Estimate at Completion (EAC) variances and track technical progress, identifying critical path delays or cost overruns.

3. Executive technical Dashboards & Reporting: Prepare monthly reporting packages and executive dashboards for the Investment Committee and Board of Directors.

**Global CAPEX Taxonomy & Strategic Categorization**

1. Capital Classification & Reclassification: Review, audit, and reclassify (if necessary) all global investment proposals into strategic buckets:

o Growth / Expansion: Revenue-generating or capacity expansion projects.

o Sustaining / Maintenance: Asset replacement, operational continuity, and

reliability.

o Compliance & Regulatory: EHS, quality, and regulatory mandatory standards. o Efficiency & Productivity: Cost reduction, automation, and operational improvement projects.

**Post-Investment Analysis & Asset Capitalization**

1. Post-Implementation Reviews (PIR): Conduct formal post-investment audits 12 to 24 months after commissioning to verify the delivery of Business Case promises (ROI, ramp-up speed, capacity, and OPEX savings).

2. Asset Capitalization Coordination: Partner with Corporate Accounting to ensure timely project closure and accurate asset capitalization (transfer from Construction in Progress - CIP to Fixed Assets), preventing delays in depreciation schedules.

3. CAPEX vs. OPEX Boundary Compliance: Enforce strict accounting rules on plant direct purchases to prevent misclassification of operational expenses as capital investments.

**Performance Metrics (KPIs) & Process Excellence**

1. KPI Framework Development & Execution: Establish, track, and report critical Key Performance Indicators for the CAPEX Office: o Capital Deployment Cycle Time (Approval to PO placement). o Budget Accuracy Ratio by Site/Division. o Project Overrun & Supplement Rate (%). o Post-Investment Benefits Realization Index

2. Continuous Improvement & Training: Train Plant Directors, Controllers, and Project Leaders on corporate CAPEX procedures, financial models, and business case justification.

**Who you are**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, education, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions).

**Required:**

  

* Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Engineering or relative field.
* 5+ years of experience
* Proven track record in technical project analysis and deep operational process knowledge.
* Desirable Engineer with formal training in Finance (MBA or equivalent), or a Finance degree with experience on technical & operational analysis
* Cross-Functional Leadership
* Stakeholder Management & Diplomacy
* Conflict Resolution & Consensus Building
* Executive Communication & Influence
* Strategic Vision & Strategic Alignment
* Adaptability & Resilience
* Change Management
* Team Collaboration & Matrix Management
* Rigorous Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving
* Accountability & Results Orientation

**What we offer**

It is a brilliant opportunity for you, Grifols is fully aware that its employees are one of its major assets. We are committed to maintaining an atmosphere that encourages all our employees to develop their professional careers in an excellent working environment.

Information about Grifols is available at www.grifols.com. If you are interested in joining our company and you have what it takes for such an exciting position, then don’t hesitate to apply!

We look forward to receiving your application!

We believe in diverse talent and want to remove any barriers that may hinder your participation. If you require any adjustments in our selection process, please do not hesitate to inform us when applying. We are here to help.

title: Conversion Oriented Copywriter
description:
En Natulim buscamos un/a **Creative Strategist – Paid Ads** que nos ayude a llevar nuestras creatividades publicitarias al siguiente nivel.

Buscamos una persona que combine **creatividad, storytelling y mentalidad de performance**: alguien capaz de detectar qué hace que un anuncio funcione, convertir insights en conceptos creativos y aterrizarlos en vídeos, hooks y guiones que generen resultados.

No buscamos un perfil puramente conceptual ni un/a editor/a de vídeo. Queremos a alguien que **piense la creatividad de principio a fin**, desde el insight y el concepto hasta la estructura del anuncio y su ejecución, trabajando junto al equipo de contenido, edición y performance.

### **Qué harás**

* Desarrollar **conceptos creativos y ángulos de comunicación** para campañas de paid ads.
* Crear y testar diferentes **hooks, narrativas, claims y estructuras de vídeo** para mejorar el rendimiento de los anuncios.
* Escribir **guiones y briefs creativos** claros para producción y edición.
* Analizar anuncios propios y de competidores para identificar oportunidades y nuevos enfoques.
* Analizar resultados de las creatividades y entender qué elementos están funcionando: **hook, retención, engagement, CTR, conversión, etc.**
* Transformar aprendizajes de performance en nuevas ideas y ciclos de test.
* Trabajar estrechamente con los equipos de **Performance, Content y Editing** para producir y escalar las mejores creatividades.
* Adaptar tendencias, formatos y códigos de redes sociales al universo de Natulim.
* Participar en la creación de contenido tanto **short-form como long-form**, siempre con foco en su aplicación a paid media.
* Mantener un sistema continuo de **testing e iteración creativa**.

### **Qué buscamos**

* **2+ años de experiencia** creando contenido creativo en vídeo para redes sociales y/o paid media.
* Experiencia real desarrollando **anuncios en vídeo para plataformas como Meta, Instagram, TikTok o YouTube**.
* Experiencia escribiendo **guiones, hooks y conceptos creativos**.
* Haber editado vídeo o tener suficiente conocimiento de edición para entender cómo llevar una idea a ejecución.
* Entender las estructuras que hacen que un vídeo funcione: **hooks, retención, ritmo, storytelling y CTA**.
* Experiencia trabajando con marcas de **e-commerce, belleza, FMCG o consumo**.
* Capacidad para interpretar métricas de performance y convertir datos en aprendizajes creativos.
* Buen criterio creativo y capacidad para convertir ideas en piezas concretas y ejecutables.
* Perfil autónomo, proactivo, curioso y muy conectado con tendencias y formatos actuales.
* **Permiso de trabajo en España.**

### **¿Qué ofrecemos?**

* **Acceso y formación en herramientas de IA**, trabajando con tecnología puntera como Claude.
* **Contrato indefinido**, estabilidad laboral y oportunidades reales de crecimiento.
* **Jornada completa de lunes a viernes**, con flexibilidad de entrada y salida.
* **Formación interna y externa** para impulsar tu aprendizaje continuo.
* **Retribución flexible** adaptada a tus necesidades (seguro médico, restaurante, transporte y guardería).
* **Hasta un 50% de descuento en productos Natulim.**
* **Días de adaptación escolar**, para acompañar a hijos menores de 3 años cuando lo necesites.
* **Un equipo joven, dinámico y con muy buen ambiente**, donde las personas y las ideas cuentan.  
    
  Te esperamos!

title: Marketing Technology Engineer
description:
#### **Who We Are**

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients' businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

**Working in MarTech with WPP Enterprise Solutions**

WPP Enterprise Solutions is a full-service digital agency helping ambitious brands deliver connected, personalised experiences across digital channels. Our expertise spans Marketing, Commerce, CRM, PXM and CX, enabling us to deliver end-to-end solutions with measurable impact.

Our clients include Bayer, MSD, Dyson, Johnson & Johnson, RTL, Nestlé, Tommy Hilfiger, Calvin Klein and other global brands. Our teams are based in Amsterdam, Barcelona, London, Poland and India, with access to the wider WPP network worldwide.

**The Opportunity**

You'll help design and build MarTech solutions across Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud and the wider Salesforce platform, working collaboratively across the wider team. Depending on the client, you may work across platforms such as Braze, Klaviyo, Bloomreach and Adobe, together with data and cloud technologies including Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Tealium, Segment, AWS, Azure and GCP.

**What You'll Do**

* **Design** **MarTech** **solutions:** Shape data models, integrations and technical designs that connect marketing platforms with CRM, CDP, data and cloud services.
* **Build and integrate:** Develop reliable production solutions using APIs, SQL, platform languages and general-purpose code, including queries and automation logic that support segmentation and journeys at scale.
* **Work with customer data:** Build segmentation, identity, ingestion and activation solutions, including automated, multi-step customer journeys connected to live data sources, across marketing platforms, CDPs and data warehouses.
* **Deliver maintainable solutions:** Build, test, deploy and support production code, applying appropriate version control, peer review, monitoring and recovery practices, and taking ownership of diagnosing production issues.

title: Digital Operations Team Lead - Music Rights & Royalties
description:
What you will be doing

As an Operations Team Lead, you will play a central role in guiding and empowering the Digital Operations team to deliver on its objectives. Reporting to the Head of Digital Operations and acting as their deputy, you will lead the team’s day-to-day work and oversee execution across core DSP processing and reporting pipelines, ensuring high-quality data exchange, timely royalty allocations, and strict compliance with client Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Your contributions will directly shape how the team runs and how we deliver DSP Processing and Reporting for our clients , making you an integral part of our team.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Execute the workflows and priorities set with the Head of Digital Operations, collaborating with Business Line, Engineering, and the wider Operations team, including operational support and communication with all of our DSP Processing and Reporting clients.
* Act as deputy to the Head of Digital Operations, covering for them when needed and making operational decisions on behalf of the team. Serve as the primary escalation point for the Operations Specialist team, triaging complex queries related to catalog ingest, matching exceptions, and output generation.
* Manage agreed business priorities, task allocations, and daily operational workflows for the Digital Operations Specialist team.
* Coordinate end-to-end DSP processing cycles across major platforms (including YouTube, Spotify, Amazon, and SoundCloud).
* Oversee the organization and maintenance of strict delivery schedules.
* Mentor and train team members, fostering a collaborative, supportive, and continuous learning environment.
* Manage pre-distribution calculations, conflict resolution lifecycles, and claiming output generation

### **Collaboration and Team Dynamics**

You will work closely with the Head of Digital Operations to plan priorities, track team performance, and continuously improve how we operate. You will also collaborate with Business Line, Engineering, Product, and Partnership teams to optimize system reliability and operational scale. These collaborations are pivotal for achieving our organizational goals and ensuring effective communication and alignment across different areas of the company.

 **Requirements**

All about you

* Preferably 5+ years of experience in Music Industry Operations.
* Experience in managing a team or related roles is preferred but not mandatory.
* Demonstrate understanding of music copyrights principles, practices, and relevant regulations.
* Deep familiarity with music metadata standards, Common Works Registration (CWR), DDEX Digital Sales Reports (DSRs), etc.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to articulate technical and operational requirements clearly across diverse global teams.
* Ability to effectively communicate with team members, stakeholders, and external partners.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities effectively.
* Demonstrate strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to analyze large volumes of usage data, diagnose root causes of operational discrepancies, and design efficient process solutions.
* Proficiency working with complex data platforms (YouTube CMS/Content ID), Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets, SQL querying, and SFTP data exchange protocol.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion.
* Proactive attitude with a willingness to learn and take initiative.
* Demonstrate adaptability and openness to feedback and learning opportunities.
* Collaborative team player with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Outstanding organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and high-stakes client deadlines.
* Fluency in English. Proficiency in Spanish and Catalan is highly appreciated, but not mandatory.
* The role is located in Barcelona. Local candidates are preferred, but remote work arrangements may be considered.

### **Expectations of the role**

Within 30 Days:

During the first month, your primary focus will be on familiarizing yourself with essential aspects of the role and supporting foundational tasks.

* Familiarize yourself thoroughly with BMAT’s core operating platforms and DSP processing lifecycle standards.
* Align with the Head of Digital Operations on team priorities, ways of working, and responsibilities.
* Establish working relationships with direct reports and key cross-functional partners across Engineering, Product, and Partnerships.
* Assume day-to-day oversight of operational queues and SLA tracking for core processing clients

Within 60 Days:

By the second month, you'll be expected to take on more complex responsibilities and actively contribute to team and strategic initiatives.

* Autonomously manage daily task distribution, priority queues, and technical escalations for the Digital Operations team.
* Lead high-priority client distribution cycles, ensuring 100% on-time delivery of claim files, pre-distribution reports, and DIF files.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to implement automated matching QA rules and streamline conflict resolution tracking.
* Facilitate the transition of routine client invoicing workflows from Partnerships to Operations in collaboration with Finance.

Within 90 Days:

At the end of the probationary period, you'll be expected to autonomously manage tasks, contribute to strategic planning, and take on leadership roles as appropriate.

* Autonomously manage team operations, performance evaluations, continuous training, and skill development.
* Drive measurable improvements in operational throughput, team capacity, and SLA compliance across all Tier 1 and Tier 2 DSP accounts.
* Represent Digital Operations in cross-departmental readiness reviews and platform feature validations.

  
**Benefits**  

### **You Can Enjoy**

* Flexible working hours and location
* Flat hierarchy
* You can make the role your own and run your own development
* Online language classes to improve your Spanish or English
* Online and onsite courses and music industry workshops run by inhouse experts
* We’ll provide you with all equipment needed for you to be comfortable
* Unlimited time off because we believe that you know best when you need to rest.
Barcelona HQ office available to you, kitted out with a rehearsal room https://www.bmat.com/bmat-house/  

  

### **Who the FAQ are BMAT**

BMAT started in 2005 when a group of engineers with a passion for music decided to spin-off from an audio research lab in Barcelona. We’re now over 250 people, spread across Barcelona, Buenos Aires, Lima, Rio de Janeiro, London, Paris, New Jersey, Oslo, LA, Singapore, Tokyo, Manila, Bangkok and Lagos.

We’re a team of pretty decent people who enjoy working with each other. We’re open-minded and well-traveled, coming from all parts of the world. We’ve got rappers, producers, cello players, DJs, and songwriters. The passion for music and the excitement for innovative technology have proven to make a good combination.

BMAT has grown as a company of companies. Within BMAT there are a number of products and services that developed semi autonomously for different players – Digital Service Providers, Publishers and Collective Management Organisations.

*Diverse perspectives drive innovation, and innovation is kind of our thing. Our open-minded and flexible culture organically fosters this diversity. We've learnt that we thrive on learning from each other, so we don't just welcome but actively hire a range of open-minded people from all walks of life. Our team is made up of people with different backgrounds, perspectives, orientations, abilities, musical tastes, dress sense and time-zones - but we all have one common goal: Making the music world a better place. With equal opportunities for everyone, BMAT is a pretty nice place to work.*

title: Demand Partnership Manager
description:

EXTE is a leading AdTech platform, specializing in video, content, and performance. Our mission is to design comprehensive advertising solutions based on creativity and technology to ensure brand value within the advertising ecosystem and relevance for agencies, media, and users; offering advertisers the right audience in a safe and brand privacy-respecting environment.

We want to be the trusted partner of brands, amplifying their stories across media through enriching advertising experiences that challenge convention and raise industry standards.

The Role

This is a full remote role that could be located anywhere.

As a Demand Partnerships Manager at EXTE, you will play a key role in expanding our global demand ecosystem and unlocking new revenue opportunities. Your mission will be to identify, attract and establish strategic partnerships with programmatic platforms, independent ad networks, DSPs and other demand sources worldwide, with a particular focus on small and mid-sized players.

You will own the full partnership development process, from identifying potential buyers and opening new business opportunities to negotiating agreements, coordinating integrations and driving partner activation. Working closely with our commercial, technical and operations teams, you will help diversify our demand sources, maximize traffic monetization and accelerate EXTEs growth across international markets.

1. Drive global demand acquisition: Proactively identify, research and approach new demand partners worldwide, with a particular focus on independent, mid-sized and emerging AdTech platforms, DSPs, ad networks, exchanges and other potential buyers of EXTEs advertising inventory.

5. Coordinate partner integrations: Work closely with technical, product and operations teams to facilitate new partner integrations, troubleshoot onboarding challenges and accelerate time-to-market.

6. Drive partner activation and revenue growth: Ensure newly signed partners become active revenue contributors. Identify opportunities to increase traffic allocation, demand volume and monetization across the partner portfolio.

7. Optimize partnership performance: Monitor partner-level KPIs, including revenue, eCPM, fill rate, bid rate, win rate, traffic quality and profitability. Identify underperforming partnerships and implement strategies to improve results.

8. Develop a global industry network: Represent EXTE at international conferences, industry events and business meetings, continuously identifying new partnership opportunities and strengthening the company position within the programmatic ecosystem.

title: Content Marketer (SEO & AI Search)
description:
**Join Reach as our Content Marketer (focused on SEO & AI Search)!**
You'll define what content engineering at the highest level looks like, then execute it for some of the best companies in the world. You'll shape how our proprietary platform automates content workflows, deciding what scales with humans and what scales with software. And as we grow, you'll build a team to scale production without sacrificing quality.
  
  
This is not a traditional content manager role. You'll combine deep SEO knowledge, advanced AI-powered production workflows, visual design skills, and LinkedIn content expertise to produce and scale high-quality content across our entire customer portfolio and for Reach itself.
  
  
**About Reach**
At Reach we're building the operating system to help companies monitor and control their visibility in AI search. We built a proprietary platform that combines our software, custom AI agents, and forward-deployed experts from the top 1% in organic growth (SEO & AEO), to help companies show up when buyers are researching and comparing solutions on Google and inside AI search engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity, and turn that visibility into pipeline and revenue.
  
  
We reached $1.4M ARR in 14 months, basically bootstrapped, and we're scaling to $10M ARR by the end of 2027. We've been doing this for companies like ColdIQ ($7M ARR, #1 Clay worldwide sales agency), Indie Campers ($140M+ ARR), Carro, Fidelidade, Fraudio, Noxus and others.
  
  
A few recent results:
  
  

* Grew Indie Campers' revenue attributed to AI search by +1,318.62% YoY (14x) and organic search revenue by +7.85% YoY across 2025, delivered during a full website migration. Read the case study.
* Helped ColdIQ influence $506K in signed contract value from organic and AI search in ~4 months, making SEO and AI search their #1 traffic source with organic traffic up 7.3x. Read the case study.
* Took Carro from a 0% to 34.58% AI citation rate (4.5x the nearest competitor) and the #3 most-cited domain in their category, now consistently closing 7-figure deals sourced from AI search. Read the case study.

You can see more of the results we drive for our customers here.
  
  
We're turning services into software to disrupt the $100B+ SEO/AI Search market, which will get drastically bigger as search behavior shifts to AI and ad budgets follow.
  
  
"The global SEO and AEO services market will grow to $171 billion by 2030 from $81.4 billion last year", Wall Street Journal
  
  
**The team**
We're a team of founders, AI engineers, and SEO & AEO specialists passionate about creating a category defining company that moves fast and has fun doing it.
  
  
Here's a look at what life on the team is like. This is our latest company retreat:
  
  
Our founders have a proven track record of building and scaling fast growing tech companies. Jose Velez (CEO) was the solo founder & CEO of Rely.io, an internal developer portal used by top engineering orgs like ESPN Bet and Feedzai, and launched AI products that reached #1 Product of the Day and #1 AI Product of the month on Product Hunt. He raised $3.6M from top-tier firms like J12 Ventures, Shilling Capital Partners, Techstars NYC, and TheVentureCity, as well as from notable angels.
  
  
Bernardo Ferreira (founding AI search strategist) led the strategy behind more than
**250M organic visits**
and
**€100M in revenue attributed to SEO**
at Worten (think Iberian Amazon) in 2024.
  
  
**Location**
For this role, we're open to it being remote, mainly because we're growing fast and we can't afford to limit ourselves. That said, we care deeply about working in person.
  
  
If you can work alongside us from our Lisbon hub, that's our preference:
  
  
→ Lisbon: with the founding team day-to-day, plus regular travel to the US.
  
  
If you can move to Lisbon, we'll support relocation including visa sponsorship where possible.
  
  
Either way, expect to travel a lot.
  
  
**The Role**
We're looking for a builder-leader: someone who sets a new standard for what SEO content production looks like in the AI era, and then builds the systems and team to scale it.
  
  
You will own three things:
  
  

* Define What Content Engineering at the Highest Level Looks Like, and Execute It

This is not about pasting a keyword into ChatGPT and editing the output. You'll build the workflows, set the bar, and ship content for some of the best companies in the world.
  
  

* Build and use advanced AI content pipelines. Use Claude Code, custom agents, programmatic approaches, and whatever tools give you leverage to produce content at 5-10x the pace of a traditional content team, with higher quality. Show us your setup. If you can't walk us through your AI workflow and impress us with how you use it for research, drafting, editing, analysis, and optimization, you won't pass the interview.
* Ship content that drives revenue, not just rankings. Blog posts, comparison pages, use case pages, landing pages, how-to guides, community responses for Reddit, Quora, and G2. Every piece of content is optimized for both search engines and AI models, on-brand, accurate, and genuinely useful for the target buyer.
* Create visual content that gets saved and shared. LinkedIn infographics, data visualizations, carousels, comparison graphics, process diagrams. You don't just write. You design. You need a strong eye and the ability to produce polished visual content quickly using tools like Figma, Canva, or equivalent.
* Write LinkedIn content that generates pipeline. Posts for Jose's personal brand, Reach's company page, and customer accounts. You understand hooks, storytelling, visual formats, and what drives B2B engagement on LinkedIn.
* Set the quality bar. Excellent writer who can adapt voice and tone across different brands and industries. Deep on-page SEO knowledge: keyword placement, heading structure, internal linking, meta tags, schema markup, content structure. Every piece you ship is the reference standard for what "great" looks like.
* Improve our platform and the content system

Your expertise doesn't just serve customers. It becomes the product.
  
  

* Be the power user who shapes the AI content tools. You'll use our AI agents daily for content production. Your feedback on what works, what's slow, and what's missing directly influences the product roadmap.
* Identify what scales with humans vs. what scales with software. Some content requires editorial judgment, deep brand knowledge, and creative thinking. Some content can be templated, automated, or generated programmatically. You'll help us draw that line correctly, and push it further every month.
* Build workflows that scale. Create templates, processes, and automations that let you produce 15-20 pieces of optimized content per month across multiple customer accounts without dropping quality. Document everything so it's transferable.
* Close the loop with Strategy and Engineering. Work with our Growth Strategists to translate content briefs and action plans into finished, published content. Feed patterns back to Engineering: what should the agents handle, what needs human attention, and where the gaps are.
* Push the boundaries of programmatic content. If there's a way to generate structured, high-quality pages at scale using data and templates, find it. If a content type can be partially automated, build the workflow. Always with quality as the non-negotiable.
* Build and Lead a Team of World-Class Content Engineers

As we scale, you'll grow from individual contributor to team leader.
  
  

* Recruit and develop content talent. Hire people who combine writing ability, SEO depth, AI tooling mastery, and speed. Build a team that's genuinely better than any agency's content team.
* Hands-on leadership. Jump into content production, quality reviews, and customer accounts. Model excellence through action, not just direction.
* Build scalable systems. Create onboarding, training, and quality assurance processes that let new team members ramp fast and produce at your standard. Maintain customer knowledge bases that power personalized content generation.
* Manage multi-customer production. Coordinate content production across a portfolio of customers with different brands, voices, industries, and priorities. Ensure nothing slips.
* Define the craft. "Content engineer" is a new role. You'll define what it means, what the career path looks like, and how the best content engineers in the world work.

**Signs you’re a great fit…**

* You have 3+ years of experience producing SEO content for B2B/SaaS companies, with proven ranking and traffic results.
* You're an excellent writer who can adapt voice and tone across different brands and industries.
* You have an advanced AI workflow that goes far beyond "use ChatGPT to draft." You use Claude Code, custom agents, programmatic approaches, or similar tools, and you can show us a setup that's genuinely impressive.
* You understand on-page SEO deeply: keyword placement, heading structure, internal linking, meta tags, schema markup, and content structure.
* You can work with data and analytics: GSC, GA4, Ahrefs/Semrush, and use them to prioritize what content to create or optimize.
* You have a strong design eye and can create infographics, LinkedIn visuals, and web pages that look polished and professional.
* You understand what works on LinkedIn: hooks, storytelling, visual formats, and engagement patterns.
* You're fast, organized, and can manage content production across multiple customers simultaneously without dropping quality.
* You use AI tools extensively and are obsessive about improving your setup.

**Bonus points:**

* Experience with programmatic SEO or templated content at scale
* Proficiency in Figma, Framer, Webflow, or similar design/web tools
* Experience writing content that targets AI search visibility (structured for LLM consumption)
* Technical comfort with Markdown, HTML, CSS, or light scripting
* A portfolio of LinkedIn infographics or visual content you've created
* Experience at a content-led agency or a startup where you owned the full content pipeline
* You've built content processes or playbooks that scaled a team's output
* Our job titles may encompass various career levels, and the actual base pay for this position will be determined based on multiple factors including training, transferable skills, work experience, business requirements, and market conditions. Additionally, this role is eligible for equity and comprehensive benefits.

**LOCATION:** Barcelona, Spain

**REPORTING TO:** Strategy Director

Working in direct partnership with a leading European pet care client (part of a major international food group), the Senior Planner / Strategist will play a pivotal role in shaping the strategic direction for four leading pet care brands.

Embedded within our dedicated on-site agency hub in Barcelona, you will collaborate closely with the client's Global Brand Teams on high-impact global briefs. Your focus will be upstream and conceptual: uncovering transformative consumer and cultural insights, authoring inspirational creative briefs, defining brand and communication strategies, and building comprehensive global master toolkits.

This is an exceptional opportunity for an ambitious, culturally attuned, and insight-driven strategist to establish foundational strategic frameworks, elevate creative ambition, and influence the global trajectory of major pet care brands.

### **WHAT IS REQUIRED**

**Global Brand & Communication Strategy**

* Partner directly with the client's Global Marketing Leads and Brand Managers to define overarching brand, communication, and campaign strategies across cat and dog portfolios.
* Architect robust Global Master Toolkits, guidelines, and campaign architectures designed for global consistency and seamless future adaptation across regional markets.
* Interrogate client challenges to uncover the real commercial and cultural problems strategy needs to solve, converting complex business goals into clear, actionable creative propositions.

**Audience Insight & Cultural Intelligence**

* Dig deep into pet owner (pet parent) behaviours, motivations, and cultural trends using qualitative discovery, social listening tools, and audience data platforms (e.g., GWI, category research).
* Translate data and category trends into rich, inspiring human insights that ignite breakthrough creative ideas.
* Help clients stay at the forefront of modern marketing, championing audience-first and culturally resonant thinking across all touchpoints.

**Creative Partnership & Briefing**

**Client Partnership & Ways of Working**

* Establish strong, consultative relationships with client brand teams, becoming a trusted advisor on brand positioning, consumer journeys, and creative effectiveness.
