**Location:** Madrid, M, ES

As Digital Workplace Operations Director, you will be accountable for the global delivery, performance and evolution of Swiss Re's employee workplace technology operations. Your scope spans Workplace Service Management, remote second-level support, onsite Field Services across Swiss Re locations, workplace hardware lifecycle services, and meeting room and multimedia technology support. You will lead a geographically distributed organization and govern the outcomes delivered by internal teams and external service partners.

This is a senior enterprise leadership role with end-to-end accountability for service reliability, employee experience, operational risk, service economics and transformation. You will set a consistent global operating model, connect workplace products and engineering with day-to-day delivery, and ensure employees experience one integrated service regardless of location, channel or provider.

You will drive the shift from reactive support to proactive, data-led operations through automation, self-service, knowledge management and AI-enabled support. Success requires a leader who has already managed comparable global operations, developed strong leadership teams and taken executive decisions during business-critical incidents and complex change.

**Key Responsibilities:**

You will have global leadership accountability for Workplace Operations, its people, service outcomes, delivery partners and continual improvement.

**Digital Employee Experience, Operational Intelligence and Product Improvement**

* You will establish a customer-centric, data-driven approach to Digital Workplace Operations, ensuring that operational insights and employee experience continuously inform product and engineering priorities.
* You will bring together service performance data, incident and problem trends, digital employee experience telemetry and direct employee feedback to identify systemic issues, recurring friction and opportunities for improvement.
* Working closely with Product and Engineering leaders, you will establish a structured feedback loop that translates these insights into actionable engineering priorities, addressing underlying product, platform and integration weaknesses rather than relying on operational workarounds or repeated support interventions.
* You will ensure that improvements are measured against tangible outcomes, including reduced incident recurrence, lower support demand, improved employee productivity and experience, and sustainable reductions in operational cost.

**Global workplace operations and service ownership**

* Set and execute the global Workplace Operations strategy, service portfolio and operating model across service management, remote support, regional onsite support and multimedia services, with clear responsibilities and consistent standards.
* Own end-to-end service delivery outcomes and the interfaces across the enterprise Service Desk (first level), remote second-level support, onsite teams, engineering specialists and managed-service providers.
* Translate business priorities into measurable service objectives, service catalogues, location coverage and capacity plans, balancing global consistency with justified local requirements.

**Regional Field Services and employee technology lifecycle**

* Lead onsite technology support across the Americas, EMEA and Asia Pacific, including executive and business-critical support, ensuring effective regional leadership, service continuity and a consistent employee experience.
* Oversee operational delivery of end-user hardware throughout provisioning, onboarding, deployment, replacement, recovery, reuse and secure retirement, including inventory availability and demand planning in partnership with Engineering, Procurement and suppliers.
* Ensure technology readiness and support for meeting rooms, multimedia services, office openings, moves and closures, and major employee events, in coordination with relevant workplace and infrastructure teams.

**Service management, quality and operational resilience**

* Lead Workplace service-management governance and operational performance across incident, major incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, service-level and service-transition practices, aligned with enterprise processes.
* Ensure effective escalation, restoration and communication during major disruptions; drive rigorous root-cause analysis, permanent remediation and a reduction in recurring incidents and avoidable service demand.
* Establish meaningful service levels and experience measures (SLAs, XLAs and operational KPIs), and maintain a transparent view of quality, reliability, employee impact, risk, demand and improvement priorities.

**Security, controls and governance**

* Ensure workplace services operate within applicable security, privacy, regulatory and internal-control requirements, with clear operational ownership for risk, vulnerabilities, privileged support access and third-party obligations.
* Oversee audit readiness, control evidence, management actions, service-continuity arrangements and supplier resilience, ensuring risks are raised early, remediation is effective and accountability is clear.

**Managed services, commercial and financial leadership**

* Own Workplace Operations financial planning and performance, including operational budgets, forecasts, service cost drivers, workforce and supplier spend, investment cases and sustainable cost optimization.
* Lead strategic partner governance, sourcing and service transitions; manage vendors against contracted outcomes, quality, experience, innovation and value rather than resource counts alone.
* Maintain effective oversight of workplace technology assets, service contracts and relevant licence consumption, partnering with Finance, Procurement and product owners on lifecycle cost and value.

**Transformation and employee experience**

* Build an evidence-led improvement roadmap that uses employee feedback, digital experience telemetry, workflow automation, self-service and AI-assisted operations to reduce friction, prevent incidents and improve productivity.
* Own operational assurance and readiness for workplace transformations, large-scale technology deployments and provider changes, ensuring credible delivery capacity, support acceptance, communication, hypercare and business continuity.
* Strengthen the experience of critical employee journeys, including joining, moving, changing devices, seeking support and leaving, with measurable gains in quality, speed, cost and satisfaction.

**Organizational and executive leadership**

* Lead and develop a multi-region organization of 150+ employees through its service-management, regional Field Services and multimedia leaders; shape structure, talent, succession, workforce planning, performance and a culture of accountability.
* Serve as a member of the Digital Workplace leadership team and partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, HR, Facilities, Finance and business leaders to resolve cross-functional issues and translate strategy into reliable operations.
* Act as the senior escalation and decision point for critical service matters, communicating clearly with executives and making balanced decisions across employee experience, cost, risk, speed and resilience.

**About the team**

In GSTP Digital Workplace, we make it easy for Swiss Re employees to use their digital workplace to connect seamlessly with people, ideas and expertise across the company and beyond. We focus on translating internal client needs into workplace products and services that improve productivity, enable flexibility and support secure ways of working.

Digital Workplace provides the products, services and support that enable Swiss Re's workforce to work from anywhere, anytime, in a stable and secure environment. This includes collaboration, productivity, endpoints, workplace foundations, governance and emerging workplace capabilities such as AI.

Workplace Operations is the global delivery and service-management capability behind that experience. It brings together remote and onsite user support, global Field Services, multimedia technology services and operational governance, in close partnership with the engineering and product organizations accountable for the technology platforms.

**About you**

To be successful in this role, you are already an established senior leader of large-scale, global IT operations or Digital Workplace / End User Services. You bring direct accountability for a comparable operation, not only individual service-management processes, engineering platforms or transformation programmes.

You have led leaders across regions and time zones, managed significant internal and outsourced service capacity, and improved service quality while controlling cost and operational risk. You are credible with engineers and service providers, but you measure success through employee productivity, reliable services and business outcomes.

You combine executive presence, sound judgement and calm incident leadership with the ability to build a strong organization. You know when to challenge, when to empower and how to turn operational evidence into clear priorities and decisions.

**You have:**

* 15+ years in enterprise IT operations or Digital Workplace, including several years as a Director or Head of a significant global service organization.
* Prior end-to-end accountability for global remote support, onsite Field Services, service governance and strategic outsourced service providers.

* Proven experience establishing data-driven operational improvement capabilities, using service analytics, digital employee experience telemetry and customer feedback to influence product roadmaps and engineering priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to work across Operations, Product and Engineering to eliminate recurring issues at their root cause, reduce support demand and improve the end-to-end employee experience.
* A proven record of leading managers across regions, building effective teams and developing talent, succession and delivery accountability.
* Deep practical knowledge of IT service management (ITIL / ITSM), major incidents, problem and change management, service transition, ServiceNow or comparable platforms, and measurable service and experience outcomes.
* Strong commercial and financial leadership, including substantial operating budgets, outcome-based managed-service contracts, supplier negotiation, service cost optimization and sourcing decisions.
* Demonstrated delivery of operational modernization with measurable improvements through automation, self-service, AI-enabled support, digital employee experience insights and continuous improvement.
* A strong understanding of workplace endpoint and collaboration technology, device and asset lifecycles, field support and multimedia services, sufficient to challenge technical and commercial decisions.
* Experience managing security, regulatory controls, audits, operational resilience and risk in a complex enterprise; experience in financial services or another regulated industry is advantageous.
* Credibility with senior executives and the ability to coordinate decisions across Technology, Security, Finance, Procurement and business stakeholders while protecting service continuity during change.

For Spain the **base salary range** for this position is between EUR 98,000 and EUR 163,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

* the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
* the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.

In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus.

**About Swiss Re**

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. title: Director of CRM & Patient Lifecycle Operations
description:

At Impress, we don't just provide orthodontics; we run a world-class operations and CRM engine. As the **Director of CRM & Lifecycle Operations**, you will own the entire patient journey—from the moment a lead is acquired to their final treatment result and beyond.

Your goal is to build a seamless, "always-on" communication ecosystem that maximizes funnel efficiency. You will leverage our existing **AI Voice and Text Agents**, scaling them to the next level to ensure that every patient interaction is personalized, timely, and high-converting.

##### **Location**

This position is **based on-site at our headquarters in Barcelona (Spain)**. You’ll be working closely with our international marketing team in a dynamic, collaborative office environment.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

***End-to-End Journey Orchestration***

Design and optimize the full patient lifecycle across all touchpoints (Email, WhatsApp, SMS, and Voice). You will be responsible for the transition between every key stage:

* **Acquisition & Lead Nurturing**: Turning interest into booked appointments.
* **Show-up Optimization**: Using behavioral triggers to ensure clinic attendance.
* **Patient Experience**: Managing the "in-treatment" journey to ensure clinical compliance and satisfaction.
* **Upselling & Advocacy**: Driving post-treatment value through retainers, whitening, and referrals.

***Next-Gen AI & Automation Leadership***

Impress is already at the forefront of AI. You will take ownership of our **AI Text and Voice Agents**, moving them beyond basic automation to sophisticated, human-like interactions. You will lead the strategy for how AI handles lead qualification, appointment rescheduling, and FAQ handling to 10x our operational capacity.

***Cross-Functional Command***

You are the glue between departments. You will work in the trenches with:

* **Marketing:** To align top-of-funnel messaging with lifecycle nurturing.
* **Booking Conversion Team:** To optimize the "Lead-to-Clinic" bridge.
* **Sales & Clinic Teams:** To ensure digital communications perfectly sync with human follow-ups and in-person experiences.
* **Omnichannel Funnel Efficiency:** Relentlessly audit and improve our multi-channel reach. ##### **Who You Are**

* **The Architect:** You have 7+ years of experience building complex lifecycles in high-growth D2C, Health-Tech, or FinTech environments.
* **AI-Forward:** You aren't afraid of the future. You have experience (or a deep strategic interest) in deploying Conversational AI (LLMs, Voice Synthesis) to automate customer interactions.
* **Master of Orchestration:** You understand that a WhatsApp message must complement—not duplicate—a phone call. You thrive on managing "Online-to-Offline" (O2O) journeys.
* **Data-Driven Leader:** You speak the language of conversion rates, cohort analysis, and attribution. You use data to tell the story of where the funnel is leaking and how to fix it.

description:

At **Macadam**, we've built an app that rewards people for walking. With over **15 million users worldwide**, we help people turn daily steps into positive habits that improve health and wellbeing.

Our product sits at the intersection of **gamification, lifestyle and wellbeing**, with a colourful, playful, character-driven universe rooted in mobile gaming.

Users earn Macadam's coins by walking, and also by doing things our partners pay for: playing games in offerwall, taking surveys, shopping through cashback, completing brand challenges. These rewarded offers are one of our largest revenue streams, and the work is only getting bigger.

We're creating a dedicated Rewarded Offers squad and looking for its first Product Manager. * Integrate new providers with your developer, help rank offers by what they actually earn, and keep the rewards economy healthy.

* Solid data and problem-solving mindset: you can pull a funnel, define a metric, run an A/B test and tell when a result doesn't hold up. SQL or a BI tool (Metabase, Mixpanel, Amplitude or similar) is a plus.
* Experience working side by side with developers on trade-offs and scope.
* Advanced AI proficiency & technical fluency: a habit of working with AI tools to conduct user research and competitive analysis, and to set up automated workflows that accelerate product discovery and execution.
* Design and user experience sensitivity.
* Autonomy and judgement: you propose the plan and don't wait for one.
* Clear written English. French or Spanish is a strong plus.

##### **BONUS POINTS**

* Experience with offerwalls, surveys, affiliate, cashback, or marketplaces.
* Background in gaming, gamified or rewards products.
* Familiarity with partner integrations (APIs, postbacks, attribution), fraud and reward integrity, and technical understanding.
* Interest in behavioural design.

##### **WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU**

* Real ownership of a revenue-critical area, reaching 15+ million users.
* Direct work with a senior full-stack developer, and the chance to build your own squad.
* Growth, learning and exposure in an international team.
* Offices in the heart of **Barcelona**, hybrid working with international flexibility.
* Meal voucher, wellness allowance (Urban Sports), private healthcare (Alan), 4 Macadam holiday days.
* Friday team lunch, company events and offsites.

##### **WHY MACADAM?**

We don't just talk about change, we walk it. Our principles:

***Make it happen***: take ownership, drive outcomes that matter.

***Build together, win together***: support and challenge each other to go further.

***Trust the data***: decide clearly, act confidently, measure what counts.

***Build for people***: design with empathy, simplicity, real humans in mind.

***Think bigger***: set the bar high, push boundaries, imagine better ways.

Want to see what we're about? Check out our website, Linkedin, Notion and Instagram page.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Long Term Planning (LTP) is the kitchen of Amazon's European network: it's where we decide what gets built, where and why, years before it opens. As a Senior PM in LTP, you'll own multi-year strategic questions end to end, see the whole supply chain rather than one slice of it, and take your recommendations straight to director and VP reviews. The questions are ambiguous and the network keeps moving, which is what makes LTP a school. You'll thrive here if you want breadth and influence early, and you like problems that don't have a playbook yet.  
  
This is a role for someone who wants to shape — not just plan — the physical backbone of Amazon’s EU Non-Sort (NS) operations. You’ll own the strategic questions that determine how millions of units flow across the continent, from how volume enters the network to how it reaches the customer.  
  
The Role:  
You’ll lead end-to-end network and topology planning across mid-term (1-year) and long-term (3-year+) horizons for Amazon’s EU Non-Sort (NS) network. You won’t optimize one slice of the chain — you’ll own the whole picture. The role centers on two high-impact mandates:  
  

* Own the CEU+UK non-sort build plan end to end — from demand through fulfillment — meeting future demand at optimal cost across the full network.

  

* Drive EU-wide strategic initiatives that redefine non-sort network design, capacity planning, and operational processes.

  
Stakeholders & Planning Cycles:  
You’ll operate at the center of the organization, leading complex cross-functional programs with senior stakeholders across Finance, Engineering, Operations, Inbound Supply Chain, External Fulfillment (3P), Real Estate, and Transportation. Your recommendations will shape Amazon’s plan of record through every major planning cycle (SPS, OP1, OP2, QxG) and land in front of directors and VPs.  
  
What You’ll Own:  
As the owner of the end-to-end planning process, you’ll take strategic questions from ambiguity to execution: judging demand forecast inputs and building the capacity requirements, identifying solve options, and driving them through Supply Chain and Engineering teams. This means deep analysis across vendor and seller behavior, network-wide program trends, and seasonal demand patterns to build risk-aware plans that hold up against real-world uncertainty.  
  
Working hand in hand with Finance, you’ll define optimal investment levels through rigorous evaluation of options — new permanent and temporary sites, retrofits, and the timing and sequencing of network launches. You’ll own the trade-offs that matter:  

* Cost and risk optimization vs. operational flexibility
* Fixed vs. variable capacity investments
* Short-term operational needs vs. long-term network sustainability

  
You’ll lead the hardest analytical questions in the network: non-sort node optimization (TNS sites, IXD non-sort flows, 3P solutions, specialty handling), the Non-Sort Dual Network Architecture (DNA) framework that defines optimal network configurations. You’ll turn that analysis into clear recommendations on economics and operational viability — and you’ll defend them in the room with leadership.  
  
Beyond the Cycle — Strategy & Innovation:  
Beyond the planning cycles, you’ll constantly redefine the end-to-end non-sort strategy as the network evolves — and the sharpest edge of that work is the trade-off between speed and cost. Your job is to spin that flywheel, embedding what you learn into making step changes to improve EU-wide planning processes. That means:  
  

* Creating frameworks to crack complex business problems
* Building innovative, data-driven solutions
* Forging consensus across diverse and senior stakeholder groups
* Driving execution through multiple organizations

  
Key job responsibilities  
The role covers the following responsibility areas:  
1. Strategic Network Planning & Architecture  
2. Partnership with demand forecasting & capacity solve  
3. Annual Planning Cycle Leadership (SPS, OP1, OP2, QxG)  
4. Cross-Functional Influence & Stakeholder Management  
5. Peak Inbound Strategy & Resilience  
6. Leadership Communication & Decision Enablement

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in program or project management
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in stakeholder management and communication management

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
* Experience leading process improvements

Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

title: AI Native Head Of Growth - EdTech (French fluent )
description:
**This isn’t another growth job**

Most growth teams call themselves data-driven. They have a dashboard, an agency and a ChatGPT licence to write ad copy faster. That’s the 99%.

We want to be part of the 0.1%: a company where AI doesn’t just help the growth team, it runs the growth loop. Every day, on every channel.

**Then it’s your chance to define a new category : The Operating System (OS) for Human Greatness Augmented with AI.**

Science-backed. Design-led. AI-powered. Global.

We’re not looking for someone who only advises on what to test, we’re looking for someone who builds it. A hands-on Head of Growth who can ideate, write the copy, design the strategy and launch experiments directly.

**WHAT AI-NATIVE GROWTH MEANS AT PARADOX**
------------------------------------------

Our growth machine has to be able to:

**1. Generate hypotheses.** Read the signals (ad performance, webinar attendance, sales calls, objections, churn reasons, comments, competitors’ ads) and propose what to test next, with a cost and an expected impact.

**2. Act across every tool.** Not a chatbot in a tab: it reads and writes in our whole stack, from ad accounts to CRM, landing pages, webinars, email, social DMs and analytics.

**3. Hold the full context of Paradox.** Our DNA, offers, voice, member stories, past campaigns and what they taught us, in one shared company brain.

**4. Ship its hypotheses.** Produce the hook, the ad cut, the page, the email sequence or the funnel variant, and put it live.

**5. Measure with real KPIs.** Every test is tied to a number that matters (cost per qualified lead, show-up rate, close rate, CAC, payback, LTV), not to likes or reach.

**6. Learn and loop on its own.** Scale what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and launch the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. Our growth hub tracks every hypothesis and experiment, with its result. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content, prepare webinars, wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations and audit our tracking after every live. Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.

**OUR MISSION**
---------------

At Paradox,

We believe self-help is broken: generic theory, a quick high, no real change.

We believe people deserve more. More than content. More than motivation.

They deserve a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

Growth at Paradox means bringing people into something that actually changes their life, and proving it.

We do that by merging :

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

**Short history**

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.

Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. A small growth team running a self-learning machine can out-test, out-learn and out-grow teams a hundred times its size.

We hold ourselves to the standards of Apple, Spotify and MasterClass. While others hide their numbers, we let our results speak.

**YOUR MISSION**
----------------

As Head of Growth, you’ll be the architect of a growth machine that learns by itself. In a classic growth team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the work, you design the system, set the bar and make the calls.

You don’t just manage a team, you get your hands dirty to identify growth levers and pull them yourself.

**YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**
------------------------

### **1. Build the agents that run growth**

* The old way: a Head of Growth hires people and agencies, briefs them, and checks their work.
* At Paradox: your team is mostly agents, and you build them yourself. You write their skills, plug them into our tools (ad accounts, CRM, webinars, email, analytics) and write the evals that tell an agent what "good" means: a hook that stops the scroll, a page that converts, a test that’s worth its cost.
* You give autonomy step by step: first an agent suggests, then it acts once you approve, then it acts alone within a budget and guardrails. You move each agent up a level only when its track record earns it.
* Example: in your first month you build the agent that reviews every ad set overnight. At first it only suggests. By month three it pauses losers and moves budget by itself within limits you set, and you only see what was decided and why.

### **2. Build an acquisition engine that runs day and night**

* The old way: a media buyer checks the dashboards each morning, changes bids by hand and waits for the weekly report.
* At Paradox: you build and improve the agents that watch every ad set, page, webinar and email sequence around the clock. They spot what’s dropping, find the cause, fix it or launch a variant, and report what they did.
* You give autonomy step by step: an agent can pause an ad on its own long before it can raise a budget. You decide where each agent stops and a human takes over.
* Example: show-up rate drops on Tuesday’s webinar. Before anyone notices, an agent has found the cause (a reminder that never went out), fixed it and started testing a new reminder sequence.

### **3. Build a creative machine with taste**

* The old way: a creative team briefs an agency, waits two weeks and gets five ads.
* At Paradox: you build the agents that turn every live, interview and member story into hooks, ad cuts and shorts, that study what the best advertisers in the world are running, and that write in our voice.
* Your taste becomes the eval: you write down what makes a great hook, a great cut and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Example: one webinar becomes dozens of hook variants by the next morning. You keep the best few, and next week the agents’ first drafts are already closer to your bar.

### **4. Build measurement that checks itself**

* The old way: an analyst rebuilds the numbers in a spreadsheet at the end of the month, and nobody trusts them.
* At Paradox: you build the agents that connect every touch to cash, from ad to lead, live, sale and transformed member, and that audit the tracking after every campaign.
* No number, no test: you define the KPIs that matter (CAC, show-up, close rate, LTV, payback), and agents refuse to launch a test that isn’t wired to one.
* Example: after each live, an agent cross-checks the ad platform, the CRM and our analytics, finds where they disagree and fixes the leak before the next live.

### **5. Make the machine better every week, and keep the soul**

* The old way: lessons live in people’s heads and leave with them.
* At Paradox: every result goes back into the company brain, and agents read it before proposing anything. The machine never learns the same lesson twice.
* You measure the machine itself: tests per week, time from idea to live, the share of the work done without a human, and how many agents moved up an autonomy level this month. You push those numbers up.
* And always: no fake scarcity, no fake claims, real stories told with consent. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

**How you’ll know you’re AI-native:** you spend your time building agents, writing evals and making calls, not doing the work by hand. Most experiments are generated and shipped by agents. The output grows every month while the headcount doesn’t.

**You’ll own these KPIs:** LTV / CAC ratio, funnel conversion rate by stage, experiments launched per week.

**Desired outcomes:** conversion rates 2x better than baseline, growth experimentation that runs continuously, a predictable growth engine.

**Tools you’ll master:** GA4, Optibase, Vidalytics, Clarity, Hotjar, Amplitude, Figma, Looker Studio, VWO, Optimizely, Claude Code, and whatever helps you see what others miss.

**THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE**
---------------------------------

**Experience :**

* You have ideally a minimum of 3 years of experience in Conversion Rate Optimization, Growth Experimentation, or Performance Marketing, ideally within SaaS, e-commerce, or digital product environments.
* You have a track record of designing, implementing, and scaling A/B and multivariate tests that have generated measurable improvements in revenue, user activation, or conversion.
* You’ve built with AI and agents yourself: Claude Code, automations, APIs, evals, creative pipelines. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

**You are :**

* A Conversion Architect, skilled at diagnosing funnel bottlenecks and translating data into structured experimentation roadmaps that deliver measurable business outcomes.
* A Behavioral Strategist, fascinated by what drives human action, able to mix cognitive psychology, UX, and persuasion frameworks to design experiences that convert because they resonate.
* A Data-driven Creator, fluent in GA4, Hotjar, AB Tasty, VWO, Amplitude, not just running tests, but connecting insights to revenue, retention, and lifetime value.

**Traits :**

* Loop thinker: you see every channel as a loop that can learn, and you can’t stop yourself from closing it.
* Taste: you know a great hook in two seconds, and you’d rather ship one great ad than ten average ones.
* Numbers-honest: you say when a test failed. You care about real revenue, not vanity metrics.
* Builder, not manager: you’d rather build the system than coordinate an agency.
* Growth over ego: you love hard feedback, you read, study and learn fast.
* Cross-disciplinary: you move from psychology to spreadsheet to creative brief to code.
* Analytical: you turn a vague problem into a clear hypothesis, a metric and an experiment.

**Language**

French: Native / Bilingual

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

**IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU**
---------------------------

If you need clarity before chaos — wrong place.

If you prefer balance over intensity — wrong season.

If you build to deliver, not to elevate — wrong mission.

If you want to optimize without getting your hands dirty in landing pages, copy, or design — wrong role.

If you want to manage agencies and budgets rather than build a machine — wrong role.

If you’re obsessed with psychology, systems and creative…

If you want to build the growth machine that learns faster than anyone else…

If you dream of using AI to bring transformation to millions of people…

**WHY JOIN US**
---------------

Build one of the first truly self-learning growth machines, and write the playbook others will copy.

Grow something that genuinely changes lives, with the proof to show it.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.

**Growth & Ambition**

* > Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

**Competitive Salary**

But you don’t just want a competitive paycheck, you also want…

**Impact & Meaning**

* > Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people
* > Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something!

We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.

But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve…

**Freedom & Well Being**

* > A company culture based on autonomy & accountability
* > Flexible working hours (but very hard working)

title: PPC Marketing Specialist (Remote)
description:
**Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.**

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

**You are the account manager. We do not have any.** You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

**You own the whole funnel, not the campaign.** Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

**You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.** We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

**You can live anywhere.** We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

 **Requirements**

**What the job looks like**

* **Own a set of DTC accounts** as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
* **Own the client relationship.** There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
* **Audit before you touch anything.** Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
* **Run brand and non brand as different businesses.** Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
* **Know what PMax is actually doing.** The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
* **Keep Google's automation on a leash.** Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
* **Own the feed.** Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
* **Own the tracking.** GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
* **Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it.** Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
* **Build the things the account needs.** Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

**You are a fit if**

* **You have done this with real money.** Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
* **You are fluent in the whole stack**, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
* **You are AI native, and you build.** This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
* **You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level.** You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
* **You are skeptical of your own numbers.** You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
* **You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls.** Where you live is up to you.
* Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

**You are not a fit if**

* "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
* You want to be told what to do this week.
* You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
* You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

  
**Benefits**

**Why this role is exciting**

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

title: Direct Response Supplement Copywriter (with AI Avatars)
description:
**AI Avatar Supplements Copywriter**
------------------------------------

Organic Instagram & Facebook Reels | Direct Response Copywriting

**About Us**
------------

Impact Clients is a fast-growing, 100% bootstrapped online education and software company. Through courses, coaching, and software, we help everyday people develop practical skills and build digital product businesses.

We are launching an exciting new business division focused on AI avatars, viral health and wellness content, and supplement affiliate marketing.

We are hiring a full-time AI Avatar Supplements Copywriter to join our internal team and help us build a portfolio of highly successful Instagram and Facebook accounts that generate millions of organic views and drive supplement sales.

Your primary mission is simple: Research viral content, write exceptional short-form scripts, and turn organic views into supplement affiliate revenue.

This is a hands-on creative position for someone who understands how to capture attention, write compelling health and wellness content, and turn social media engagement into measurable revenue.

Company: Impact Clients  
Website: https://go.impactclients.co/ Language: English  
Availability: Full-Time (40 hours/week)  
Time Zone: ET business-hour overlap preferred  
Work Type: Full-Time, Remote  
Industry: Health & Wellness, Supplements, AI Avatars, Affiliate Marketing, Direct Response  
Expected Compensation: 2,000 - 3,000 USD/month

**Our Business Model**
----------------------

We are building a new portfolio of organic Instagram and Facebook accounts focused on health, wellness, longevity, and supplement-related topics.

Rather than using traditional human influencers, we use AI-generated avatars to create engaging, educational, and entertaining short-form videos.

Here's how the business works:

* Research Viral Content: Identify high-performing health and wellness videos, trending topics, proven hooks, and compelling educational angles.
* Write Scripts: Turn research into original, attention-grabbing Instagram and Facebook Reel scripts designed to maximize retention, engagement, and sharing.
* Create AI Avatar Videos: Our production team uses AI avatar technology and video editing to bring your scripts to life.
* Drive Organic Traffic: Publish content across our Instagram and Facebook accounts to generate views, followers, and product interest.
* Generate Affiliate Revenue: Direct interested viewers toward relevant supplements sold through affiliate partners, including Amazon product pages, where purchases can generate commissions.

Our goal is to build a repeatable, scalable content engine that consistently produces viral videos and generates meaningful affiliate revenue.

You will be responsible for the research, hooks, storytelling, and scripts that power this entire operation.

**Example Accounts & Creative References**
------------------------------------------

Below are examples of Instagram accounts operating in the type of health and wellness content space we are entering.

Please review these accounts before applying to understand the general content formats, topics, and creative styles we are looking to develop:

These accounts are provided as creative references for the type of organic health and wellness content we intend to produce.

Your responsibility will be to research what makes content successful in this market and develop original scripts that can achieve comparable or better results.

We are looking for someone who can identify proven viral patterns and turn them into original, engaging, revenue-generating content—not simply copy or rewrite another creator's videos.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Research viral content daily: Discover high-performing Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and other short-form videos in the health, wellness, longevity, and supplement markets.
* Write high-converting scripts: Develop original short-form video scripts designed to generate strong hooks, watch time, engagement, shares, and supplement affiliate sales.
* Develop compelling hooks: Write attention-grabbing openings that stop viewers from scrolling and make them want to watch the entire video.
* Master short-form storytelling: Structure scripts with compelling introductions, curiosity, educational value, and natural transitions into product-related calls to action.
* Research supplement products: Understand the supplements we promote, their ingredients, intended uses, consumer interests, and approved product positioning.
* Write product-focused content: Develop educational and promotional content around health topics that naturally connects to relevant supplement products.
* Optimize for revenue: Understand that our goal is not simply generating millions of views, but producing content that translates into clicks, qualified product interest, and affiliate commissions.
* Collaborate with AI video editors: Work closely with our AI avatar production team to ensure scripts translate into compelling final videos.
* Analyze performance: Review metrics including views, average watch time, engagement, clicks, and attributable sales to identify successful formats and improve future scripts.
* Build repeatable content systems: Organize research, winning hooks, proven angles, and creative templates to help our team consistently produce high-performing content at scale.
* Maintain compliance: Ensure health and supplement scripts avoid unsubstantiated medical claims, misleading representations, and prohibited claims while following applicable FTC guidance, affiliate disclosure rules, and platform policies.
* Continuously improve: Test different hooks, messaging angles, storytelling structures, and calls to action based on performance feedback.

**Must-Haves**
--------------

* Strong copywriting ability, particularly for short-form videos, direct-response marketing, or social media content.
* Demonstrated ability to research viral content and understand why certain videos outperform others.
* Excellent understanding of Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and short-form content retention.
* Ability to write engaging scripts that communicate complex topics in simple, compelling language.
* Strong research skills and an ability to identify interesting health and wellness topics from credible sources.
* Understanding of persuasive writing, consumer psychology, curiosity-driven hooks, and effective calls to action.
* Ability to produce scripts consistently at high volume without sacrificing quality.
* Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, and writing while maintaining originality and accuracy.
* Willingness to learn about supplements, affiliate marketing, and direct-response content monetization.
* Strong attention to detail, ability to follow feedback, and willingness to iterate based on performance.
* Excellent written English and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.

**Nice To Haves**
-----------------

* Experience writing viral Instagram or Facebook Reels that have generated 1M+ views.
* Experience writing direct-response copy specifically for supplements, health, wellness, nutrition, or longevity products.
* Proven track record writing social content that has generated measurable clicks, conversions, or affiliate revenue.
* Familiarity with AI avatar platforms, AI video generation, or faceless content production.
* Experience with supplement affiliate programs, Amazon Associates, or similar performance-based marketing models.
* Understanding of Facebook and Instagram algorithms, retention metrics, and organic content distribution.
* Experience writing comment-to-DM calls to action or using ManyChat-style automation workflows.
* Familiarity with supplement advertising compliance, health-related advertising restrictions, and affiliate disclosure standards.
* Experience creating high volumes of original content across multiple social media accounts.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

We are not hiring someone to simply write scripts and check boxes.

We are hiring someone who is excited about the challenge of building a brand-new revenue division through viral content.

Success in this position means:

* Consistently identifying promising viral content opportunities before they become oversaturated.
* Producing original scripts that achieve strong watch time, engagement, and organic reach.
* Developing repeatable winning formats that can be replicated across multiple accounts.
* Collaborating effectively with our AI avatar production team to maintain a consistent content pipeline.
* Creating content that generates meaningful affiliate clicks, supplement purchases, and attributable revenue.
* Continuously improving creative performance through research, testing, and iteration.

Ultimately, we want a copywriter who thinks like both a creative strategist and a direct-response marketer.

You should care just as much about whether a video generates sales as you do about whether it generates views.

**Our Core Values**
-------------------

We believe that an exceptional company is built by exceptional people.

Impact Clients has grown from zero to multiple eight figures without outside funding because our team operates with an entrepreneurial mindset, high standards, and a shared commitment to our customers.

Our three core values define how we work:

1. Client Success = Company Success

Everything we do, from marketing and sales to coaching and fulfillment, exists to create the best possible outcomes for our customers.

Client success always comes first.

2. 1% Better Every Day

We believe in constantly improving, both personally and professionally.

Whether that's working out, reading, learning new skills, or sharing valuable ideas, our team takes personal growth seriously.

We encourage continuous development—physically, mentally, and spiritually—and regularly share books, podcasts, lessons, and reflections with each other.

3. FIO — Figure It Out

We are an entrepreneurial, resourceful team of owners.

We believe in hiring people who can take initiative, solve problems independently, and operate with very little micromanagement.

Every team member is encouraged to treat their division like their own business, take full ownership of results, and find creative solutions to challenges.

We believe that if you want to go fast, you go alone; if you want to go far, you go together. That's why we all choose as individuals to grow with this team because we are committed to the vision of building a billion-dollar enterprise-value organization, and having a ton of fun along the way.

We work hard, set high standards, and genuinely enjoy building alongside talented, ambitious people.

**Benefits & Opportunity**
--------------------------

* Competitive compensation: 2,000–3,000 USD per month, depending on experience and qualifications.
* Build a new division: Join at the ground floor of an exciting new AI avatar and supplement affiliate marketing business.
* Creative autonomy: Research viral content, test fresh angles, and develop your own creative approaches to generating organic growth.
* High-growth environment: Work inside an established, multiple-eight-figure company launching a new revenue channel.
* Work with AI technology: Collaborate with a team using AI avatars, video generation, and modern content production tools.

* Fully remote: Work remotely with a results-oriented team that values autonomy, ownership, and execution.

**How To Apply**
----------------

If you're passionate about viral content, direct-response copywriting, AI technology, and health and wellness, we'd love to hear from you.

Please be prepared to share examples of your previous copywriting work, particularly short-form video scripts, along with any available performance metrics demonstrating results.

We want someone who can help us build a viral content engine that consistently generates millions of views and turns that attention into real, measurable revenue.

title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
**About UMAEZ**

UMAEZ builds, launches and scales direct-to-consumer brands it owns outright, including GODA. Every revenue function sits in-house, from creative strategy and paid media to retention, creator programs and customer support. We are remote-first and AI-first, with a global team that ships a high volume of performance creative every week.

**About the role**

We are looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to own the operational backbone of our marketing team.

You will connect creative production, retention, creator and affiliate programs, social media initiatives, hiring coordination, external partners and marketing systems, and you will design the workflows and AI integrations that make them run. Your job is to turn priorities into clear assignments, make sure teams have what they need, keep deadlines visible and get approved work to launch.

This is a hands-on ownership role. You will run daily execution while maintaining and improving the systems behind it. In the same week you might clear an urgent production bottleneck, build a ClickUp automation, rebalance an overloaded pod and give leadership a clear read on operational performance.

You will take full ownership of the function through a structured handover with the outgoing Head of Marketing Operations.

**What you'll own**

Daily execution and operating rhythm

* Own the daily operating rhythm of the marketing department. Turn leadership priorities into plans with clear owners, deadlines and follow-through.
* Coordinate requests across creative, media buying, retention, customer support, People and external partners. Resolve blockers, manage competing priorities and escalate decisions before they affect delivery.
* Track announcements and feedback from team leads, and turn strategy or priority changes into updated assignments the same day.
* Run the relevant operational meetings, keep action logs and make sure decisions are reflected in team workflows.
* Own the follow-ups and smaller tasks that keep work moving.

Creative production and delivery

* Own the workflow from brief assignment through production, review, revisions, approval, final upload and delivery for launch.
* Work with creative leads and strategists to keep production plans realistic, priorities clear and workloads balanced. Track backlog, overdue tasks, revision queues and upcoming deadlines, and protect the weekly editing cadence so the pipeline is cleared by the end of each week.
* Enforce naming conventions, task requirements, upload procedures and approval gates. Leads and strategists approve their own department's creative; you own the approval flow, including repurposed TikTok edits that admins approve against set guidelines.
* Run pre-launch quality checks on the ads delivery tracker, including content safety (claims, platform policy, visual compliance) and duration and format checks, so every asset is complete, compliant and ready for media buying.
* Oversee the daily delivery sweep with the operations admins. Confirm that approved assets reach media buying, delivery records in ClickUp and Notion stay accurate and launch blockers get timely follow-up.
* Maintain the marketing and launch calendar for campaigns, product launches and seasonal peaks such as BFCM. Coordinate dependencies across creative assets, product information, website readiness and launch teams.
* Brief and prioritize web and design requests, and check output before it goes live.

Pod structure, capacity and team coordination

* Own the operational structure of the creative pods (strategists, video editors and shared resources, including pods run with external creative partners), and adapt it as brands and workloads grow.
* Keep a current view of who supports each strategist, product and brand. Spot staffing gaps, overloaded or idle team members and opportunities to rebalance work.
* Place new joiners in pods, coordinate their access, workflow training and team integration, and keep the pod structure tracker up to date.
* Monitor delivery performance and recurring execution issues. Agree corrective actions with functional leads and follow through until each issue is resolved.

Workflow building and AI integration

* Design and build the operational workflows that connect teams, tools and handoffs, from intake and assignment through review, delivery and reporting.
* Lead AI integration across marketing operations: find where AI can remove manual work or improve quality, then build, test and roll out the solution with the teams who will use it.
* Build and maintain automations, Make scenarios and AI agents (for example Claude skills and MCP connections, ClickUp agents and AI assistants) that handle repetitive coordination: assignment checks, delivery QA, content safety and duration checks, reporting, onboarding messages and sample tracking.
* Test new AI and agentic tools for operations and creative production, and recommend what to adopt, with clear costs, risks and expected time saved.
* Keep a registry of every running automation and agent, with its purpose, owner and schedule. Make sure each one is monitored, documented and that failures surface quickly.
* Train the team to run and trust these workflows, so they keep working without depending on the person who built them.

ClickUp workspace

* Own the marketing ClickUp workspace: structure, lists, statuses, templates, dashboards, permissions, forms and native automations. Serve as the escalation point for ClickUp issues.
* Keep the workspace practical, accurate and usable as team needs change, with consistent processes across internal teams and external partners.
* Make sure tasks hold the information needed for execution, reporting and accountability.

Notion and operational documentation

* Own the architecture and maintenance of the marketing Notion workspace, including operational databases such as the ads delivery and creator sample trackers.
* Keep SOPs, playbooks, team resources and the onboarding knowledge base organized and current, including role-based onboarding templates and walkthrough videos. Every process should have a clear owner and reflect how the team actually works.
* Update documentation whenever workflows change, so essential knowledge is easy to find and does not depend on any one person.

Reporting and operational performance

* Own marketing operations reporting and the accuracy of the trackers behind it.
* Keep visibility into assignments, production, delivery, backlog, capacity, onboarding and operational risks. Turn reporting into clear actions for the team and concise updates for leadership, including a weekly Marketing Operations update and the operations section of the monthly leadership review.
* Define and maintain operational KPIs and their calculations with the relevant stakeholders, such as creative lead time and on-time delivery. Flag missing or inconsistent data before using it to assess performance.
* Identify recurring bottlenecks and implement improvements that speed up execution, reduce avoidable revisions and improve resource use.

AI tools, software and cost oversight

* Own the operational administration of the marketing tool stack (including Higgsfield, HeyGen, Claude, Make, Tagbox and other creative and AI tools): access, onboarding, offboarding, usage tracking and vendor coordination.
* Own monthly Higgsfield credit reporting: credits consumed, allocation by team and project, usage patterns and efficiency metrics such as credits per finished second of video. Forecast requirements and flag overspend early.
* Review software needs with team leads, coordinate renewals and resolve access or usage issues. Cut unnecessary costs and identify tools that make production faster.
* Support the rollout of approved AI workflows, training resources and usage standards.

Retention operations

* Oversee the operating structure that supports the retention team, working closely with the Head of Retention.
* Maintain project and campaign workflows, ownership, timelines, reporting and cross-team dependencies, so the team has the systems and resources to execute consistently.
* Track agreed initiatives, escalate delivery, staffing or coordination issues, and support new retention and growth projects through planning, setup and implementation.

Creator, affiliate and social media programs

* Oversee the creator and affiliate programs, including the Trybe creator program and partner-agency programs: program structure, recruitment and activation workflows, performance tracking and the overall health of each program.
* Maintain onboarding resources, submission processes, approval requirements, tracking and communication procedures. Make sure product samples are tracked from order to delivery and that delayed shipments and missing content are followed up.
* Coordinate issues involving creator permissions, usage rights, asset delivery, attribution and commission setup and internal handoffs.
* Oversee social media initiatives with the social team: content calendars, production and approval workflows, asset delivery and posting cadence. Make sure social plans line up with launches, creator content and paid campaigns.
* Report on program and initiative performance with the relevant leads, and turn what works into repeatable processes.

External partners and vendors

* Manage operational relationships with external creative partners, agencies, vendors and platforms, and lead key partner calls. Keep deliverables, responsibilities, timelines and escalation routes clear.
* Monitor partners and vendors for operational gaps, keep partner documentation current and follow through on open commitments, service issues and agreed improvements.

Creative rewards and commission administration

* Own the administration and documentation of creative rewards programs.
* Maintain eligibility rules, performance trackers, milestone records and calculation procedures. Validate the monthly close with the relevant performance and finance owners before rewards are approved for payment.
* Resolve questions on naming, attribution, iterations and eligibility consistently. Escalate exceptions and proposed rule changes to leadership.

Hiring, onboarding and offboarding coordination

* Partner with the Head of People and functional leads to identify hiring needs based on capacity, workload and performance.
* Keep visibility into open roles, expected start dates, onboardings, exits and resource gaps, and share a regular hiring operations recap.
* Coordinate skills-test logistics for creative candidates with the reviewing leads.
* Prepare new joiners operationally: workspace access, onboarding checklists and ClickUp templates, pod and channel assignments, welcome messages and training resources.
* Oversee the marketing side of offboarding so access is removed across every tool and shared account, and responsibilities and files are handed over properly.
* People owns recruitment and formal HR processes. You own the operational readiness and integration of marketing hires.

Admin team management

* Lead the marketing operations admins. Set weekly priorities, clarify ownership and review the accuracy and completeness of assignment, delivery, reporting and access-management work.
* Keep dependable daily coverage so recurring work continues through absences and staffing changes. Own escalations and fix the process when the same issue comes back.

Leadership support and continuous improvement

* Give the CEO a clear view of operational health, risks, capacity and decisions required.
* Support planning for new products, brands, teams, partners and growth initiatives. Assess operational requirements, resource implications and execution risks before rollout.
* Keep visibility into vendor costs, rewards liabilities and resource allocation, and provide accurate operational inputs for budget and profitability decisions.
* Proactively spot broken or missing processes, and take approved improvements from diagnosis through implementation, documentation and team adoption.

**What success looks like**

* Marketing priorities have clear owners and realistic deadlines. Teams know what to work on, approved assets move steadily toward launch and blockers surface early.
* Every asset that reaches media buying has passed its quality, safety and duration checks, and delivery records match reality.
* Manual coordination keeps shrinking as reliable workflows, automations and AI agents take it over, and the team knows how to run them.

Above all, we need someone who takes full ownership, follows through and builds systems the team can rely on.

**At ING we are looking for a Customer Journey Expert – Discretionary Portfolio Management**

**Your role and work environment:**

ING Bank is entering in the Private Banking segment in Spain, a large market serving more than €600b in household wealth and showing a growth rate of 4% annually. ING Bank is in the process of launching a comprehensive new proposition tailored to Private Banking, digitally savvy customers. Join us in shaping the future of banking for Spain’s Private Banking & Investment.

ING Spain is building a new Discretionary Portfolio Management (DPM) proposition as a key component of its Private Banking offering. We are looking for a hands-on **Customer Journey Expert** to join the DPM team, help complete delivery and close existing gaps, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of the product.

You will contribute across the **end-to-end DPM journey**, from requirements and testing to implementation, banker training and continuous improvement. Working closely with the Product Owner and the wider team, you will connect customer and banker needs with technology, operations and regulatory requirements.

You will work in a **highly international and cross-functional environment**, collaborating with **One Investment Platform** and teams across Investments, Technology, Operations, Data, Finance, Risk, Legal and Compliance.

This is a **hands-on Customer Journey Expert role within the DPM team**, combining product delivery, customer experience and support for bankers. You will take responsibility for agreed activities and contribute to product improvements, while backlog ownership and prioritization remain with the Product Owner.

**Your key responsibilities:**

You will contribute to **DPM delivery, day-to-day product improvements and further evolution** through the following activities:

* **Complete the remaining DPM delivery**: Define and refine business requirements, document user stories and acceptance criteria, and work with technology and operations teams to bring outstanding capabilities into production.

* **Close existing gaps**: Identify and analyse functional, operational and customer journey gaps, help define practical solutions, and follow agreed actions through to resolution.

* **Support testing and implementation**: Prepare and execute end-to-end business and user acceptance tests, follow up on defects, and support release readiness and post-implementation validation.

* **Train and support bankers:** Prepare practical training materials and product guides, deliver DPM training sessions, and gather banker feedback to improve both the service and the assisted journey.

* **Contribute to product evolution:** Help define and implement new DPM capabilities and proposition enhancements, including pDPM, in line with the product roadmap and priorities agreed with the Product Owner.

* **Improve the digital and assisted experience:** Work with UX, design and technology teams on visual improvements, clearer portfolio information and simpler customer journeys, aligned with the Private Banking Digital Experience.

* **Keep the end-to-end service coherent:** Collaborate with Investments, One Investment Platform, retail product tribes and control functions to align processes, customer communications and operational handovers as DPM evolves.

As a **Customer Journey Expert** you are responsible of:

* **Customer Experience:** Provide the **best customer experience** by designing, mapping and constantly improving the customer journey. With an end-to-end process view being able to collect CX and data, translating into UX and IT landscapes

* **Digital Strategy**: As expert in digital experience, be proactive in the identification of new capabilities in our digital platform to **engage our customers** and increase **efficiency** of our assisted channels bringing the best experience in the moments of truth

* **Commercial Support:** Collaborate with marketing, customer interactions teams and bankers to translate the DPM value proposition into clear customer communications and practical supporting materials, incorporating feedback from the assisted channel.

* **Data Fluency:** Comprehend, define, select, and analyze data to gain insights that enhance the **decision-making process**. Use product and journey data, together with customer and banker feedback, to identify gaps, assess improvements and contribute to balanced cost-benefit assessments before and after implementation.

* **Agile Delivery:** Translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria. Work on items prioritized by the Product Owner, contribute to refinement, and deliver agreed activities in short cycles with the team. Identify dependencies, risks and impediments early, support their resolution, and use testing and feedback to improve solutions while reducing complexity.

**What are we looking for?**

Want to know if this job is made for you? These are some of the qualities that we value the most for this role. And if the shoe fits… don’t hesitate to apply!

**A pioneer of the agile culture displaying the following behaviors:**

Ability to display flexibility to teams and adapt plans, approach and behavior to the different needs and situations

* Ability to take responsibility for agreed deliverables and contribute to team decisions based on facts, data and customer feedback

Strong resilience: ability to navigate through ambiguity

* Negotiation skills

* Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to follow delivery activities and open issues through to completion

* Passionate about innovation, new market trends and investment products

* Clear communications skills (written and oral)

* Ability to work on an international level

* Excellent oral and written English skills

* Team player

* Loving to collaborate with different people

* Able to work in an autonomous way and to take initiative

* Making things happen thanks to your ‘can do’ attitude

**Proven track record and technical skills**

* University degree, master’s in finance related is also a plus

* 5+ years’ professional experience in banking

* Experience with investment products and/or Private Banking customer journeys; familiarity with DPM is a plus

* Omnichannel experience management

* Research techniques and UX product design is a plus

* Practical experience translating business needs into requirements and supporting user acceptance testing and implementation

* Ability to explain investment products and processes clearly and prepare practical training materials for bankers

* Strong command of written and spoken English
  

  
  

**What do we offer?**

The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.

  

Check out what is waiting for you!

**Balance That Works.**

We put balance to work, so you can do it too. With our customers’ needs first, the team´s and your own, we agree when to come to ING MAD and when to work best from home. More time together when it matters, more freedom when you need it.

**Restaurant card.**

So that thinking about what to have for lunch doesn’t take up your time or your cravings.

**Health insurance.**

For you and all your family (spouse/partner and children).

**Life insurance.**

We help you protect what matters most to you.

In addition, you will enjoy our flexible remuneration model, through a more tax-advantaged way, you will be able to access other services such as nursery, transport card, training aids…

**Free company shuttle.**

It doesn't matter where you live. We have 6 routes (North, Central, South, A5, A42 and A6) to get you to our ING office in Madrid comfortably.

**Banking benefits.**

Special loans with more beneficial conditions.

Special mortgage conditions after 6 months working at the bank.

And you can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us!

**More vitality and more belonging**

360º care of the employee (physical, mental, social connection & purpose).

Physiotherapy service on site.

Clinics with professional, world-class athletes.

Gympass service.

Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI+), Leonas & RIÑG.

International Remote work program.

**Get to know Us**

We are a team of more than 1900 people sharing one idea: **doing our bit in helping our clients create a better future for themselves**, by providing them with the tools they need to get where they want to go.

A **fully online bank** where technology, innovation, simplicity and transparency are the main ingredients, and the first one to work with **agile methodologies**.

And although we are based in Spain, we **are lucky to work in an international bank with presence in more than 35 countries.**

And even though we look orange on the outside, **we are green on the inside**. Our ambition in Sustainability is **Empowering (y)our Sustainability journey**. We are embarking on our path, for us, but we are also there for when our clients decide to embark on this journey.

**Making things happen, helping others be successful, always being one step ahead—that’s our DNA.** If you look at yourself in the mirror and your reflection matches our way of being and working…we are looking forward to meeting you!

*At ING, you belong just as you are. We hire and support people for their talent and potential — and we know that when you can be yourself, you do your best work.*

**Job Application Safety Reminder**

We’re seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:

* **Apply only via official ING platforms:** ING uses **Workday** and **LinkedIn** as its internal recruitment system. Applications should be submitted **only via our official career site or via ING job postings on LinkedIn**.

* **Check the sender’s email carefully:** Legitimate communication will always come from **@ing.com** and/or **@myworkday.com**.
