Únete a nosotros para dar forma al futuro de la banca para Banca Privada e Inversiones en España.

  
  

ING España está desarrollando una nueva propuesta de Gestión Discrecional de Carteras (DPM, por sus siglas en inglés) como componente clave de su oferta de Banca Privada. Buscamos un/a **Customer Journey Expert** con un enfoque práctico para incorporarse al equipo de DPM, ayudar a completar la implementación y cerrar las brechas existentes, así como contribuir a la evolución continua del producto.

  
  

Contribuirás a lo largo del **journey end-to-end de DPM**, desde los requisitos y las pruebas hasta la implementación, la formación a bankers y la mejora continua. Trabajando estrechamente con el Product Owner y el resto del equipo, conectarás las necesidades de clientes y bankers con los requisitos tecnológicos, operativos y regulatorios.

  
  

Trabajarás en un **entorno altamente internacional y transversal**, colaborando con **One Investment Platform** y con equipos de Inversiones, Tecnología, Operaciones, Data, Finanzas, Riesgos, Legal y Compliance.

  
  

Este es un **rol de Customer Journey Expert con un enfoque práctico dentro del equipo de DPM**, que combina delivery de producto, experiencia de cliente y soporte a bankers. Asumirás la responsabilidad de las actividades acordadas y contribuirás a las mejoras del producto, mientras que la gestión y priorización del backlog seguirán siendo responsabilidad del Product Owner.

  
  

**Tus principales responsabilidades:**

  
  

Contribuirás al **delivery de DPM, las mejoras del día a día del producto y su evolución futura** mediante las siguientes actividades:

* **Completar el delivery pendiente de DPM:** Definir y refinar requisitos de negocio, documentar user stories y criterios de aceptación, y trabajar con los equipos de tecnología y operaciones para llevar a producción las funcionalidades pendientes.
* **Cerrar las brechas existentes:** Identificar y analizar brechas funcionales, operativas y del customer journey, ayudar a definir soluciones prácticas y realizar el seguimiento de las acciones acordadas hasta su resolución.
* **Dar soporte a las pruebas y la implementación:** Preparar y ejecutar pruebas de negocio end-to-end y pruebas de aceptación de usuario, realizar el seguimiento de defectos y apoyar la preparación de releases y la validación posterior a la implementación.
* **Formar y dar soporte a bankers:** Preparar materiales prácticos de formación y guías de producto, impartir sesiones de formación sobre DPM y recopilar el feedback de bankers para mejorar tanto el servicio como el journey asistido.
* **Contribuir a la evolución del producto:** Ayudar a definir e implementar nuevas funcionalidades de DPM y mejoras de la propuesta, incluyendo pDPM, en línea con el roadmap del producto y las prioridades acordadas con el Product Owner.
* **Mejorar la experiencia digital y asistida:** Trabajar con los equipos de UX, diseño y tecnología en mejoras visuales, información más clara sobre las carteras y customer journeys más sencillos, alineados con la Experiencia Digital de Banca Privada.
* **Mantener la coherencia del servicio end-to-end:** Colaborar con Inversiones, One Investment Platform, las tribus de producto de retail y las funciones de control para alinear procesos, comunicaciones con clientes y transiciones operativas a medida que evoluciona DPM.
  

  

Como **Customer Journey Expert** eres responsable de:

* **Experiencia de Cliente:** Ofrecer la **mejor experiencia de cliente** diseñando, mapeando y mejorando constantemente el customer journey. Con una visión end-to-end del proceso, ser capaz de recopilar datos y aspectos relacionados con CX y traducirlos a entornos de UX e IT.
* **Estrategia Digital:** Como especialista en experiencia digital, ser proactivo/a en la identificación de nuevas funcionalidades en nuestra plataforma digital para **involucrar a nuestros clientes** y aumentar la **eficiencia** de nuestros canales asistidos, ofreciendo la mejor experiencia en los momentos de la verdad.
* **Soporte Comercial:** Colaborar con marketing, los equipos de interacción con clientes y bankers para trasladar la propuesta de valor de DPM a comunicaciones claras para clientes y materiales prácticos de apoyo, incorporando el feedback del canal asistido.
* **Fluidez con Datos:** Comprender, definir, seleccionar y analizar datos para obtener insights que mejoren el **proceso de toma de decisiones**. Utilizar datos de producto y del journey, junto con el feedback de clientes y bankers, para identificar brechas, evaluar mejoras y contribuir a análisis equilibrados de coste-beneficio antes y después de la implementación.
* **Agile Delivery:** Traducir las necesidades de negocio en requisitos claros, user stories y criterios de aceptación. Trabajar en los elementos priorizados por el Product Owner, contribuir al refinamiento y entregar las actividades acordadas en ciclos cortos junto con el equipo. Identificar dependencias, riesgos e impedimentos de manera temprana, apoyar su resolución y utilizar las pruebas y el feedback para mejorar las soluciones reduciendo al mismo tiempo la complejidad.
  

  

**¿Qué buscamos?**

  
  

¿Quieres saber si este puesto está hecho para ti? Estas son algunas de las cualidades que más valoramos para este rol. Y si encajan contigo… ¡no dudes en presentar tu candidatura!

  
  

**Una persona pionera de la cultura agile que demuestre los siguientes comportamientos:**

Capacidad para mostrar flexibilidad hacia los equipos y adaptar los planes, el enfoque y el comportamiento a las diferentes necesidades y situaciones.

* Capacidad para asumir la responsabilidad de los entregables acordados y contribuir a las decisiones del equipo basándose en hechos, datos y feedback de clientes.

Gran resiliencia: capacidad para desenvolverse en entornos de ambigüedad.

* Habilidades de negociación.
* Sólidas habilidades de planificación y organización, con capacidad para realizar el seguimiento de las actividades de delivery y de los asuntos pendientes hasta su finalización.
* Pasión por la innovación, las nuevas tendencias del mercado y los productos de inversión.
* Habilidades de comunicación claras, tanto escritas como orales.
* Capacidad para trabajar a nivel internacional.
* Excelente nivel de inglés oral y escrito.
* Capacidad para trabajar en equipo.
* Pasión por colaborar con diferentes personas.
* Capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma y tomar la iniciativa.
* Capacidad para hacer que las cosas sucedan gracias a una actitud «can do».
  

  

**Experiencia demostrable y habilidades técnicas**

* Titulación universitaria; contar con un máster relacionado con finanzas también será un plus.
* Más de 5 años de experiencia profesional en banca.
* Experiencia con productos de inversión y/o customer journeys de Banca Privada; estar familiarizado/a con DPM será un plus.
* Experiencia en gestión omnicanal de la experiencia.
* Conocimientos de técnicas de investigación y diseño de productos UX serán un plus.
* Experiencia práctica traduciendo necesidades de negocio en requisitos y dando soporte a pruebas de aceptación de usuario e implementación.
* Capacidad para explicar productos y procesos de inversión de forma clara y preparar materiales prácticos de formación para bankers.
* Sólido dominio del inglés escrito y hablado.
  

  

**¿Qué ofrecemos?**

  
  

El tiempo que pasas en el trabajo, los retos a los que te enfrentas o las lecciones que aprendes son muy importantes, pero… ¿qué pasa con tu vida personal? En ING queremos que tu trabajo te llene en todos los sentidos, y por eso cuidamos hasta el más mínimo detalle.

¡Descubre todo lo que te espera!

  
  

**Balance That Works.**
  
Ponemos el equilibrio a trabajar para que tú también puedas hacerlo. Teniendo en cuenta primero las necesidades de nuestros clientes, las del equipo y las tuyas propias, acordamos cuándo venir a ING MAD y cuándo es mejor trabajar desde casa. Más tiempo juntos cuando importa, más libertad cuando la necesitas.

  
  

**Tarjeta restaurante.**
  
Para que pensar qué comer no te quite tiempo ni te quite las ganas.

  
  

**Nuestra casa será tu hogar.**
  
En nuestras oficinas podrás encontrar soluciones de movilidad eléctrica, servicio médico, peluquería, gimnasio, The Good Service (para ayudarte con tus gestiones) ¡y mucho más!

  
  

**Seguro médico.**
  
Para ti y toda tu familia (cónyuge/pareja e hijos/as).

  
  

**Seguro de vida.**
  
Te ayudamos a proteger lo que más te importa.

  
  

**Retribución flexible.**
  
Además, disfrutarás de nuestro modelo de retribución flexible, a través del cual y de una forma fiscalmente más ventajosa podrás acceder a otros servicios como guardería, tarjeta de transporte, ayudas para formación…

  
  

**Transporte gratuito de empresa.**
  
No importa dónde vivas. Disponemos de 6 rutas (Norte, Centro, Sur, A5, A42 y A6) para que puedas llegar cómodamente a nuestra oficina de ING en Madrid.

  
  

**Beneficios bancarios.**
  
Préstamos especiales con condiciones más ventajosas.
  
Condiciones hipotecarias especiales tras 6 meses trabajando en el banco.
  
¡Y podrás beneficiarte de nuestro plan de pensiones después de 1 mes con nosotros!

  
  

**Más vitalidad y más sentimiento de pertenencia**

Cuidado 360º del/de la empleado/a (bienestar físico, mental, conexión social y propósito).
  
Servicio de fisioterapia en las instalaciones.
  
Clínicas con deportistas profesionales de primer nivel.
  
Servicio Gympass.
  
Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI+), Leonas & RIÑG.
  
Programa internacional de trabajo en remoto.

  
  

**Conócenos**

Somos un equipo de más de 1.900 personas que compartimos una misma idea: **aportar nuestro granito de arena para ayudar a nuestros clientes a crear un futuro mejor para sí mismos**, proporcionándoles las herramientas que necesitan para llegar adonde quieren.

  
  

Un **banco completamente online** donde la tecnología, la innovación, la sencillez y la transparencia son los ingredientes principales, y el primero en trabajar con **metodologías agile**.

  
  

Y aunque estamos en España, **tenemos la suerte de trabajar en un banco internacional con presencia en más de 35 países.**

Estamos orgullosos de contar con un equipo diverso y estamos comprometidos con seguir desarrollando una cultura de **Diversidad, Inclusión y Pertenencia** para fomentar una cultura de **colaboración e innovación** que represente a todos los colectivos de la sociedad.

  
  

Y aunque por fuera nos veas naranjas, **por dentro somos verdes**. Nuestra ambición en materia de Sostenibilidad es **Empowering (y)our Sustainability journey**. Estamos emprendiendo nuestro propio camino, por nosotros, pero también estamos ahí cuando nuestros clientes deciden emprender este viaje.

  
  

**Hacer que las cosas sucedan, ayudar a los demás a tener éxito y estar siempre un paso por delante: ese es nuestro ADN.** Si te miras al espejo y tu reflejo encaja con nuestra forma de ser y trabajar… ¡estamos deseando conocerte!

*En ING, perteneces tal y como eres. Contratamos y apoyamos a las personas por su talento y potencial, y sabemos que cuando puedes ser tú mismo/a, haces tu mejor trabajo.*

  
  

**Recordatorio de seguridad para candidaturas**

Estamos observando un aumento de ofertas de empleo fraudulentas. Para protegerte, sigue estas pautas clave al presentar tu candidatura a puestos de ING:

* **Presenta tu candidatura únicamente a través de las plataformas oficiales de ING:** ING utiliza **Workday** y **LinkedIn** como sistema interno de selección. Las candidaturas deben enviarse **únicamente a través de nuestra web oficial de carreras profesionales o de las ofertas de empleo de ING publicadas en LinkedIn**.
* **Comprueba cuidadosamente el correo electrónico de quien te escribe:** Las comunicaciones legítimas siempre procederán de **@ing.com** y/o **@myworkday.com**.
* **Nunca te solicitaremos pagos ni datos bancarios:** Si alguien te pide esta información, se trata de un fraude.

title: Global Permitting & Approvals Manager
description:
### **About the company**

**About the company**

**Utopia** is an ultra-luxury hospitality and lifestyle brand creating a global ecosystem of properties and experiences.

We develop private villa retreats in beautiful locations around the world, each with high-end service. **Utopia** also offers a wider ecosystem of leisure experiences and services available both to those staying on property and to external visitors.

**Utopia** designs and builds its properties in-house. Our projects span the full journey: from concept and architecture to construction, interiors, landscape, guest experience, and long-term operation. For architects and designers, this means contributing on properties from the ground up, with the ability to influence how each place is planned, built, and experienced. For hospitality professionals, it means collaborating with a brand where service is personal, attentive, and built around each guest’s stay.

We’re a young, ambitious team with high standards and a hands-on approach. We value strong ideas, practical thinking, attention to detail, and people who are ready to take ownership of their part of each project. If you’re interested in architecture, design, hospitality, or guest experience, we invite you to explore opportunities with **Utopia.**

**About the role**

We are looking for a hands-on Global Permitting & Approvals Manager to lead permitting and regulatory approvals across our international development portfolio.

You will research local requirements, translate them into clear technical tasks for project teams, coordinate AORs and local consultants, and drive approval processes through to completion.

This role requires independent problem-solving, strong execution skills and the ability to establish effective processes in a fast-moving international environment.

Projects span Spain, South Africa, Brazil, Costa Rica, the Dominican Republic, the UAE and other locations, each with different regulatory requirements.

**Responsibilities**

* Own permitting and regulatory approvals across multiple countries and projects.
* Research local regulations and establish approval strategies and schedules.
* Translate statutory requirements into technical documentation tasks for internal teams.
* Participate in selecting and managing local AORs and permitting consultants.
* Coordinate application submissions, authority comments and final approvals.
* Identify critical risks, resolve blockers and protect construction milestones.
* Implement standardized permitting processes and portfolio-wide reporting.

  
**Requirements**  

* Hands-on construction permitting experience in at least two countries and three project locations.
* Proven record of personally securing development or construction approvals.
* Experience of permitting in at least 2 of selected locations: Spain, South Africa, Brazil, Costa Rica, the Dominican Republic, the UAE
* Strong understanding of regulatory requirements and technical submission documentation.
* Experience managing local AORs, consultants and government authorities.
* Ability to research new jurisdictions and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong ownership, analytical thinking and process-building capabilities.
* Fluent English

**Nice to Have**

* Spanish and/or Portuguese.
* Hands-on permitting experience in Spain, Brazil, Latin America, the UAE, or South Africa.
* Background in luxury residential or hospitality development.

  
**Benefits**  

* **Fully remote with business trips.** You'll collaborate from anywhere within GMT-3 to GMT+3.
* **All the tools you need.** A laptop and access to our project and documentation tools from day one.
* **Properties across three continents.** You'll take projects through approval in Europe, Africa, the Middle East, and Latin America, so you won't be limited to one market, one regulator, or one type of permit.
* **A team that spans 30+ countries.** Developers, architects, engineers, and legal specialists from every corner of the world, held to the same standards and the same bar for quality.

By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy.

title: UX Product Owner (Personal Loans)
description:
**About Revolut**

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 15,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

**About the role**

The Credit team at Revolut creates and scales lending features that power global growth. They manage the entire product lifecycle, from backend systems to customer-facing experiences. By combining market insight, risk expertise, and technical precision, they deliver safe, forward-thinking solutions tailored to each region.

We’re looking for a Product Owner to lead our unsecured personal loan roadmap, including day-to-day operations, project execution, and risk assessment.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

title: Product Expert - Vault Safety
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

### **The Role**

Veeva is looking for a highly motivated individual with life science industry experience within the Safety (Pharmacovigilance) domain to drive customer success with our Veeva Safety Suite products.

As part of the Veeva Safety product team and collaborating with broader global Product Experts, your experience will play a key role in the Product organization. You will:

* Build and nurture highly engaged user communities by maintaining regular communication across various forums to deliver clear, impactful messaging that drives shared understanding, encourages product adoption, and enhances customer value
* Represent the Product organization in customer meetings, online communities, with internal team education and at industry events – driving increased customer value through release education and product capability promotion
* Serve as the Voice of the Customer, capturing their needs and industry intelligence before sharing insights with product managers. This helps to guide product decisions and design improvements, ultimately delivering better Safety solutions that drive regulatory compliance and operational efficiency
* Develop rich relationships with key product users / influencers
* Collaborate effectively with Veeva field teams to drive customer success, product excellence, best practices (Good Vault Practice) and Veeva success!

This role is ideal for someone passionate about Pharmacovigilance, eager to collaborate with customers, and excited to drive their success.

### **What You'll Do**

* Be the product evangelist, providing subject matter expertise for the Veeva Safety products and champion for Veeva's key product enhancements
* Contribute to best practices and process recommendations within the Veeva Safety products
* Stay up to date with the latest features and roadmap direction
* Engage with customer stakeholders to communicate our product roadmaps and vision
* Provide product education to Veeva Safety customers in our online communities (Veeva Connect) and a range of in-person forums; Ensuring we are communicating the problems we are solving, value delivered and product functionality.
* Act as the customer advocate by collecting, analyzing and prioritizing their feedback to contribute to future product innovations, helping to inform product roadmaps. Be a customer advocate internally!
* Collaborate with Product teams to create effective release communications and resources.
* Provide cross-functional support to internal teams, including Services, Strategy, Sales, and Product Support.

### **Requirements**

* 5+ years within the life sciences industry, ideally within Pharmacovigilance (Safety)
* Experience in using and/or implementing Safety applications and processes including substantial experience working with case processing, safety operations, aggregate reporting and signal management
* Ability to understand customer business requirements and to translate them to technical product requirements, preferences, and limitations – communicated to both business and technical stakeholders.
* Ability to understand product vision, technical specifications and software development documentation, and translate them into language and content relevant for end users and business teams.
* Strong organizational, analytical and communication/ English skills (written, verbal, and formal presentations). Ability to understand and engage technical users (safety scientists, data analysts).
* Prior experience leading workshops and product discovery, displaying high levels of curiosity
* A strong passion for emerging technologies (specifically AI) and the ability to quickly grasp, articulate, and conceptualize how AI-driven features can solve related real-world challenges (including some exposure to AI in driving efficiencies in your existing role and/ or optimizing workflows)
* SQL & PV Data Mastery: Proficiency writing and auditing complex SQL queries (AI-assisted coding experience a plus).
* Self-directed team player with a positive attitude and strong sense of ownership.
* Willingness to travel up to 25%.
* Based in Europe with ability to work across time-zones.

### **Nice to Have**

* Veeva Product experience (including Veeva Safety / case processing)
* Statistical Signal Detection: Understanding of the statistical algorithms used in quantitative signal detection, such as Disproportionality Analysis (PRR, ROR, EBGM).
* Experience performing software demonstrations
* Creating engaging videos with familiarity with video recording/ editing software (e.g. Camtasia)

Note: Veeva will consider applicants from European countries where Veeva has representatives.

### **Interviewing with Veeva**

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

* Follow the application process and submit your resume.
* Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
* Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
* If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:

  + A conversation with the hiring manager
  + A practical case exercise
  + A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
* Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

### **Compensation**

* Total compensation: 70,000-140,000 EUR
* The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

###### **#LI-RemoteSpain**

###### **#LI-MidSenior**

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

As an equal opportunity employer, Veeva is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and growing a diverse workforce. Diversity makes us stronger. It comes in many forms. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. We value people for the individuals they are and the contributions they can bring to our teams.

If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at talent\_accommodations@veeva.com.

title: Treasury Manager (Liquidity)
description:
**About Revolut**

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 15,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

**About the role**

The Finance team keeps Revolut moving with clarity and confidence. From accounting to strategic support, they work across the business to assess risk, guide decisions, and drive growth. Their insight shapes everything from daily operations to long-term plans and plays a key role in how we scale.

We're looking for a Treasury Manager to join our Liquidity team and enhance our overall framework in Western Europe. You’ll ensure robust frameworks and controls are in place to meet regulatory requirements and support growth while optimising returns.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

**What you'll be doing**

* Identifying key liquidity and FX risks, and reviewing the entity's risk appetite for liquidity and funding exposures
* Establishing, maintaining, and analysing early warning indicators (EWIs)
* Conducting daily monitoring of cash, liquidity, and FX positions
* Contributing to strategic and investment activities, such as ALCO and HQLA/treasury portfolio
* Collaborating with Product Owners and Risk team members to deliver the entity's ILAAP in line with our internal policies and regulatory requirements
* Implementing appropriate liquidity management tools for the data capture, control, measurement, reporting, and forecasting of liquidity
* Maintaining liquidity and funding policies and procedures
* Keeping up-to-date on emerging trends in financial markets that can affect funding strategy, and assisting in the design of the liquidity investment portfolio

**What you'll need**

* A master's degree from a top university or business/engineering school
* 4+ years of experience in financial risk management or accounting, preferably within regulated financial institutions (banks, fintechs)
* Knowledge of risk-related regulations and their application in the banking industry, including prudential capital, liquidity, and financial risk requirements
* Experience with risk identification, monitoring, and controls (implementation and testing)
* Previous examples of practically interpreting and organising complex data
* The ability to quickly assume responsibilities
* An organised and methodological approach
* Excellent interpersonal skills

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with tax-related topics
* Exposure to high-growth or scaling financial institutions
* Experience interacting with regulators or auditors, or supporting regulatory inspections

* Legacy Code: The project includes legacy code that needs to be maintained and improved. It is important to understand existing implementations, refactor them when necessary, and introduce changes safely without disrupting existing functionality.

* AI Integration: AI tools are actively integrated into everyday development workflows, supporting code development, code reviews, debugging, and technical problem-solving.

* Strong understanding of the iOS SDK, including UIKit, CoreData, and CoreAnimation.
* Experience with Auto Layout and Xcode Interface Builder.
* Experience integrating RESTful APIs, working with network requests, handling server responses, and processing JSON data.

* Experience maintaining, refactoring, and improving legacy code without disrupting existing functionality.

 **Job Description**

The Technical Architect will serve as the technical point of reference, with the objective of transforming business goals into robust, evolvable, secure, and operable architectures. They will lead end-to-end technical architecture design, establish technical and non-functional criteria, support the team during implementation, and ensure that deliverables meet the quality, performance, resilience, and security levels required by a critical enterprise platform.

Responsibilities

* Define the end-to-end technical architecture of the project, including components, integrations, data flows, dependencies, and boundaries of responsibility.
* Make and document architectural decisions using ADRs, evaluating alternatives, trade-offs, evolution costs, risks, and operational consequences.
* Translate functional and non-functional requirements into implementable designs, technical acceptance criteria, and an evolution roadmap.
* Design scalable and resilient distributed solutions, considering consistency, concurrency, idempotency, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery.
* Participate in the development of critical components and conduct code reviews focused on design, maintainability, security, and operational behavior.
* Define the testing and quality strategy: unit, integration, contract, end-to-end, performance, resilience, and security testing.
* Design and review APIs, integration contracts, persistence schemas, and compatibility and evolution mechanisms.
* Evaluate performance and capacity through analysis, profiling, load testing, and the definition of measurable latency and throughput targets.
* Ensure the automation of builds, validations, static analysis, deployments, and quality controls within CI/CD pipelines.
* Integrate secure-by-design principles, threat modeling, secrets management, access control, and traceability into the architecture.
* Identify technical risks, structural debt, and bottlenecks; prioritize their remediation and communicate their impact on timeline, cost, and scope.
* Participate in planning complex deliveries, technical estimations, milestone definition, and tracking architectural commitments.

 **Qualifications**  

* More than 4 years of experience as a Technical Architect, with demonstrable experience leading the design and delivery of platforms or projects of high technical complexity.
* At least 5 years of experience in software development and in Java, Spring Boot, APIs, persistence, distributed systems, automated testing, and CI/CD.
* Experience in regulated or financial environments with high availability, performance, security, and traceability requirements.
* Experience conducting architecture reviews, defining standards, managing technical debt, and evolving existing systems.
* Experience working with Agile methodologies and collaborating cross-functionally with Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, and Business teams.
* Advanced experience with Java 21, Spring Boot 3.x, and designing mission-critical enterprise applications.
* Mastery of microservices architecture, distributed systems, synchronous and asynchronous integration, and communication patterns.
* In-depth knowledge of REST API design, contracts, versioning, backward compatibility, and integration governance.
* Experience with Spring Data JPA, data modeling, transactions, PostgreSQL, and query and persistence optimization.
* Experience with Gradle or Maven, multi-module projects or composite builds, dependency management, and build automation.
* Mastery of SOLID principles, DDD, Clean Architecture, design patterns, and refactoring and safe evolution techniques.
* Experience defining testing strategies using JUnit 5, Mockito, AssertJ, as well as contract, integration, and performance testing.
* Solid knowledge of concurrency, caching, messaging, idempotency, consistency, resilience, and fault tolerance.
* Experience with Git, code reviews, branching strategies, and collaborative development practices at scale.
* Experience with CI/CD, automated quality, static analysis, artifact management, and controlled deployments.
* Knowledge of observability: structured logs, metrics, distributed traces, alerting, and production diagnostics.

Languages

* **Minimum B2 English level, mandatory.** A professional level is required to lead decisions and collaborate with international teams.
* **Spanish – professional level, minimum B2, mandatory.**

Nice to Have

* Experience in the architecture of financial platforms, corporate banking, trading, or high-criticality transactional systems.
* Experience with event-driven architectures, Kafka, or other messaging and distributed processing platforms.
* Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud, and deployment patterns such as blue-green, canary, and rolling releases.
* Experience applying OAuth2, OpenID Connect, threat modeling, secrets management, and application security controls.
* Knowledge of SRE, SLO/SLI, capacity, high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
* Experience in application modernization, progressive migrations, the strangler pattern, and technical debt reduction.
* Experience defining architecture standards, technical reviews, and governance models in large organizations.
* Domain knowledge of Trade Finance or Documentary Trade.

**What do we offer you?**

* Full-time or B2B contract
* **Remote within CET Time zone.**
* Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects.

description:
DESCRIPTION

We are looking for an Ophthalmic Franchise Manager to take ownership of the development of our ophthalmology franchise across international markets.

Reporting to the Head of Sales, this role combines commercial strategy, international distributor management and marketing. You will lead the franchise strategy, strengthen relationships with our partners and coordinate cross-functional teams to drive sustainable growth, profitability and successful in-market execution.

* Availability to travel internationally.

title: CS Team Lead
description:
**Who we are**
==============

With a global **mission** to help people live longer, healthier lives, **Docplanner** Group is the world's biggest healthcare platform. We serve patients and healthcare professionals across 13 countries in Europe and LATAM, with a network of more than 2.8 million healthcare professionals and over 20 million bookings every month. Our global team of around 3,000 people works from offices in Warsaw, Istanbul, Rome, Barcelona, Mexico City, Bogotá, Curitiba, Rio, Munich and Berlin.

**About the role**
------------------

Clinic Agenda is growing, and so is the number of clinics that rely on it every day. We are looking for a Team Lead to turn a Customer Success team of around 8 reps into the reason clinics stay and grow with us.

Our Customer Success processes are mature and well established. We expect you to master them quickly and then challenge them: give you feedback on what you think it works, sharpen what doesn't, and move the team from reacting to churn requests to a proactive, commercial and data-driven approach. You will be measured on results, and you will have the autonomy to decide how to get them.

**How you work**
----------------

* **Numbers first.** You open every discussion with data. You know your portfolio's health, churn and expansion figures without having to look them up.
* **Data-driven decisions.** Intuition gives you a hypothesis; data confirms or rejects it. You test, measure and adjust.
* **You escalate always with** **a proposal.** When something needs leadership's attention, you bring the analysis, the options and your recommendation.
* **Ownership and accountability.** You take full ownership of your team's results. When a target is at risk, you are the first to see it, explain it and present the plan to recover it.
* **Outcomes over activity.** You care about results, not about how busy the team looks.
* **You build people.** You set clear expectations, give honest feedback and measure your own success by how much your reps improve. You also take tough decisions if needed.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Build a high-performing team**

* Lead, coach and develop around 8 Customer Success Reps, some of them early in their careers.
* Set clear expectations, run regular 1:1s and call reviews, and give direct, actionable feedback.
* Spot skill gaps early, build training plans to close them and track each rep's performance continuously.
* Hire, onboard and grow talent so the team gets stronger.

**Grow the portfolio**

* Co-own with RevOps and CS Manager, the upselling and cross-selling strategy across the existing clinic base.
* Use product usage and customer data to find expansion opportunities and turn them into revenue.

**Protect the base**

* Run retention and churn-reduction strategies across the portfolio.
* Detect at-risk clinics early through usage, engagement, support signals, and act before they churn.

**Raise the standard**

* Master our established Customer Success processes and KPIs, then challenge them with data and improve what no longer works.
* Keep workflows, escalation paths and service-level standards up to date and consistently applied.
* Structure internal documentation so reps can find the information they need, fast.
* Design an onboarding programme for new joiners that shortens their ramp-up time.
* Analyse quality insights with our internal AI tool to improve process adherence and service quality.
* Ensure smooth day-to-day operations: capacity, coverage and service levels are always under control.

**Work across teams**

* Coordinate with Sales, Product, Finance and Customer Care so clinics get one seamless experience.
* Partner with Revenue Operations on reporting, automation and prioritization.
* Step into key customer conversations when the situation needs it.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

**You are accountable for these targets, and you decide how the team gets there:**

* **Expansion MRR:** New recurring revenue from upselling and cross-selling to existing clinics
* **Churn MRR:** Recurring revenue lost through cancellations and downgrades
* **Net Revenue Retention:** Overall revenue kept and grown across the portfolio
* **Onboarding & Farming Quality:** Overall quality standards

**Additional information**

Salary in line with your experience.  
Most importantly: an amazing team that will support you every step of the way.  
Private health insurance.  
Your birthday off to spend with your loved ones.  
Free language classes.  
Unlimited access to iFeel chat for mental health and emotional wellbeing support.  
Hybrid working, with a minimum of 1 day a week at our Barcelona offices.

**Our hiring process**
  
First match: a chat with Fito (Talent Acquisition Lead).  
Strategic conversation: an interview with gustavo and Patri  
c-level interview: With Cyril our Head of CS.
  
Business case presentation: with Gustavo and Carlos our CEO

title: Program Coordinator, IE Impact
description:
Overview:

Are you interested in joining a dynamic and international team of professionals to transform education? IE University's **Education & Student Experience** is looking for a **Program Coordinator** to join its team!

**IE IMPACT** is IE University’s undergraduate core studies learning journey, totaling 21 ECTS, and required of all IEU students. IE University’s four core courses consist of one in the **Humanities**, one in **Technology,** the **Entrepreneurial Mindset & Practice** course and the **IE Challenge** course**.** The IE Impact Learning Journey aims to equip students with the knowledge, mindsets and skills needed to be innovative problem-solvers who lead positive change. The entire learning journey centers the value of diversity and a commitment to sustainability (within the broad understanding of the SDGs). The IE Impact program is IE University’s largest academic feat thanks to its scale, transversal composition and mission. The IE Impact team is responsible for its successful operational execution.

The **Program Coordinato**r is a great opportunity for current IEU staff who are assistants and seek a promotion (with the support of their current supervisors). It is also a great opportunity for young professionals who seek to form part of an international team and develop themselves further in an academic institution. It is also a great opportunity for others who perhaps have been out of the workforce for a period and are eager to contribute to our team their maturity and eagerness to work outside of the home.

The **program coordinator** role is highly administrative and requires a lot of time seated at a computer responding to student and faculty email inquiries and occasional in-person drop-ins, which makes up approximately 85-90% of the work.

The **program coordinator** role is also asked to balance administrative tasks with creative work, contributing to “beyond-the-classroom" activities for students that serve to reinforce IE Impact learning objectives, as well as contributing to the organization of training activities for faculty.

The **program coordinator** role engages with many different and transversal stakeholders across the entire university (staff, students, faculty, guests) and such interactions require professionalism, intercultural skills, maturity and empathy.

The **Program Coordinator** role reports ultimately to the IE Impact Executive Director. For daily operations, the program coordinator works under the supervision and with the support of the IE Impact Sr. Associate Director. The Program Coordinator also works in close coordination with and to support the IE Impact Academic Directors (each IE Impact course is led by at least one Academic Director and/or Academic Coordinators).

Every story begins with a purpose, and ours has always been about people. Founded in 1973, IE University has continuously raised the bar to drive positive change through education. We encourage bold thinking and foster a culture where innovation, curiosity, and courage lead to real-world impact. Together, we create an environment where talent thrives, and ideas shape the future.

We support students in developing impact skills to live and lead with positive impact. This ignites a ripple effect: We transform people, who then transform others, systems, society, and, ultimately, our world.

**Our Purpose**

To foster positive change.

**Values**

* Cultivate the humanistic approach.
* Empower your entrepreneurial spirit
* Cherish the diversity of people, mind, and experience
* Drive innovation with a proactive mindset

We are looking for a person to join a full-time position in **Madrid - IE Tower.**

**Your role as a Program Coordinator will involve:**

* Academic operations: coordination with academic partners and internal stakeholders (planning, registrar, IT) to prepare courses (websites, enrollment, etc.) and materials for courses, for both students and faculty. Tasks include, but are not limited to, class lists, student accommodations, faculty training, enforcement of academic policies, course evaluations, meeting with class delegates, etc.
* Administrative operations: Tasks include, but are not limited to, processing expenses, travel arrangements and reimbursements, special payments, record and update processes, etc.

* Legal work permit to work in Spain

* Native level/Fluency in English and strong conversational Spanish skills.
* Excellent communication skills in English and a strong customer orientation
* International profile and comfort in working in multicultural environments
* Attention to detail and problem-solving skills
* Proficiency in MS Office
* Proactive and creative attitude
* Empathy
* Teamwork
* Life-long learner, and life-long learner mindset.

* Willingness to work occasionally at IEU’s campus in Segovia.

title: Senior Business Innovation Consultant
description:
Reports to: Lead Business Innovation Strategist / Design Strategy Director/VP

**About Mormedi**

We are a global boutique, strategic design and innovation consultancy. We help our clients create products, services, and experiences that delight customers and that fuel growth. By blending strategy, creativity, technology and business insight to design and deliver the most meaningful solutions.

**Our Mission: To help businesses navigate change confidently.**

We accomplish our mission by:

* Developing practical, human-centred solutions that drive growth, sustainability, and transformative impact;
* Making strategy and visions of the future tangible as a way to gain and maintain momentum;
* Establishing partnerships across industries for non-traditional approaches and better connected ecosystems;
* Creating strategies that help our clients lead the future with purpose.

**Our Values**

* Long-term thinking: We are passionate about finding the most profound, lasting opportunity in each innovation challenge, looking and testing from multiple angles.
* Meaningful experiences: We strive for positive impact in people's everyday lives by inviting diverse human perspectives and creating relevant and meaningful experiences.
* Systemic elegance: We believe that design can make a real difference when approached with a holistic, inclusive and sustainable mindset.
* Maker mentality: We can't help but make the abstract practical through visualization, models and prototypes to drive alignment and speed up progress.

**About the role**

Role overview

As a Senior in our Business Innovation practice, you will work at the intersection of human-centred design, business planning, financial modelling, and venture validation. You will autonomously lead project workstreams—from uncovering customer insights and framing new venture hypotheses to building robust business cases, operating models, and market launch roadmaps—guiding junior team members and collaborating directly with clients to deliver high-impact strategic deliverables on time and on budget.

This role is for you if

You want to take full ownership of business innovation streams that reshape how clients compete, from early exploration to commercially viable go-to-market solutions. You thrive in collaborative studio environments, enjoy building financial models from scratch, facilitating executive co-creation workshops, mentoring emerging consultants, and defending business viability directly with C-suite stakeholders.

What you will own

* Autonomous execution and content leadership over complete strategic workstreams, several smaller projects, or major work packages within large client programs, taking ownership of content excellence, business case viability, and project profitability.
* High-level strategic storytelling, translating abstract user insights, market dynamics, and unit economics into compelling presentation decks and executive arguments.
* Definition of business models, operating models, and financial feasibility frameworks in multidisciplinary projects led by Strategic Design, Industrial Design, and UX/UI.
* Guiding, supporting, and mentoring Staff, Junior strategists, and Interns on business design methodologies, financial modelling, workshop preparation, and deliverable quality.
* Facilitation of co-creation workshops, client working sessions, and executive presentations.
* Support in commercial opportunities: helping define project scope, estimating effort, and drafting strategic POV materials for pitch proposals.
* Participation in creating thought leadership content (articles, case studies, whitepapers) and industry presentations to strengthen market positioning.
* Contribution to growing the Business Innovation practice, evolving proprietary business design toolkits, and scaling client accounts.
* Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration & Studio Community: Collaborate closely with Strategic Design, Industrial Design, and UX/UI teams to ensure commercial viability and business models inform physical and digital design execution, actively fostering a cohesive Mormedi studio culture and cross-discipline teamwork.
* Quality & Environmental Leadership (ISO 9001 & ISO 14001): Responsible for upholding Quality and Environmental Management System standards within assigned streams, driving continuous process efficiency, and embedding sustainable business practices and circular economy principles into deliverables.

**How success is measured**

**Project Delivery (~80%):** Delivery quality, project timeline/budget compliance, client satisfaction (CSAT 4-5), financial rigor, and mentoring impact.

**Commercial & Marketing Support (~20%):** Support in proposal preparation, organic account opportunity identification, content creation, and methodology enhancements.

**What you bring**

**Senior Strategic & Business Expertise –** Minimum 6 years of professional experience in Business Innovation, Strategy Consulting, Venture Building, or Strategic Design, with a strong portfolio showcasing complex innovation and business model engagements delivered for diverse industries.

**Financial Modeling & Business Craft –** Demonstrated ability to build, manage, and interpret complex financial models from scratch to support unit economics, revenue forecasting, scenario analysis, and strategic decision-making.

**Methodology Mastery –** Deep knowledge of human-centered innovation, business model canvas, operating model design, customer journey mapping, and qualitative research methods.

**Executive Storytelling & Facilitation –** Exceptional ability to structure complex arguments into clear, visually compelling presentations (PowerPoint/Miro) and facilitate board-level working sessions.

**Project Stream Leadership –** Proven ability to organize project streams, prioritize tasks across multiple projects, and keep project profitability and margin targets in mind.

**AI Literacy & Responsible AI –** Fluency in applying Generative AI tools (LLMs, research synthesis engines, automation platforms) to business modeling, market research, and scenario planning while ensuring compliance with the EU AI Act, client IP protection, and data privacy.

**Software & Tools**

**Executive & Financial Suite:** Microsoft Office (Advanced Excel for financial modeling, P&L projections, and planning; PowerPoint for executive storytelling; Word).

**Collaboration & Workshop Platforms:** High proficiency in collaboration platforms such as Miro.

**Generative AI Platforms:** LLMs and agentic workflow tools applied to market scanning, trend analysis, and research synthesis under strict confidentiality rules.

**Visual Suite (Nice to have):** Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop overview).

**Languages:** High professional proficiency in English and Spanish; a third language is appreciated.

**Qualifications**

An appropriate Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Innovation Management, or a related field, with a proven interest in design thinking.

Willingness to travel for client meetings, field research, and workshops.

Valid work permit for Spain/Europe.

A valid driving license (minimum 2 years of seniority) is appreciated.

title: Customer Success Manager (Prosthetic Lab Business Unit)
description:
**Straumann Group**

Straumann Group is a global leader in solutions for tooth replacement, restorative dentistry, orthodontics and preventive dentistry. We combine innovation, excellence and a strong commitment to quality to make first-class dental care increasingly accessible to professionals and patients around the world.

With more than 11,000 employees and an international presence, we develop, manufacture and market a broad portfolio of solutions, including dental implants, biomaterials, CAD/CAM prosthetics, digital equipment, software and clear aligners. Our portfolio includes leading brands such as Straumann, Neodent, Anthogyr, Medentika, ClearCorrect and Dental Wings, among others.

As a comprehensive solutions provider, we work closely with dental professionals, clinics and laboratories, offering not only innovative products but also training, support and services that contribute to the development of clinical practices and improve the patient experience.

**Primary Position Objectives**

As a Customer Success Manager for the Prosthetic Lab Business Unit (PLBU) you will play a crucial role in understanding and meeting the unique needs of customers and markets requiring prosthetic solutions and workflows. This position involves a combination of technical expertise, customer interaction, and collaboration with various stakeholders to ensure the successful growth of Straumann Group prosthetic solution.

Additionally, together with the sales organization you will be responsible for driving sales in the assigned territories.

This position will play a key role in delivering the next generation of Straumann prosthetic solutions and digital services for dental labs.

The Customer Success Manager for PLBU reports directly to the Head of PLBU EMEA & APAC and is a highly collaborative role that works closely with the service centers, R&D teams, other Straumann business units, and the PLBU Product Management team.

The role demands expertise in prosthetic solutions and requires interpersonal skills and a customer centric mindset.

**On this role, your primary responsibilities include:**

* Drive sales by working closely with the country sales team. Providing them with overviews on sales data and products information, and ensure diligent follow up on key accounts, markets and new prospects.
* Provide technical support to clients (internal and external), addressing queries and concerns related to prosthetic solution, workflows and services.
* Build close in-depth relationships with key customers to understand current and future needs.
* Collaborate with the product development and design teams to translate client specifications into technically feasible solutions.
* Provide market intelligence on new customer requirements as well as gathering information on competitors and their solutions.
* Educate clients (internal and external) on the features and functionalities of the Straumann Group prosthetics solutions.

**Profile**

* Highly customer obsessed and have a good understanding of the dental market (prosthetics) customer requirements.
* Dental prosthetic expertise.
* Good knowledge of digital technologies and workflows.
* Fluent in spoken and written English. Other languages are an asset
* Objectives driven and are comfortable working in a fast-paced work environment and cross functional teams.
* A dental technician or have at least 3 years experience in customized prosthetic solutions.
* Customer centric and enjoy continuous interaction with customer.
* Familiar with customer analytics, data and digital solutions, and have a track record of using data in developing and delivering customer insights to support rational decision-making and business growth.
* Additional education on business or team management is an asset.
* In-depth understanding of the commercial business with the ability to influence, challenge and innovate to enable commercial strategic imperatives .
* A strategic mindset, with strong capability to clearly communicate and foster alignment in across all levels of the organization

description:

* **Contract type:** Permanent, Full time

* **Reports to:** Head of Account Management, Spain

##### **About VSI**

VSI is a leading localisation company providing dubbing, subtitling, voice-over, and digital media services to the entertainment and corporate industries. Headquartered in London’s West End, with offices worldwide, VSI partners with some of the world’s leading global brands and content producers.

##### **About the role**

As Dubbing Production Supervisor, you will lead the dubbing project management team at our Spanish facility. You will make sure our international clients' projects are delivered efficiently and on time. You will work with colleagues across VSI's global network to bring high-quality Castilian and Catalan dubbed content to audiences.

This role suits someone who enjoys dubbing, likes coordinating several projects at once and is happy working with creative teams. You will find practical solutions in a dynamic environment. You will work closely with clients, suppliers, project managers, casting and production coordinators, the technical team and the Head of Account Management.

##### **What will you do**

* Oversee dubbing projects from the initial brief through planning, scheduling, budgeting, delivery, invoicing and post-project review.
* Deliver projects on time, within budget and to VSI's quality standards.
* Select and coordinate the internal teams for each project, including project managers, casting and production coordinators and technical colleagues.
* Work with clients throughout production on the creative brief, approach and approvals.
* Review internal workflows and client-specific requirements, and update client and department guidelines to reflect best practice.
* Communicate clearly and proactively with clients, suppliers and colleagues, arrange production meetings, and give practical advice on complex projects and ad hoc issues, escalating where appropriate.
* Monitor each project's progress weekly to keep it on budget and in line with profitability targets, spotting risks and opportunities to improve delivery, account performance and processes.
* Prepare accurate project updates and reports for the Head of Account Management.
* Support the Head of Account Management with quotes by providing operational input, timelines and cost information.
* Collect all required documentation from talent and staff, such as non-disclosure agreements, agreements of rights and freelancer agreements, and make sure everyone involved follows Health and Safety and Security guidelines.
* Keep project data complete, timely and accurate in our internal systems, including processing purchase orders for supplier and client invoices on time.
* Manage project administration and other operational tasks as needed.
* Look after the security and maintenance of the building, escalate issues to the relevant teams and the Head of Account Management, and make sure the studio is securely locked each day.
* Take on other reasonable tasks that support

##### **What we are looking for**

* Placeholder Bullet Point
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Previous project management experience in localisation, media or a similar fast-paced production environment.
* A good understanding of dubbing workflows.
* A collaborative approach and the ability to coordinate multimedia requirements across production teams while keeping work consistent.
* Excellent organisation and the ability to prioritise when deadlines overlap.
* A proactive, solutions-focused mindset with sound problem-solving skills.
* Flexibility when requirements or priorities change at short notice.
* Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to client service.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and Power BI reporting, with good general technology skills and the ability to support the testing and adoption of new systems.
* Availability and willingness to travel regularly between our Barcelona and Madrid facilities.

##### **It would be helpful if you have**

* Experience with OOONA or a similar project management platform.

##### **Why join VSI**

At VSI, you will join a passionate, highly driven team helping entertainment travel the world. You will have the opportunity to work on high-profile global content, collaborate with talented colleagues and make a visible contribution in a creative, international and fast-moving environment.

We support people to grow their careers alongside experienced colleagues and some of the best talent in the localisation industry.

title: Director of Human Resources — Arquetipo Studio
description:
### **Build what Europe must own**

Building the companies behind Europe’s strategic sovereignty.

Our mission is to originate, operate and capitalise the European companies and technologies our sovereignty depends on.

We are a venture builder focused on dual-use deep tech. Every company we launch is born inside the studio, with its own team, capital and method, and goes to market ready to compete.

We work across three missions:

* **Spectrum Dominance.** Capabilities to operate in, protect and manage data across contested environments.
* **Sovereign Compute.** Secure, certifiable European silicon, ready for post-quantum cryptography.
* **Trusted Autonomy.** High-integrity mission autonomy for uncrewed systems.

Build with us.

### **The role**

We are looking for Arquetipo’s first Head of Human Resources. You won’t inherit a department: you’ll design from scratch how a venture builder attracts, organises, develops and retains Europe’s scarcest talent.

You will report directly to the COO. Your scope won’t be a single company but a system: the studio and each of the ventures born from it, each at its own stage of maturity.

This role isn’t for everyone. If you’re looking for a position with established processes, a large team and a low profile, this isn’t it. If you want your work to show in a continent’s technological capability, read on.

### **What you’ll do**

#### **Talent for critical missions**

* Design and execute the strategy for attracting technical and executive talent to the studio and its ventures.
* Run the recruitment policy, ensuring our talent is aligned with our goals and values.
* Build our own channels with universities, research centres and the wider tech ecosystem, and turn Arquetipo’s mission into an employer brand that attracts people who want to build, not just work.

#### **Organising a venture builder**

* Define the HR management model, tools and ways of working.
* Prepare each venture for independence: its own structure, policies and people team at the moment of spin-out.
* Coordinate employment management across a multi-entity, multi-site environment spanning Madrid, Málaga, Bilbao and our ventures’ locations.

#### **Culture and accountability**

* Translate our values into observable behaviours and real criteria for hiring, evaluation, promotion and exit.
* Design a performance system with clear objectives, identified owners, continuous feedback and consistent consequences.
* Establish a development programme for studio and venture leaders so they lead by example.

#### **Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with employment law and with the specific requirements of the sectors we operate in.
* Drive and oversee the company’s ethics and compliance programme as it relates to people.

#### **What we expect at 90 days**

* Hiring for critical positions under way.
* HR management procedures up and running.
* A standard hiring process, with explicit values assessment, operating across all open positions.
* A proposed compensation & benefits framework.

#### **What we expect at 12 months**

* Critical positions in the hiring plan filled on time.
* An accountability-based performance system in place across the studio and the ventures.
* An HR management model and people playbook that let us launch a new venture in weeks, not months.
* People metrics (turnover, time-to-hire, quality of hire, engagement) presented and defended quarterly before the leadership team.

### **What you need: technical skills**

#### **Essential**

* 5+ years of experience in Human Resources.
* Experience building an HR function from scratch or leading rapid growth in a technology, industrial or engineering company.
* Proven experience hiring scarce technical profiles: hardware, embedded software, critical systems or R&D.
* Strong command of Spanish employment law.
* Experience designing compensation & benefits policies.
* Analytical judgement: you make decisions based on data.
* Professional English (C1 or above).
* Availability to work on-site in Madrid and to travel.
* Eligibility to obtain a personal security clearance.

#### **Nice to have**

* Experience in defence, aerospace, semiconductors, space or other regulated sectors.
* Experience in venture builders, startup studios, groups with multiple portfolio companies or corporate innovation units.
* Postgraduate studies in People Management, Industrial Relations, Organisational Psychology or a related field.

### **What you need: values and ways of working**

Technical skills get you through the door. These decide whether you stay.

* **Accountability.** When something fails in your area, you don’t look for explanations elsewhere. And you build systems so the rest of the team can do the same.
* **You lead by example.** You never ask anyone to do what you wouldn’t do yourself. If you demand transparency or rigour, you’re the first to show it.
* **The mission guides your decisions.** You understand why technological sovereignty matters and turn it into concrete people decisions, even uncomfortable ones.
* **You’re part of the business, not a support function.** You understand the mission, the product, the cash plan and the technical challenges of each venture.
* **You combine closeness with high standards.** You care for people without lowering the bar. You have difficult conversations respectfully, on time and without beating around the bush.
* **Your decisions are guided by our values.** They are the criteria you act on.
* **You do first, then delegate.** At this stage you’ll write policies, run interviews and review contracts yourself. The team will come when the system and growth justify it.
* **Confidentiality.** You’ll handle sensitive information about programmes, partners and people. Discretion is part of the job, not an extra.

### **What we offer**

* The opportunity to design, from the ground up, the organisation of a venture builder that is building strategic capabilities for Europe.
* A seat on the leadership team, with direct influence over which companies we launch and with whom.
* Competitive compensation.
* Working alongside top-tier engineers, researchers and entrepreneurs in semiconductors, autonomy and artificial intelligence.

### **Our process**

* **Interview with the hiring manager** on mission, purpose and leadership style.
* **Interviews with studio and venture leaders**, including people who will work with you every day.
* **References and offer.** We’ll ask for references from people who have seen you lead, not only from those who have supervised you.

We’re not looking for the perfect CV. We’re looking for the person who best understands why we do what we do and who is willing to answer for how we do it.

description:
**Job Purpose:**

The core of this role will be to manage communications for a global manufacturing site including site communication plans, activities, channels and messages that align with GSK and GSC’s (Global Supply Chain) business priorities. You will work closely with the global Communications and Government Affairs team (CGA) aligned to GSK’s Global Supply Chain as well as with the site head and site leadership team.

The successful candidate will be skilled at developing communications which are insight-driven, engaging and delivered in a timely, digestible way for maximum impact, that are inclusive and accessible to all employees and aligned to GSK brand and voice. You will have experience with internal communications and channel management. You will be comfortable coaching leaders on their communications skills and supporting external-, change- and issues communication.

In this role you will:

* Develop and execute the annual site communications plan to help drive employee engagement and align staff around site-, GSC- and GSK strategy and priorities.
* Manage the site’s communication channels in the day-2-day. This includes organising all-site town halls, managing newsletters and digital channels and maintaining the site’s intranet pages up to date.
* Support broader CGA priorities as needed and ensure relevant company news is shared and adapted for local use at the site. Highlight the site's contribution to company priorities by taking part in global engagement campaigns and sharing impactful stories about how the site makes a difference. Create high-impact content to support local site priorities and – operations.
* Use relevant metrics to measure impact and generate insights to drive improvements. This includes conducting feedback surveys, obtaining qualitative feedback through focus groups, measuring view- and engagement rates of digital channels and monitoring progress regularly.
* Embrace technologies and AI tools to increase creativity and impact of communication activities.
* Co-deliver communications trainings in partnership with the global CGA team and advise site head and -leaders on their communication skills.
* Develop change communication plans in collaboration with the global CGA team and execute them to support major site transformations, accelerate adoption to organisational changes and new ways of working.
* Build the site’s external reputation by pro-actively suggesting LinkedIn stories for site leaders as well as local community engagement activities. Collaborate with the LOC on media opportunities and connection with government officials. Develop site-specific communication material such as a narrative and related

assets like video, photography and fact sheets that can be used both for external and internal engagement purposes.

* Help protect the site's local reputation through effective crisis communications.
* Support the site's culture activation and employee engagement plans in collaboration with relevant site leaders, - functions and ERGs.

**Core Capabilities:**

* Strategic internal communication skills: able to design and deliver communication plans that effectively support business priorities and help drive employee engagement.
* Excellent writing and storytelling skills: able to create engaging, high-impact content.
* Effective channel management: capable of managing different types of communication channels (online/offline, virtual/in-person) autonomously.
* Stakeholder management and influencing skills: Well-connected into the broader communications network. Recognised as a reference for advice on effective communications by site leadership, CGA peers and LOC. Able to actively listen and translate global messages so that they resonate locally.
* Effective use of data and insights: familiar with how to measure impact of communication channels and activities to continuously improve.
* Able to apply brand standards: effectively translate the company’s tone of voice to fit site communications. Develop communication materials that comply with the company’s visual identity.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in communications or equivalent
* Minimum 3 years of experience working in a communications role
* Strong project management skills with ability to work under pressure and effectively prioritize work
* Excellent cultural awareness
* Ability to deal with sensitive issues confidentially
* Ability to get things done

**Preferred Qualifications**:

  

The following characteristics are a plus:

* Experience working in a manufacturing/industrial environment
* As part of a global company, ability to speak and write in English professionally
* Experience with external communication, change communication and crisis communications
* Experience with training and coaching leaders on their communication skills

**Skills**

Content Development, Corporate Copywriting, Data Analytics, Digital Fluency, Reputation Management, Risk Management, Stakeholder Management, Storytelling, Strategic Planning

title: Manager Video Creative Development
description:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.

**Job Description**
===================

Location:

Madrid, ES

**Visión general**

  

Los equipos de vídeo digital global de Condé Nast crean contenido de vídeo de primera calidad que generan más de 1.000 millones de visualizaciones al mes a nivel global, con más de 4.000 episodios al año entre unscripted, documentales, comerciales y relacionados con eventos.

  

El objetivo de este rol Manager Video Creative Development, que reporta al Head of Video Programming & Development (Spain) y estará ubicado en nuestras oficinas de Madrid, es **desarrollar, desde el punto de vista creativo, la presencia audiovisual de las marcas de Condé Nast en español** **VOGUE, GQ, Architectural Digest y Condé Nast Traveler** , mediante contenido de vídeo original, en serie o one shots, para plataformas digitales globales (O&O, Youtube, Tiktok, Facebook, Instagram…) con foco en máxima calidad, escalable y replicable en plataformas y mercados: series icónicas que trascienden plataformas y mercados, que multiplican el impacto de momentos culturales locales y globales, conectan a las marcas de Condé Nast con las audiencias más interesantes y crean oportunidades de integración publicitaria para las marcas más importantes del mercado.

  

**Responsabilidades**

  

* Desarrollar nuevas IP de vídeo y podcast según los objetivos y prioridades editoriales y comerciales de las marcas de Condé Nast, que sean replicables y adaptables en distintos mercados y plataformas.
* Generar tanto ideas sobre la base de series preexistentes como nuevos pilotos, en serie o one shots, con el máximo nivel de calidad en narrativa y estilo visual. Trabajar con los equipos de optimización y redes sociales para maximizar el rendimiento de cada idea en todas las plataformas.
* Dirigir in situ episodios y one-shots, definiendo el lenguaje visual de las marcas y trabajando con el equipo de producción para liderar a los equipos técnicos y artísticos.

title: Hospitality Loyalty Application Support Specialist- Madrid based
description:
**Company Description**

Radisson Hotel Group is one of the world's largest hotel groups with ten distinctive hotel brands, and more than 1,460 hotels in operation and under development in 95+ countries. The Group’s overarching brand promise is Every Moment Matters with a signature Yes I Can! service ethos.

People are at the core of our business success and future. Our people are true Moment Makers and together we bring the culture, spirit, environment and opportunities that empower you to be your best, every day, everywhere, every time. Together, we make Every Moment Matter.

 **Job Description**

Do you have a passion for hospitality and a sharp eye for tech? Join our International Global Hospitality IT Support team!

From resolving system issues to optimizing configurations, you’ll be the bridge between hotel teams and backoffice tech solutions.

**Team Mission:**

We’re looking for tech-savvy, hospitality focused individuals to join a new team within our Hospitality IT Support area. If you come with a background in hotel operations like Reservations, Loyalty programs or Customer care departments this may be for you.

The Hospitality IT Support team is responsible for ensuring the availability, accuracy, and optimal performance of the reservation platform that supports hotel distribution, loyalty program, and guest bookings. The role combines technical support, operational awareness, and close collaboration with business stakeholders.

Contribute to the continued success of Radisson Rewards, our loyalty program serving more than 27 million members worldwide. Your role will be to provide first hand support for application errors and support requests from hotel users. You will be responsible for solving training issues and making configuration changes to the system, as well as managing tickets in our support tool ServiceNow when an issue needs to be passed to a more technical support team. The successful candidate will be skilled in building strong and trusting relationships with our hotel users and Loyalty teams, so that we can transform the relationship they have with IT from a transactional relationship to a deep trusting one that will benefit both our hotel employees and customers.

We offer an agile, professional, efficient, and process orientated support function to the Radisson community, which includes guest facing staff and back-office teams, in areas such as Front Office, Meetings & Events, Point of Sale and CRS.

All our activities are based on industry standard best practices (ITIL) and require constant contact with end users (hotel teams) and technical support teams, both RHG’s and external vendors.

**Role purpose:**

**The primary purposes of the Application Support Specialist role are:**

* Gain a deep technical knowledge in RHG’s central Loyalty program, based on SAP TMSForHotels product, named EMMA after RHG’s moto: Every Moment Matters.
* Understand both RHG and your specific Hotels business processes and structure to provide relevant and valuable support to the organization.
