* Support and troubleshoot integrations between the CRS and related systems such as PMS, channel managers, booking engines, revenue management tools, and third-party distribution channels.
* Ensure correct data flow for rates, reservations, redemptions, points balance, Radisson Rewards accounts and confirmations.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to resolve interface failures or data mismatches
* Perform on demand configurations in the system application requested by the hotels.
* Document new processes and troubleshooting documents for both the team and end user’s benefit.

**What we offer:**

* You would be joining an international and dynamic team, working for one of the top Hotel chains in the world.
* Surrounded by highly skilled professionals with both Hospitality and IT backgrounds, the position offers end-to-end experience in hotel loyalty Operations with a strong focus on technology services for hospitality, the area leading the biggest changes and improvements in the hotel business.
* The position offers a competitive salary package, with great work-like balance for the hospitality industry standards and company benefits.

**Key roles and responsibilities**

* **Service Operations and Delivery:** Responsible for delivering high quality services to the RHG community.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Operate as a point of interaction/escalation for Requests for Information, Configuration and Incidents.
* **3rd Party Intermediator:** Interact as needed with partners to ensure prompt resolution of incidents.
* **People Management:** From stakeholders to external partners, we ensure that proper relations are established across the board.
* **General:** Ensure a high degree of collaboration and good team spirit is achieved across all parties.
* Must be able to interact with confidence with hotel senior staff, like Heads of Department and General Managers

  
**Qualifications**

**Location:**

* Madrid, Spain

**Language skills:**

* Full English Proficiency is a must
* French proficiency is a plus

**Education:**

* Bachelor's Degree in International Hotel Management, Hospitality Management or related field
* A recognized ITIL certification at Foundation level or above is highly desirable
* SAP Certifications are highly desirable

  
**Additional Information**

Why Join Radisson Hotel Group?  
  
Live the Magic of Hospitality - Be part of a team that creates exceptional experiences and memorable moments every day. Let your Yes I Can! spirit shine as you bring hospitality to life.  
  
Build a Great Career - No matter your background or experience, we invest in your growth, learning, and career development—helping you reach your full potential.  
  
Experience the Team Spirit - Join a workplace that’s inclusive, fun, and meaningful. We celebrate diversity, support one another and foster a sense of belonging through our Employee Resource Groups and inclusion initiatives.  
  
Lead with Your Ambition - Your ideas, passion and drive matter! We empower you to make a difference—in hospitality, your community and beyond.  
  
Enjoy Global & Local Perks - No matter where you’re located, you’ll enjoy exclusive global benefits - like special hotel rates for you and your loved ones at our hotels worldwide. Plus, you’ll have access to local perks and rewards tailored to your country, making your experience even more rewarding!  
  
Enjoy benefits such as - up to 53% off your stay as a Team Member at over 1,500 Radisson Hotels worldwide  
Guaranteed minimum of 30% off for your Friends & Family  
Exclusive Discounts on Breakfast, Food & Beverage, Spa and more  
  
Join us in shaping the future of hospitality! If you’re ready to bring your talent, energy, and passion, we’d love to hear from you.  
  
Apply now and let’s make every moment matter.

description:
**Highly Skilled Specialist Technician for the Bioassay Laboratory (Ref: KTT 2026-03)**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Institute of Chemical Research of Catalonia (ICIQ) is seeking a Highly Skilled Specialist Technician for the Bioassay Laboratory to conduct *in vitro* ADME-Tox assays and coordinate biological evaluation of compounds within the institute. The successful candidate will contribute to the expansion of ICIQ’s activities in chemical biology, molecular medicine, and drug discovery, supporting the validation of biologically active compounds and fostering collaborations with internal and external research partners. This position will play a key role in establishing and managing biological assay platforms, providing scientific guidance to research groups, and strengthening the institute’s translational research activities at the interface between chemistry and biology.

The position is funded by the ‘Severo Ochoa’ Centres of Excellence programme, reference CEX2024-001469-S, funded by MICIU/AEI/10.13039/501100011033.

ICIQ is looking for a Highly Skilled Specialist Technician for the Bioassay Laboratory to lead the development and implementation of a Bioassay Laboratory in order to be able to perform *in vitro* ADME-Tox profiling of chemical entities within the institute, including: determination of activity against biological targets; screening of potential targets; metabolic stability; assess cytotoxicity, mutagenicity, permeability; etc. The position will support ICIQ’s strategic growth in chemical biology, molecular medicine and drug discovery by establishing, coordinating and overseeing biological evaluation activities for research projects across the institute. The Bioassay Laboratory will form part of the Knowledge and Technology Transfer and Industrial Projects Department, and the selected candidate will work closely with ICIQ research groups and external collaborators. The Highly Skilled Specialist Technician for the Bioassay Laboratory will design and manage biological assay workflows, contribute to the evaluation of biologically active compounds, set up a laboratory space, and define need of equipment and consumables required for the daily operations of the Laboratory, and provide scientific and technical expertise at the interface between chemistry and biology. The selected candidate should be skilled to be able to synthesise, isolate and characterise chemical compounds, when needed. The role will also play a key part in identifying new opportunities, establishing strategic collaborations, and supporting the translation of research outcomes towards biomedical and industrial applications. The position will contribute to the consolidation of biological evaluation capabilities at ICIQ and help strengthen the institute’s activities in emerging areas of chemical biology, molecular medicine and translational research.

**Responsibilities**

* Ensure that the requirements to set up a Bioassay Laboratory are fulfilled: purchase of equipment, consumables and reagents.
* Ensure the space dedicated to the Bioassay Laboratory is adequate and up to date of all safety and quality requirements
* Set up protocols to conduct ADME-Tox experiments, including: determination of activity against biological targets; screening of potential targets; metabolic stability; assess cytotoxicity, mutagenicity, permeability, etc.
* Conduct experimental work to provide ADME-Tox results
* Synthesis, characterisation and isolation of compounds to assess their ADME-Tox properties
* Explore public and private funding sources

**Requirements**

* Ph.D. in life sciences discipline: Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, or equivalent
* Experience in working in biological assays
* Experience in the preparation, isolation and characterisation of chemical compounds
* Good knowledge of English (written and spoken)

**Valued qualities**

* Good communication skills
* Strong commitment for scientific excellence
* Motivated, creative, and problem-solving individual capable of working independently as well as in a team
* Previous experience in working in medicinal chemistry programs
* Previous experience in working with animal models

**We offer**

* A full-time contract linked to the project CEX2024-001469-S
* Incorporation: February 2027
* An international and dynamic environment within a multidisciplinary team
* Annual salary split into 12 monthly payments.
* Remuneration aligned with the company’s salary policy, within the PTTAGE1 – PTTAGE5 band (32.960 – 41.200 EUR), based on the candidate’s qualifications and experience.
* Flexible 37.5 hours working week
* Free parking available at our facilities.
* Continuous training plan to support your professional development.
* Good connection to public transportation networks.
* Facilities with spacious areas, abundant natural light, and a functional, well‑designed environment aimed at enhancing people’s wellbeing.

**OTM-R principles in the selection processes**

ICIQ follows the principles of Open, Transparent and Merit-based Recruitment (OTM-R) and the Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers as established by the European Commission.

ICIQ follows in its selection process a gender equality opportunity policy and a non-discrimination policy on the basis of age, ethnic or social origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation, language and disability.

ICIQis committed to promoting a work-life balance for its employees and, as such, offers flexible working hours.

The Selection Committee for this process is composed of:

* **Fernando Bravo**; ICIQ’s KTT Manager
* **Elisabet Vilella**, Subdirector IRB CatSud (external member)
* **Marga Nadal**; Director of IDIBGI (external member)

A Human Resources Unit representative will participate in the interviews to ensure procedural correctness and compliance with OTM R principles, without forming part of the Selection Committee.

The evaluation committee will perform the assessment ensuring the absence of conflict of interest with any of the candidates, and will sign a Declaration of Absence of Conflict of Interest (DACI) to that end. In case a conflict of interest arises, the evaluator will be substituted by a different evaluator with similar expertise.

The interview will last approximately 30 minutes and will be conducted in English. During the first 10-15 minutes, you will be asked to provide a short presentation about your background.

**Selection Process**

ICIQ’s selection process usually entails the following phases:

* **Pre-selection:** The pre-selection process will be based on qualifications and expertise as reflected on the candidates’ CVs. This phase is merit-based.
* **Interview:** Preselected candidates will be interviewed by the Hiring Manager of the position and the appointed Selection Committee.
* **Offer Letter:** Once the successful candidate is selected, the People Unit will extend a Job Offer, specifying the start day, salary and overall job conditions.

For further information, you can visit our HR Excellence in Research page at: HR Excellence in Research (iciq.org)

This position is funded by the ‘Severo Ochoa’ Centres of Excellence programme, reference CEX2024-001469-S, funded by MICIU/AEI/10.13039/501100011033.

title: Administrative Case Manager & Accessibility Liaison
description:
Job Description:

**Job Title:** Administrative Case Manager & Accessibility Liaison

**Start Date:** January 7 or as soon as possible

**Department:** Student Affairs, Diversity & Inclusion

**Reports to:** Valencia Director of Student Affairs, Diversity and Inclusion

**Location:** Valencia, Spain (On-site)

**Contract type:** Full time position

**Schedule:** Monday – Friday, 1:00 PM – 9:00 PM CET

**Reports To:** Valencia Director of Student Affairs, Diversity and Inclusion

**Position Overview**

Reporting to the Director of Student Affairs, Diversity and Inclusion, the Administrative Case Manager works in consultation and collaboration with internal and external partners to assist students in accessing support for health and wellness related concerns and navigating barriers to success. This position provides 1:1 consultation with students, and supports essential functions related to interventions with students of concern.

The position includes coordination with various resources in Valencia (and Boston when applicable) as well as with external resources (e.g. contracted counseling service providers, health insurance, contracted health care providers).

The position operates strictly within an administrative, non-clinical scope, focusing on triage, documentation, compliance, and cross-departmental coordination to ensure student success and campus safety. While this is not a clinical position, sensitivity, judgment, and respect for confidentiality is required. The successful candidate will facilitate support for students/parents/family members during both urgent and non-urgent situations, many of which involve mental and physical challenges. The Administrative Case Manager helps ensure appropriate care and follow-up for students in need of additional resources, helping to coordinate a comprehensive plan of care with appropriate colleagues across multiple units of the College.

In addition to primary shift duties, **this position participates in the campus administrator on-call rotation**, serving as a key escalation point for after-hours student health, safety, and psychological emergencies.

Additionally, this position is the primary campus liaison to Boston’s Accessibility Resources for Students, who determines reasonable academic, housing, and dietary accommodations. The position is responsible for connecting students to the Boston team and ensuring reasonable accommodations are implemented for students studying at Berklee Valencia.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS/PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Administrative Case Manager:

* Review and provide outreach to student concerns submitted as Health and Wellness Early Alerts and other incident reports; engage appropriate parties in the response where necessary.
* Apply standardized non-clinical behavioral threat assessment frameworks and related tools to provide and advise on appropriate interventions.
* Support the Director as the operational coordinator for the CARES Team, managing workflows in student database, liaising directly with the Valencia Director for Student Affairs
* Maintain accurate, timely documentation case management records and ensure compliance with both US higher education standards (FERPA/Title IX principles) and applicable local Spanish/EU data protection laws (GDPR).

* Coordinate safety plans, behavioral risk assessments, emergency communications, and multi-departmental support (e.g., accessibility services, residence hall staff, medical assistance team, and/or other community resources) across varying levels of student concern.

title: Presenter - GCN en Español
description:
**Department:**

GCN en Español

 **Contract:**

Fixed-term cover, February – July 2027

**Location**

: You’ll be based in Girona

**Reporting to**

:

Director of Pro Cycling in the UK

**Job purpose**
---------------

To represent GCN en Español on and off screen, creating and presenting engaging, entertaining and informative cycling content for our Spanish-speaking audience.

The role will involve being a key on-screen personality for the channel, presenting a wide range of video formats, from cycling news and race analysis to technical features, product testing, challenges and practical cycling advice.

The successful candidate will also contribute to the creative development of the channel, researching and pitching ideas, writing scripts, planning content and working closely with the wider production team to deliver videos that engage existing viewers and attract new audiences.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about cycling, knowledgeable about the sport and its industry, confident in front of the camera and able to bring personality, insight and energy to our content.

**Purpose / mission of the department**
---------------------------------------

To grow GCN en Español as a leading destination for Spanish-speaking cycling fans around the world.

This means growing our audience, views and subscribers, while continually developing the breadth, quality and appeal of our content. We aim to inform, entertain and inspire cyclists through original, relevant and engaging video content covering all aspects of the sport and cycling culture.

**Success outcomes (within the fixed-term contract)**
-----------------------------------------------------

By the end of the contract, the successful candidate will have:

* Successfully integrated into the GCN en Español team and established a strong rapport with the existing presenters and production team.
* Confidently presented and contributed to a variety of the channel's regular content and social formats.
* Researched, developed and pitched original ideas that have been progressed into engaging video content.
* Demonstrated the ability to independently research, script and present content to a consistently high standard.
* Contributed to the growth and engagement of the GCN en Español audience through compelling, relevant and entertaining content.
* Represented the channel professionally at cycling events, races and industry activities where required.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Presenting and content creation**

* Be one of the key faces and voices of GCN en Español, representing the channel on camera and across its various platforms.
* Present a wide range of content, including cycling news, technical features, product reviews, challenges, entertainment, interviews and practical advice.
* Bring energy, personality, humour and authenticity to presentations, helping to create an engaging relationship with our audience.
* Research, develop and pitch original content ideas that reflect the interests of our Spanish-speaking cycling audience.
* Write scripts, prepare presentations and work with producers and other team members to plan and deliver content.
* Take ownership of individual video projects where appropriate, from initial idea and research through to filming and delivery.
* Actively engage with the GCN en Español audience across social media platforms, helping to build a strong and loyal cycling community.

### **Cycling knowledge and technical content**

* Present informative and engaging technical content, including bike and component reviews, product comparisons, testing and explanations of new cycling technology.
* Present practical how-to content covering bike maintenance, riding techniques, training, fitness and cycling skills.
* Demonstrate products and techniques both in the studio and out on location, providing viewers with useful, accessible and credible advice.
* Use personal cycling knowledge and experience to provide insight, context and credibility to the content.
* Keep up to date with developments in the cycling industry, new products, trends and innovations.

### **Racing and industry coverage**

* Research and present cycling news, race reports and analysis, particularly around major professional stage races and one-day events.
* Present technical and feature content from professional cycling races and other industry events.
* Use industry contacts to arrange and conduct interviews with professional riders, teams, mechanics and other key figures in cycling.
* Help bring the stories, personalities and developments from the professional peloton to life for our audience.
* Attend race events and other locations as required to produce relevant and engaging content.

### **Teamwork and channel development**

* Work closely with International Content Creators, Production team and other presenters to ensure content aligns with the channel's objectives and overall GCN strategy.
* Collaborate with other GCN channels and the wider Play Sports Network team where opportunities arise.
* Contribute positively to the creative culture of the team, sharing ideas and supporting the development of new formats and content opportunities.
* Assist other members of the GCN team as and when required.

### **Commercial Content and Partner Relationships**

* Present branded and sponsored content for GCN en Español, working with commercial partners to deliver engaging video content that meets agreed campaign objectives.
* Work collaboratively with the commercial, production and editorial teams to develop creative ideas and concepts for partner-led content.
* Confidently integrate brand messaging, products and key campaign messages into video content in a natural, engaging and authentic way.
* Present product demonstrations, reviews, sponsored features and other commercial formats while maintaining the tone, personality and credibility of GCN.
* Build positive working relationships with commercial partners and represent GCN professionally during filming, events and other partner-facing activities.
* Understand the importance of delivering content that meets both audience expectations and commercial commitments.

**Skills, experience and attributes**
-------------------------------------

**Essential:**

* An elite-level road cyclist, comfortable demonstrating riding techniques and participating in cycling challenges and features.
* Good knowledge of, and contacts within, professional road cycling and the cycling industry, with knowledge of its equipment and technology.
* Passionate about cycling, with understanding of its overall culture and audience.
* Native/fluent Spanish speaker with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Good ability in spoken and written English to communicate effectively with the wider Play Sports Network team, the majority of which are based in the UK.
* Confident and engaging on camera, with the ability to communicate information clearly and naturally.
* Creative, curious and able to generate interesting and original content ideas.
* Research, scriptwriting and storytelling skills.
* Flexible, organised and able to work effectively in a fast-paced production environment.
* A positive team player who can also work well independently and take ownership of projects.

**Desirable:**

* Previous experience presenting video or digital content.
* Experience in journalism, broadcasting, video production or content creation.
* Experience presenting technical cycling content, product reviews or race coverage.

title: Senior Analyst/ Associate Director, FIs - Spanish banks, Madrid
description:
Requisition ID: 50969

Business Unit: Fitch Ratings

Category: Credit Analysis & Research

Location:
Madrid, M, ES

Date Posted: Nov 13, 2026

**Fitch Ratings is currently seeking a Senior Analyst or Associate Director, Fis – Spanish Banks based out of our Madrid office.**

  

As one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, Fitch Ratings plays a critical role in global capital markets by providing supplementary credit analysis, ratings, research, and commentary to financial market participants. For over 100 years, Fitch Ratings has been creating value for global markets through its rigorous analysis and deep expertise, which have resulted in a variety of market leading tools, methodologies, indices, research, and analytical products. Fitch Ratings is part of Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries, which also includes Fitch Solutions. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst.

  

At Fitch Ratings, credit analysts play a pivotal role in moving markets, as quality credit analysis is the lifeblood of our organization. With a legacy of over a century, our unique approach to credit ratings offers unmatched opportunities for professional growth. Embracing a “challenger mindset,” you'll join a team dedicated to innovating service to our clients. Our people-driven analysis thrives on collaboration across all levels and locations, surpassing traditional financial modeling. Lastly, as part of our global community, you'll find inspiration, challenge, and support, with ample opportunities for visibility and influence in the global financial marketplace.

  

Want to learn more about a career as a credit analyst at Fitch Ratings? Visit: https://careers.fitch.group/content/Credit-Analysts/

  

**About the Team**

  

The Fitch Ratings Financial Institutions Group has actively built the agency into the global leader in bank credit rating coverage. Our experienced analysts provide comprehensive, timely and transparent coverage of major institutions around the world, as well as unparalleled coverage of smaller companies. Our analysts offer a diversity of talent and backgrounds, with experience in regulatory oversight, counterparty analysis, auditing, investment banking, buy-side investing and more.

  

**How You’ll Make an Impact:**

* Monitoring a portfolio of issuer ratings, including the preparation of rating committee materials
* Analysis of financial institutions sector and individual banks data, update of financial excel-based tools and charts
* Writing and publishing of comprehensive rating reports on individual issuers
* Participation in credit rating committees for banks in the allocated region and other countries
* Regular interaction with contacts at issuers and with issuers’ senior management at rating meetings
* Participation in the publication of sector-specific research and commentary, including preparation of peer data, country snapshots and sector background information
* Assist as needed in the coverage of other banks in the portfolio; including working with other team members to prepare committee materials, peer tables or analytical tools, reviewing annual and interim accounts and completing ad-hoc data requests

  

**You May be a Good Fit if:**

* Proven analytical experience (ideally between 4 and 6 years), ideally in credit- or audit-related fields, gained from working at a commercial/investment bank, accountancy firm, buy-side firm, regulatory authority, rating agency, or similar.
* Background in either financial institutions or corporate credit analysis. Experience in bank analysis and banking regulation is desirable.
* Excellent demonstrable written and verbal communication skills in Spanish (native level) and English are essential.
* Ability to work independently as well as being a good team player.
* Ability to cope with time pressure and work to deadlines.
* Strong writing and communication skills as well as strong command of financial statement analysis.
* Proficient in Excel
* A drive for innovation and appetite to find smart ways to implement AI into daily analytical tasks.

This position will involve occasional travel, primarily within Europe.

  

**What Would Make You Stand Out:**

* Knowledge of another European language such as Portuguese is desired but not essential.
* University degree level, preferably with professional qualifications (such as CFA).

  

**Why Choose Fitch:**

* **Hybrid Work Environment:** 3 days a week in office required
* **A Culture of Learning & Mobility:** Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity
* **Investing in Your Future:** Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals
* **Promoting Health & Wellbeing:** Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing
* **Supportive Parenting Policies:** Family-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
* **Inclusive Work Environment**: A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe
* **Dedication to Giving Back:** Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community

  

At Fitch, AI is embedded in how we work every day—supporting smarter decision-making, streamlining workflows, and enabling new ways to create value for our business and clients. Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day-to-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We’re looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI-enabled environment—or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. We value professionals who embrace technology as part of continuous learning and who are committed to using it thoughtfully to enhance how work gets done.

  

Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch’s credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interest or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will be asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work.

  

Fitch is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We evaluatequalified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law.

title: Public Relations & Marketing Assistant Manager - Four Seasons Resort Mallorca at Formentor
description:
Job ID: REQ10397675

Four Seasons Mallorca at Formentor

Location: Illes Balears, Illes Balears, Spain

widget: Full time

  

**About Four Seasons:**

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.
  
  
At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

**About the location:**

Welcome to Four Seasons Resort Mallorca at Formentor. Perched on the spectacular Formentor Peninsula, surrounded by the Mediterranean Sea and the breathtaking landscapes of Mallorca, Four Seasons Resort Mallorca at Formentor is a truly extraordinary place to work. Originally opened in 1929, this iconic retreat has been reimagined following an extensive restoration, reopening in August 2024 as Four Seasons’ first resort in Mallorca. Set within a vast private estate, the Resort combines its rich heritage and poetic charm with contemporary luxury and the warm, authentic spirit of Spanish hospitality. Here, nature, history and exceptional service come together to create an inspiring environment for both our guests and our people. Join our team and become part of the story of Formentor — a place where careers are shaped by meaningful experiences, genuine connections and the opportunity to deliver the exceptional, every day.

**About the Role** 
***Reports to: Director of PR & Marketing***
----------------------------------------------------------------

Supports The PR & Marketing Director in developing and executing public relations and marketing initiatives for the hotel.

In conjugation with Commercial Director, Director of PR & Marketing, the PR & Marketing Assistant Manager plays an integral role in the development and execution of the annual strategic commercial plan comprised of public relations, social media, and marketing communications strategies that support the business objectives. Through strategic thinking and execution, increase awareness and visibility, the PR & Marketing Assistant Manager also contributes to driving traffic and revenues. The role also require the involvement in the F&B and SPA marketing strategy, creating and executing marketing and promotional strategies to attract new clients and retain existing ones.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Executes all key PR & Marketing initiatives as defined below:

**Strategic planning & performance:**

* Apply market intelligence, consumer trends, guest insights, and competitive analysis to guide positioning and data-driven decision-making. Adjust strategies as market conditions evolve.
* Supports The PR & Marketing Director in developing the PR and Marketing strategy and support channel plans aligned with commercial goals and property priorities.
* Lead the creation and execution of the integrated marketing and communications calendar, including campaign plans, global brand initiatives, and on‑property activations and F&B promotions.
* Identify and analyze seasonal trends, key moments, priority feeder markets, and target audiences to inform annual marketing and campaign planning.
* Establish and monitor a local measurement framework (KPIs); track Property Scorecard metrics; conduct post-campaign analysis to inform future initiatives.
* Maximize adoption of global brand initiatives and campaigns in local and feeder markets to showcase the property’s distinctive guest experiences.
* Champion brand stewardship at the property level by ensuring consistent execution of brand guidelines with local relevance and adherence to governance processes.

**Digital Marketing**

* Liase with the Digital Marketing Manager on the resort digital strategy and ensure marketing funds are distributed accordingly.
* Lead integrated marketing campaigns across paid, owned, and earned channels to drive reach, conversion, and aspiration, ensuring seamless orchestration and alignment with brand guidelines.
* Develop and execute social media and owned-channel content strategies; create influencer and content creator programs (hosted stays, collaborations) to extend reach and engagement.
* Analyse performance dashboards, monitor performance against targets and partner with agencies to optimize social and digital performance in real time (investment, content, targeting, cadence) based on insights.

**PR**

  

* Oversee online reputation management by monitoring and ensuring appropriate management of third-party review sites.
* Lead creation of Press Releases (brief to copywriters) for PR agencies.
* Activate the property’s unique positioning through compelling storytelling and creative expression.
* Liaise with the PR team to plan, develop the public relations strategy such as management and follow-up with PR agency, organizing events, one-on-one interviews with media, KOL’s and key accounts that are potential for the hotel.
* Execute an annual awards strategy aligned with brand priorities, overseeing submissions for hospitality, travel, lifestyle, culinary, wellness, and sustainability awards.
* Support community relations and Four Seasons for Good initiatives, ensuring alignment with brand values and local stakeholder expectations.

**Brand/Creative**

* Lead and oversees any related photo- and videoshoots to ensure all hotel visual assets are in line with the FS brand standards.
* Maintain owned web content across Four Seasons digital platforms, ensuring accuracy, compelling storytelling, and alignment with positioning, increasing organic search visibility and conversion goals.
* Develop and preserves brand, visual identity and concept in all elements of the marketing process.

**Collaborations and Activations**

* Create hotel, culinary and social experiences such as seasonal events and happenings to foster revenue opportunities through customer insights.
* Build and maintain a close relationship with events intermediaries, organizing happenings that lead to strategic alliances and sales opportunities.  
  Develop collaboration/ sponsorship opportunities.
* Lead marketing planning for partnerships with key luxury brands.

**Profit Functions**

* Set and control Marketing Budget and Expenses and is responsible for updating Commercial Director and Director of PR & Marketing about expenses for forecast purposes.

* Track ROI and present monthly results of marketing efforts (PR, Activities & Events) and expenses on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis.
* Responsible for processing relevant invoices and purchase orders, and maintain operational expenses for monthly expense management.

**People Function**

* Maintains positive client and media relations, develop and build strong connection with local/global press and journalists along side the PR team.
* Plays a key role in reputation management. Act as a key strategic partner on property, ensuring communications efforts advance both brand equity and measurable commercial outcomes.
* Serve as the property’s positioning champion, ensuring awareness, understanding, and engagement with the property’s positioning across all employees.
* Participate in local community and industry events.
* Attend internal meetings and will be actively involved in maintaining communication and promotional calendars.

**What You Bring:**

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Exceptional communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal (coaching, coordinating) skills, required to support a diverse team of employees and agencies on a daily basis.
* Able to achieve under pressure - multiple tasks and time constraints
* Excellent project management skills - able to conceive and implement projects from start to finish, manage processes and expectations, and build commitment to deadlines, both individually or in a matrix structure with multiple managers and indirect stakeholders
* Pro-active and inquisitive mind set to develop problem solving, decision making, conflict resolution and strategic thinking skills
* Understands F&B marketplace; well-informed of market trends and user behaviors, including leading marketing strategies unique to this category and evaluating the competition’s marketing communications activities and implements change as dictated by market requirements
* Well-organized, able to set priorities and be detail-oriented
* Is an ambassador of the hotel at all times, both inside and out into the community
* Collaborative approach with skill in building solid relationships across property and external stakeholders.
Strategic mindset combined with strong tactical execution capability  

**Technical Skills and Knowledge**

* Excellent writing, presentation and communications skills, with a strong sense of quality and a creative mind set
* Photography skills and an eye for aesthetic
* Media relations experience
* Ability to interpret market intelligence and consumer insights to inform strategy and positioning.
* Expertise in integrated PR and marketing strategies across Paid, Owned, and Earned channels.
* Strong creative judgment for evaluating visual and written content to ensure alignment with brand identity
* In-depth understanding of affluent consumer behavior and luxury brand standards

**Who will thrive here:**

You are:

* A storyteller with commercial instincts.
* Equally comfortable presenting strategy to executives and hosting media guests.
* Passionate about luxury hospitality and guest experiences.
* Curious about emerging trends, technology, and consumer behavior
* Able to balance creativity with accountability and performance analysis.

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunities for career growth and advancement within a global hospitality brand.
* Comprehensive training and development opportunities to enhance your skills and knowledge.
* Employee meals available at the staff restaurant.
* Employee recognition programs focused on engagement and career progression.
* Complimentary uniform dry-cleaning service.

**Schedule & Hours:**  
This position is based at the hotel and requires flexibility, with the possibility of working varying shifts, weekends, and holidays, as needed.

The candidate must have the legal right to work in Spain.

title: Head of Content (Temporary)
description:
**The Head of Content is a strategic leadership position designed to act as the key bridge between the creative vision and operational execution. Reporting directly to the Brand Director, it will partner closely with the Art Director, the Design team, and the Digital department to orchestrate omnichannel (ON and OFF) campaigns through all project stages.**

**The mission of the position is to define and lead Camper’s content strategy within the Brand and GTM framework, and translate it into an integrated editorial, creative-production and delivery system across channels.**

**The ideal candidate is a senior leader with a strong background in advertising agencies or client-side marketing teams. You must bring a strategic mindset, exceptional leadership skills, a problem-solving aptitude, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.**

**The Content Department serves as the visual and narrative engine of the brand across all commercial, corporate and market touchpoints. Operating as a strategic in-house agency hub, its mission is to provide high-quality creative solutions to key areas such as Digital, Product and consumers to elevate our storytelling, effectively communicate our products, and drive both sales and brand positioning objectives.**

**This position is temporary.**

**Responsibilities**

* **Strategic Leadership: Create, lead, and execute the company's global content strategy, ensuring total alignment with Camper's business objectives.**
* **Campaign Management: Direct cross-channel global campaigns from brief to execution, optimizing resource allocation, maximizing deliverables, and ensuring KPIs are consistently met or exceeded.**
* **Operational Excellence: Ensure the successful delivery of all projects—on-time, within scope, and within budget. Coordinate internal and external resources, establish robust project management frameworks, and maintain strict budgetary control.**
* **Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate deeply with the Art Director, Digital, eCommerce, and Product departments to ensure that all content meets the strategic and commercial needs of the business.**
* **Performance Analysis: Measure, analyze, and report on the effectiveness of content and design campaigns, leveraging data to drive continuous adjustments, optimizations, and strategic improvements.**

**Requirements**

* **Experience: Proven senior-level experience (7+ years) in similar roles, with a strong background working in advertising agencies or client-side for global brands.**
* **Education: Bachelor’s degree in comms or marketing related fields**
* **Leadership: Demonstrated experience in project management and leading multidisciplinary creative teams (designers, copywriters, external partners) in a dynamic environment.**
* **Strategic & Operational Skills: Ability to think strategically and solve problems creatively, providing multiple solutions to a given project challenge. Solid organizational skills, including acute attention to detail, deadlines, and budget management.**
* **Technical Knowledge: In-depth knowledge of design, content creation tools, and project management technologies.**
* **Communication: Excellent written, verbal communication, and presentation skills. Must be highly comfortable managing complex stakeholder relationships.**
* **Languages: Fluent in English; Spanish is a strong plus.**
* **Mindset: A collaborative team player with a strong problem-solving aptitude.**

title: Head of Organic Growth, Kraken Pro
Senior Nuke Compositor
description:
**Flying Bark Productions is a dynamic and innovative animation studio dedicated to pushing the boundaries of character animation and storytelling. We are working on exciting projects such as Avatar: The Last Airbender feature film, Netflix's Ghostbusters animated series and Stranger Things animated series as well as upcoming feature film, Zac Power.**

As a Senior Nuke Compositor you will work closely with Lighting TDs and creative Leads in order to achieve the creative brief set out by the VFX Supervisor. You will be able to confidently use the tools or software provided, and play a critical role in the execution and delivery of the high quality visual style of the production.

**About you:**

* Minimum requirement of 6+ years production experience in 3D animated films and/or animated episodic;
* Portfolios with mature, graphic stylization of reality preferred. Somewhat in the vein of Spiderverse, Entergalactic, Arcane and The Witness [Love, Death, Robots] ;
* Using Nuke Compositing software, meet the brief for the film that fulfils the creative standards of the project as advised by the Compositing Supervisor
* Ability to tackle shots creatively, whilst keeping an eye on continuity and taking responsibility for their final look
* Ability to think of creative solutions to enhance shots, without overshadowing the overall story point or animation, including but not limited to, the addition of adding atmos, vignettes, depth of field
* Able to seamlessly work with 2D, CG and/or 2.5D shots, understanding limitations in 2D and CG animation pipelines when required
* Able to manage their time allocated to their assigned work
* Able to be organized and methodical, dealing with large amounts of shots, tracking versions and render management
* Producing final shots with neat and well labelled node network, with reference to files in correct locations and easy to navigate filing systems
* Being proactive and communicative with the upstream teams and production, ensuring the efficient delivery of animation layers to compositing
* Communicate with the Pipeline team and aid in implementing improvements to the Comp pipeline
* Able to take direction from the Supervisor/s and Lead/s, and address notes appropriately
* An understanding of film colour space, grading, and a superior eye for composition, colour, mood and lighting

  

**What do we do?**  
Flying Bark Productions is a renowned independent producer of family-focused animation entertainment. For over 50 years, our 2D and 3D production facility has created award-winning feature films and TV series.

  

**Why work with us?**

* We work on some pretty cool projects - check out our website: https://www.flyingbark.com.au/
* We have cake days, movie nights, wrap parties & a culture club dedicated to coordinating our busy social calendar!
* We love dogs and you will often see some of our regular fluffy companions in the studio.
* Career development is important to us so we offer training and support opportunities whenever possible.
* Our employees say our culture is the best they've ever experienced - everyone is welcome and celebrated!
* You'll have access to mental health resources and free counselling via our Employee Assistance Provider, Support Act.

  

**Perks & Benefits:**

* We have a hybrid approach to work with flexible work from home days on offer.
* Breakfast is served daily - on us!

  

*Flying Bark Productions is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

title: Executive Editor - French speaker
description:
Hey there!
  
We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we're revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
  
  
Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We've teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!  
  
Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let's discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever's mission.

**Meet The Team**  
Secret Media Network is a digital media group focused on recommending perfect plans, discovering great places, sharing things to do, and relevant breaking news in different cities around the world. Our network is composed of Secret London, Secret Chicago, Secret LA, Secret NYC, Secret Sydney, Lisboa Secreta, Paris Secret, Madrid Secreto, Barcelona Secreta, and More!  
  
**The Role**  
We are seeking an experienced Editorial Executive to lead the creation of compelling content for our media outlets for our expansion into new markets. Reporting directly to our VP of Media, you will play a pivotal role in managing a growing team of passionate editors, writers, video producers, and social media creatives.

**What You´ll Do**

* Scope of responsibility for the French and Belgian markets.
* 1-on-1 management, ensuring clear workflows, and providing individual feedback.
* Crafting, communicating, and executing a creative vision for the entire Secret Media Network.
* Collaborating with Editors, Staff Writers, and the video and social team to establish and maintain high editorial standards, adhering to the brand's identity and tone of voice.
* Leading and guiding the team to foster growth, inspire creativity, and reach new audiences.
* Working with experienced editors to elevate our content in established cities, with an eye toward expandable formats.
* Analyzing data for cities in your region based on SMN's internal KPIs, and leveraging findings to inform future strategy.
* Identifying editorial partnership opportunities to broaden SMN content to a diverse audience.
* Taking a hands-on approach to initiate key content-creation initiatives.
* You will also be responsible for coordinating, assigning, and prioritizing editorial work within the team, collaborating with other Fever departments, and developing and analyzing audience-growth strategies. Your role will involve celebrating 'wins' and sharing best practices network-wide.
* Having a deep understanding of how the business operates and translating that knowledge into content strategies that support revenue, audience growth, and overall company objectives.
* Building and optimizing a successful content-driven conversion funnel, ensuring that storytelling, formats, distribution, and audience insights work together to drive measurable conversions.

**Who You Are**

* Proficiency in English and bilingual/native level in French.
* +5 years of experience working for a newsroom, content agency, creative agency, or digital media property.
* Strong leadership skills with a minimum of 2 years of team management experience.
* Deep passion for journalism, especially at the local level, social media, and digital marketing.
* Expertise in media mapping and the ability to collaborate with external partners (advertising agencies, media agencies, TV/Animation companies).
* Digital fluency and hands-on knowledge of the current social media landscape, including platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, etc.
* Ability to inspire creative teams and customers, strong presentation skills.
* Data-driven and business-savvy with superb writing skills and creative flair.
* Solid understanding of optimization technologies and AI-driven processes, workflow automation, and performance outcomes.
* Ability to convert content creators' economy into growth opportunities.
* Team player attitude.
* Additionally, proficiency in using WordPress, familiarity with Photoshop, Canva, and knowledge of other image/video editing software is preferred. Powerful media network contacts and connections will be highly appreciated.

**Why You´ll Love It Here**

* Attractive compensation package with room to grow.
* 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher.
* Flexible remuneration with Cobee: meals, transport, training, and nursery support (tax-exempt).
* Payflow: option to access part of your salary in advance.
* Taxdown: help optimizing and filing your taxes.
* Private health & dental insurance with Cigna: 100% covered by Fever. You can also add your family members via flexible remuneration.
* Wellhub membership for gym and wellness access: 100% covered by Fever up to the Silver plan.
* Language learning support: English and Spanish lessons.
* Hybrid work setup: home office friendly with a central Madrid office location.
* Snacks, drinks, and fresh fruit are always available at the office.
* Dynamic international team: a young, talented group creating a great work environment.

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

title: Staff AI Engineer - Agents & Harness
description:
**We Are Sparta**  
  
Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders.  
  
Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has.  
  
We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.  
  
At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.  
  
Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies.

### **The role**

You are the senior technical authority for how Sparta builds agents. You design and build the harness that runs Leonidas AI's agents, set the patterns the rest of the team and the wider engineering group follow, and stay in the code on the hardest problems. You work as a peer of the Agents Team Lead: they own the team and the delivery, you own the technical direction of the agent platform.

When a trader asks why an arbitrage is shut, Leonidas has to pick the right curves, call the right tools, reason across them and show where every number came from, in seconds. Models, frameworks and best practice for agents change every few months. Your job is to build a harness that absorbs that change without rewrites, and to make sure we can prove each change made the product better.

### **What you will do**

* **Set the technical direction.** Author the target architecture for the agent platform: execution graph, LLM interfaces, tool contracts, memory and context management, sub-agents, sandboxing and how skills plug in. Write the designs, run the reviews and own the trade-offs.
* **Hands on AI development -** Context engineering across branched conversations, handoffs between specialist agents, a decision-model layer so a model can change without touching agent code, and resumable, observable runs.
* **Make quality measurable.** Define how we evaluate agents: golden question sets, offline and online evals in CI, tracing and feedback loops, and release gates a model or prompt change must pass.
* **Open Leonidas up.** Design the agent-to-agent API, MCP server and headless modes, and the boundaries between what we expose, what customers connect and what stays internal.
* **Own reliability, cost and safety.** Latency and token budgets, failure handling, guardrails, provenance on every number, and the security model for agents that call tools and run code.
* **Raise the bar for everyone.** Mentor engineers, coach the team through design and code review, and spread good agent-building practice, including AI-assisted development, across all of engineering.
* **Manage and grow people.** Line-manage a group of engineers on the Agents team: run 1:1s, set goals, give feedback, support career growth and take part in hiring.
* **Shape the roadmap.** Work with the Team Lead, product and customers to decide what to build, what to buy and what to stop, and to size the risk in new ideas through quick prototypes.

### **What you bring**

* 8+ years building production software, including designing and shipping LLM-powered agents or agentic products used by real users.
* Technical leadership without the title: you have set architecture across a team, led designs through review and mentored others to a higher level.
* Deep, hands-on knowledge of agent systems: tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, streaming, context and memory management, retrieval, and failure modes over long runs.
* Clear writing and influence: you explain trade-offs to engineers, product and executives, and you change minds with evidence.

### **Nice to have**

* Built an agent harness or framework, or contributed to an open-source one (OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, DSPy or similar); built MCP servers or clients.
* Knowledge graphs, ontologies or entity resolution (mapping trader language to the right data).
* Sandboxed code execution, guardrails or security work for agents.
* Fine-tuning or model selection experience, or a research background.
* Interest in commodities or financial markets.

### **Our stack for this team**

Python · OpenAI Agents SDK · Postgres · Redis · StarRocks · Kafka · AWS · Nx monorepo · GitHub

**Why Join Sparta?**
====================

At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.

* Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company
* $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment
* Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale
* Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence
* Top-tier tools and technology to support your success

**What's the Culture Like at Sparta?**
======================================

At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

**The Sparta Code**
===================

**Understanding is non-negotiable**

***Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.***

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

**Ask for forgiveness, not for permission**

***Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.***

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

**Fall in love with the problem**

***The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.***

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

**It's your fault. Lucky you.**

***If it's on you, it's in your control.***

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

**Conflict is a gift**

***Honesty is an expression of care.***

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

*Sparta Commodities is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and promotes diversity within its workforce. We are determined that no-one will ever receive less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, veteran status or any basis covered by appropriate law.*

Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest.

 **Job Description**

**Country/Cluster Scope: GA South**

**Work Level: 5A**

The Transformation Lead serves as the transformation orchestration lead for implementing the Re-Imagine Europe programme within the Geographic Area (GA), with primary focus on Crop Protection. The role goes beyond project planning and reporting: it acts as the integrator that connects strategy, operating model design, change execution, capability building, new ways of working and business adoption across countries, functions and field-facing teams.

Working in close partnership with the GA Head, country leaders, HR, Finance, Communications, functional leads and the European programme team, the role translates the European master plan into an integrated GA transformation roadmap. This is a high-visibility transformation leadership role requiring strong PMO discipline, change leadership, stakeholder influence, commercial understanding, digital curiosity and the ability to mobilise teams without direct authority. Success will be measured not only by delivery against milestones, but by business readiness, adoption of new behaviours, clarity of accountabilities, continuity of commercial execution and measurable progress toward the intended Re-Imagine business outcomes.

**Qualifications**

**Knowledge, experience & capabilities**
