* Make sure DFAT-funded results are clearly attributed and that each client is counted only once.
* Build the MEAL skills of partner organizations.

Partners differ widely in capacity and resources, so the role works with a good degree of independence day to day. The aim is high-quality results, not just compliance. The post holder is supported by the Assessment and Learning (A&L) Manager, the Management Information System (MIS) Manager and IRC sector MEAL Managers and receives technical oversight from the Head of MEAL & Program Quality.

**Work Location:** IRC Bangladesh, Cox’s Bazar Office

**Contract Length:** 31st October 2027 (with possibility of extension subject to funding, program needs and performance of incumbent)

**Major Responsibilities:**

**Consortium MEAL framework and strategic ownership:**

* Design, maintain and regularly update the consortium-wide MEAL framework and MEAL Plan, including the Program Logic, log frame, MEL framework, Performance Indicator Reference Sheets (PIRS) and Indicator Tracking Table (ITT), in line with DFAT’s Design, Monitoring and Evaluation Standards (February 2026) and Development Evaluation Policy (2026), IRC MEAL policies and IRC’s global strategy, Strategy100. Ensure the framework, MEAL Plan, PIRS and standardized tools are approved and used by all partners.
* Own the consortium’s MEAL standard and practice. Contextualize existing IRC tools, standards and MEAL systems for the consortium rather than building parallel systems. Lead the standard MEAL methods, tools and reporting system, and strengthen partners’ capacity to use them.
* Agree with all partners how each indicator is defined and calculated, what data is collected, which tools are used, how often and with what sampling, and who is responsible. Ensure every partner applies the same definitions and protocols and understands the PIRS.
* Lead the annual Program Logic review and monitoring of key assumptions and risks with partners and contribute monitoring evidence to the consortium risk register.

**Data collection, consolidation, analysis and reporting:**

* Collect, clean, validate, analyze and compile project data for all indicators across IRC and all Bangladeshi Partners, for both monitoring and reporting.
* Ensure all partners collect data using CommCare-based tools and upload it daily to one central server and check the data routinely on dashboards.
* Maintain one common ITT for all partners (used for annual reporting) and analyze CommCare MIS data and the Program Indicator Dashboard (PID) monthly to assess progress and identify priority areas for targeted monitoring. Update the ITT and performance dashboards every month.
* Ensure data is consistently broken down by sex, age, gender, disability and location on every record (using the Washington Group Short Set on Functioning to identify persons with disabilities), and clear attribution of DFAT-funded results through project-specific codes in the MIS, addressing any attribution gaps through agreed data-sharing protocols and monthly data quality reviews.
* Apply DFAT’s unique client counting approach across all partners, using the program-specific client identifier in CommCare to count each individual once at service, sector and program level, and report unique reach against the target of 210,841 individuals by sector, sex, age, gender and disability. Ensure program data reported to DFAT is accurate, complete and donor compliant.
* Set and enforce common data management rules for all partners, covering file naming, storage, version control and data sharing.
* Ensure sensitive GBV and child protection case data remain within GBVIMS+ and CPIMS+ and agreed information-sharing protocols, with only aggregated, anonymized data used in consortium and DFAT reporting.
* Run routine consortium-wide analysis to identify programmatic, geographic, thematic and capacity gaps, including gaps in reaching the most at-risk groups (women and girls, children, adolescents and persons with disabilities) in line with JRP Priority 1 criteria, and flag them promptly to the PMU, outside the regular reporting cycle were urgent.
* Develop and monitor Value for Money (VfM) indicators aligned with DFAT’s 4Es framework (economy, efficiency, effectiveness and equity), including cost per client, cost per output and service utilization rates, working with Finance and sector leads and comparing results across delivery models and against sector benchmarks, and review the results with partners at program performance reviews.
* Prepare quarterly narrative and monitoring reports in consortium-agreed formats, and the MEAL inputs for DFAT annual performance reporting (led by the Program Coordinator, in the 8+3 format and aligned with DFAT’s whole-of-program indicators), with dashboards developed together with the MIS Manager. Submit reports on time and provide the DFAT inputs on schedule.

**Routine and process monitoring:**

* Lead a standardized process monitoring approach with tools and checklists for health and nutrition, protection, child protection and GBV, WASH, education, livelihoods, and emergency preparedness and response, covering quality, whether services are delivered as designed, inclusiveness, timeliness and the functioning of cross-sectoral referral pathways, with safeguarding, AAP and GEDSI built in.
* Monitor service quality, continuity, client access and satisfaction during the phased transition of services to Bangladeshi Partners, in line with the Partner Capacity building and Handover Plan, and report findings and corrective actions to the PMU and DFAT.
* Select activities for monthly spot checks based on MIS analysis (geographic coverage, program component, data quality performance and risk), and conduct spot checks with partner MEAL staff using digital tools.
* Plan and lead joint field visits with sector teams and partners, so that teams learn from one another (proposed monthly, and a longer 2–3 day visit each quarter covering all partners’ project areas).
* Review monitoring findings monthly with sector leads, and present consolidated findings at quarterly Program Performance Review and Reflection meetings, tracking agreed corrective actions to completion.

**Data quality assurance:**

* Check the quality of partner-reported data by verifying it, applying validation rules, cleaning it with a clear record of changes, and giving partners feedback.
* Lead annual Data Quality Assessments (DQAs) using IRC’s DQA methodology, adapted to DFAT’s Design, Monitoring and Evaluation Standards, and ensure at least 10% of reported data is verified against source documents each quarter during field visits.
* Lead on-site data verification and routine spot checks of CommCare records against registers, attendance sheets and case files (verifying sensitive GBV and child protection records only through agreed confidential protocols).
* Follow up DQA findings with agreed corrective actions and track them to completion and ensure compliance with IRC’s Data Quality Management Framework.

**Baseline, surveys, evaluations and research:**

* Use the baseline survey (completed in November 2026) as the benchmark for tracking change and refining targets, lead the internally managed outcome surveys (including the Year 2 midline) in line with the PIRS collection frequencies, coordinate the independent external endline survey in Year 3, and provide technical coordination of the Joint Program Review at around Month 18 (including the evaluation questions, validation workshop and joint action-planning workshop). Deliver all survey, review and evaluation activities on schedule.
* Develop Terms of Reference, methodologies, sampling plans (95% confidence level, 5% margin of error), tools and analysis plans, and oversee enumerators (IRC-enrolled incentive workers) and partner field supervisors, including daily data checks through dashboards, and ensure enumerators are trained in research ethics, safeguarding, PSEA, informed consent and sensitive-topic data collection.
* Prepare the Scope of Work in consultation with DFAT and share it before the evaluation team is recruited; procure and manage the independent final evaluation to DFAT’s quality and ethical standards and coordinate the management response and action plan and the learning workshop.
* Facilitate research as relevant to DFAT, such as KAP and SMART surveys, outcome harvesting, formative and multisector research, and coordinate with the protection and GEDSI teams so that the program-wide GEDSI analysis and protection analyses inform targeting and adaptation.
* Coordinate methodologies and reporting with DFAT’s external MEL provider.

**Accountability to affected populations:**

* Ensure there is one consortium-wide Client Feedback and Response Mechanism (CFRM) and coordinate it, building on existing partner systems, with safe, accessible and inclusive channels (adapted for persons with disabilities, women with restricted mobility, children and non-literate community members).
* Ensure feedback is recorded in the CommCare MIS and handled through IRC’s 4R approach (Receive, Refer, Respond, Reply), and that communities are told what action was taken.
* Ensure sensitive complaints, including safeguarding, PSEA and misconduct concerns, are referred immediately through safe, confidential pathways to IRC’s Ethics and Compliance Unit and are reported only in aggregate.
* Align CFRM complaint categories with the Common Feedback Platform (CFP) harmonized referral standards, coordinate with CFP focal points and inter-agency accountability mechanisms and refer out-of-scope concerns appropriately.
* Analyze feedback trends together with monitoring data, including signs of inclusion or exclusion errors in targeting, and work with the Community Mobilization, Community Engagement & AAP CoP so findings lead to changes in the program.
* Lead the annual multi-sectoral client satisfaction survey and ensure child-friendly and inclusive feedback methods capture the views of women, girls, boys, older persons and persons with disabilities.

**Learning and adaptive management:**

* Develop and maintain the consortium Learning Agenda (finalized with DFAT and partners) and learning logs and facilitate evidence-to-action processes so findings lead to program changes, including evidence-to-action briefs shared with DFAT, partners and JRP coordination platforms.
* Organize the quarterly reflection sessions, annual learning workshop and the Evidence-to-Action Plan following the Joint Program Review.
* Document and share learning briefs, case studies and good practices with partners, DFAT, other CoPs and IRC technical networks, working with the Communications team.
* Promote Gender Equality, Disability and Social Inclusion (GEDSI), Value for Money, localization and safeguarding in all MEAL analysis and learning, drawing on the technical leadership of CDD on disability inclusion and Nari Maitree on gender equality and social inclusion.

**Partner MEAL capacity strengthening and localization:**

* Assess partner MEAL capacity, jointly with partners and in step with the joint organizational capacity assessments and develop a tailored capacity strengthening and sharing plan covering data collection, analysis, reporting and use of data. Implement the plan and document progress.
* Provide training, mentoring, coaching and supportive supervision to partner MEAL staff, and give regular feedback on adherence to agreed tools and standards, while drawing on partners’ own expertise through peer-to-peer, bi-directional capacity sharing.
* Support the gradual handover of MEAL systems, tools and decision-making to Bangladeshi Partners, consistent with the localization-first approach and the Partner capacity building and handover plan.
* Track and report the program’s localization indicators, including the share of funding passed to Bangladeshi Partners and partner leadership of MEAL functions.

**MEAL Community of Practice:**

* Manage the MEAL CoP, which brings together MEAL focal points from IRC and all partners to harmonize tools, review data quality and share learning, guided by one Learning Agenda, and lead its work, with technical support from the Head of MEAL & Program Quality and in coordination with the NGO Forum MEAL Manager (co-lead).
* Prepare the Learning Agenda and meeting agendas, run peer learning sessions, technical clinics, joint problem-solving and peer reviews, and hold the monthly informal sharing meeting and quarterly formal meeting.
* Maintain the shared repository of MEAL tools and learning products and the common action tracker and escalate matters needing management decisions to the PMU.

**Coordination and representation:**

* Represent consortium MEAL directly to DFAT, and present key monitoring and feedback findings to the PMU and, where relevant, the CPF, using aggregate data only (never individual client information) and including community feedback and the changes made in response, which is a standing CPF agenda item.
* Work with the Head of MEAL & Program Quality, Program Coordinator, A&L Manager, MIS Manager, sector MEAL Managers and the NGO Forum MEAL Manager as set out above.
* Represent IRC in inter-agency MEAL, information management, accountability and assessment working groups as required.

**Others:**

* Promote and actively participate in initiatives and efforts to build team engagement, inclusion and cohesion in IRC [team/office]
* Foster ongoing learning, honest dialogue and reflection to strengthen safeguarding and to promote IRC values and adherence to IRC policies.

**Key Working Relationships:**

**Position Reports To:** Head of MEAL & Program Quality

**Internal:** MIS Manager, IRC sector MEAL Managers, NGO Forum MEAL Manager, Related CoPs

**External:** Partner MEAL focal points (Nari Maitree, Breaking the Silence, CDD, FIVDB and CNRS), DFAT and its external MEL provider

**Experience:**

* Minimum 7 years of progressive MEAL experience in humanitarian and development settings, including at least 3 years in senior or lead roles managing MEAL systems for multi-partner programs.

**Knowledge, Skills & Competences:**

* Demonstrated experience in strengthening MEAL capacity of local and national partner organizations, and in localization approaches.
* Experience with DFAT (including its Design, Monitoring and Evaluation Standards and Value for Money framework) or comparable institutional donor requirements (for example US Government, ECHO or OCHA) for compliance, reporting and indicator measurement.
* Experience in at least three of the following sectors: protection, health, WASH, education, GBV, livelihoods and resilience, in humanitarian settings.
* Experience leading baselines, surveys, evaluations and research studies.
* Experience designing and managing multi-partner data systems, including unique client counting and de-duplication, and client feedback and response mechanisms in humanitarian settings.
* Advanced skills in Excel, Power BI, SPSS, Kobo and CommCare; PowerApps and DHIS2 desirable.
* Strong quantitative and qualitative analysis skills, and experience developing dashboards and automated reporting systems.
* Knowledge of data protection, safeguarding, protection from sexual exploitation and abuse (PSEA), GEDSI and accountability principles, including the ethical handling of sensitive GBV and child protection data.
* GIS/QGIS skills are highly desirable.
* Ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions with partners at different capacity levels.
* Strong coaching, facilitation and collaboration skills, with a partner-led and respectful approach.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Bangla.
* Female Candidates are highly encouraged to apply.

**Specific Educational Qualification:**

* Master’s degree preferred in statistics, sociology, public health, development studies, economics, social sciences, demography, monitoring and evaluation, or a related field; or minimum bachelor’s degree in a relevant field with additional relevant experience.

**Professional Standards:** All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

title: Catastrophe Risk Analyst
description:
**Location** Madrid, Spain **Job type** Full-Time **Work mode** Hybrid **Job level** Professional **Job ID** 14751 **Company** Munich Re Specialty - Global Markets **Employment type** Regular **Area of expertise** Claims & Underwriting

  

**About us**

At Munich Re Specialty – Global Markets (MRS-GM), it is our ambition to become the leading Primary Specialty Insurance provider, underpinned by an effective and adaptable strategy, superior products and industry leaders working in a supportive environment to achieve this.

At the heart of our success is a strong culture where people are encouraged to be present, bold and curious, allowing them to achieve their individual goals.

Please see our website for more information.

**Catastrophe Risk Analyst**

We are currently looking for a Catastrophe Risk Analyst to be based in Madrid on a full-time basis, reporting into the Head of Exposure Management

To provide exposure management and catastrophe risk analytical support to the Exposure Management and Underwriting teams, delivering high-quality risk insights to support underwriting and portfolio management decisions. The role is responsible for the collection, assessment, analysis and reporting of exposure management information, including both regular reporting and ad hoc analytical support for the Syndicate and its international distribution network.

The position will play a key role in establishing and developing an Exposure Management capability in Spain to support the growth of Munich Re Specialty Global Markets across Europe. Working within a developing function, the successful candidate will help shape processes, operating models and analytical capabilities while partnering with senior underwriting and risk stakeholders to support future regional growth.

**Responsibilities**:

* Analyse and manage large and complex datasets, utilising catastrophe and accumulation modelling tools to assess, quantify and communicate catastrophe and accumulation risk across the portfolio.
* Support the development and enhancement of data ingestion, transformation and quality control processes to improve the efficiency and accuracy of catastrophe modelling workflows.
* Interpret, synthesise and present catastrophe model outputs to underwriting teams, including analysis of portfolio changes, model movements and key risk drivers.
* Operate catastrophe modelling platforms and interrogate exposure and results databases using SQL and other analytical tools.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of Exposure Management practices through process optimisation, automation and the development of new analytical capabilities.
* Support the design and implementation of operational workflows, controls and governance processes for the European Exposure Management function.
* Assist the Head of Exposure Management in building and developing a high-performing Exposure Management team to support future regional growth.
* Develop innovative analytical solutions to help underwriting teams better understand, quantify and manage catastrophe risk.
* Assess and monitor exposures throughout the underwriting lifecycle, from data receipt and validation through to modelling, analysis and reporting.
* Support post-event analytics and loss estimation activities for both natural and non-natural catastrophe events.
* Assist in the validation, benchmarking and review of third-party catastrophe models and associated modelling assumptions.

**Knowledge and Skills**

* 2+ years' experience in a catastrophe risk, exposure management, actuarial or related analytical role.
* Degree in a quantitative, scientific or hazard-related discipline, such as Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Meteorology, Seismology, Atmospheric Science, Geography or Environmental Science. Equivalent industry experience will also be considered.
* Highly adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment, with the ability to take ownership, establish new processes and contribute to the development of a growing function.
* Strong analytical and data manipulation skills, with the ability to interpret and communicate complex datasets and modelling results.
* Experience with catastrophe modelling platforms, preferably Moody's RMS solutions, including RiskLink, Risk Modeller, IRP, UWIQ and/or EIQ.
* Experience with alternative catastrophe modelling platforms would be advantageous.
* Familiarity with local reporting requirements and catastrophe risk management frameworks is desirable.
* Experience supporting catastrophe event response activities, hazard monitoring and post-event reporting.
* Proficiency in SQL and Microsoft Excel; experience with Python, R, Power BI or similar analytical or programming tools would be beneficial.
* Fluency in **English and Spanish**; additional European languages (e.g. German or Italian) are a plus.

If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align perfectly with everything outlined, or you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the candidate we are looking for!

**Diversity, Equity & Inclusion**

At Munich Re, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion foster innovation and resilience and enable us to act braver and better. Embracing the power of DEI is at the core of who we are. We recognise diversity can be multi-dimensional, intersectional, and complex, so we want to build a diverse workforce that includes a wide range of racial, ethnic, sexual, and gender identities; economic and geographic backgrounds; physical abilities; ages; life, school, and career experiences; and political, religious, and personal beliefs. Additionally, we are committed to building an equitable and inclusive work environment where this diversity is celebrated, valued, and has equitable opportunities to succeed.

All candidates in consideration for any role can request a reasonable adjustment at any point in our recruitment process. You can request an adjustment by speaking to your Talent Acquisition contact.

Learning and innovating today, striving for sustainable societies and business tomorrow

At Munich Re Specialty – Global Markets our approach to ESG is underpinned by our desire to seize business opportunities and to nurture a stimulating and inclusive work environment. Our ESG strategy aims to deliver holistic impacts across environmental, social and governance topics including supporting a number of local initiatives within our community and offering volunteering opportunities for colleagues.

Learn more about sustainability at Munich Re – choose your impact!

**#BePresent** **#BeBold** **#BeCurious**

  

**Your Benefits**
-----------------

With us, you get more than just an exciting job. Enjoy a wide range of employee benefits tailored to your wellbeing and development. Please note that regional differences may apply.

Competitive Salary

We provide fair and competitive compensation that reflects your performance and commitment.

Company performance-based Incentives

In addition to your salary, our variable compensation approach allows you to share in Munich Re's success.

Recognition and Special Rewards

We recognise outstanding individual contributions through a variety of targeted rewards and incentives.

Retirement Planning

We support your long-term financial wellbeing with retirement solutions aligned with local regulations.

Inclusive Workplace Culture

We foster a respectful, inclusive, and values-driven environment.

Learning & Development

We offer tailored learning opportunities with a strong focus on core skills and business-critical knowledge.

Work-Life-Balance

Supporting your ability to balance family, leisure, and your career.

Health & Wellbeing

We support your physical and mental health through a range of programs and activities in each location.

title: Service Reliability Lead 100% (f/m/d)
description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

IT Digital Transformation (DT) is establishing Service Reliability as a strategic capability across its global delivery organization. As Service Reliability Lead, you will define, drive, and continuously improve reliability practices across six Agile Release Trains (ARTs), enabling teams to build and operate resilient, observable, and business-critical services.
  
Reporting to the Head of Shared Delivery & Services, you will serve as the central point of contact for Service Reliability across DT and partner closely with ARTs, Operations, Engineering, Product Management, Risk & Compliance, and senior leadership. Your mission is to establish a reliability-first culture by combining Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, IT Service Management (ITSM) practices, observability, end-to-end monitoring, and operational
  
governance.
  
This is a highly visible role requiring a combination of technical expertise, operational excellence, stakeholder management, and organizational leadership. You will define and co-establish reliability standards, enable teams to adopt them, and build a Service Reliability practice that scales across the DT organization.

**YOUR CHALLENGE**
------------------

**Service Reliability Strategy & Framework**

* Establish and continuously evolve the Service Reliability framework across DT

* Define reliability principles, standards, governance, and best practices in alignment with SRE and ITSM methodologies

* Drive adoption of reliability practices across six global ARTs while ensuring clear ownership remains within the delivery teams

* Act as DT's central authority and subject matter expert for Service Reliability Reliability Engineering & Operational Excellence

* Define and drive practices for service resilience, availability, recoverability, and operational readiness

* Co-establish and continuously improve Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and error budget frameworks in alignment with business needs

* Facilitate operational readiness reviews and production acceptance assessments for existing, new and changed services

* Analyze production incidents, service disruptions, and telemetry data to identify reliability improvement opportunities

* Promote a proactive reliability culture focused on preventing operational issues before they impact clients or business processes

**Observability & End-to-End Monitoring**

* Co-create DT's observability and end-to-end monitoring strategy

* Enable monitoring standards, instrumentation approaches, alerting concepts, and service health management across the DT organization

* Design, build, and maintain executive and operational dashboards providing transparency into service health, reliability trends, and operational performance

* Leverage telemetry, metrics, logs, traces, and business transaction monitoring to improve service reliability Cross-Functional Enablement

* Enable and support ARTs in implementing reliability engineering practices and operational excellence standards

* Coach ARTs, Engineering Leads, ITSOs, and Product Managers on Service Reliability concepts, methodologies, and tooling

* Collaborate with global Incident & Problem Management functions to strengthen reliability outcomes

* Establish knowledge-sharing mechanisms across DT (e.g. via CoP) Stakeholder Management & Leadership

* Act as trusted advisor to senior stakeholders across Digital Transformation and Operations

* Provide regular insights on service reliability performance, risk areas, trends, and improvement initiatives

* Build strong partnerships with Operations teams, ART Leads, Engineering Leads, Product Management, Risk & Compliance, and senior leadership

* Enable decision-making through data-driven recommendations and measurable outcomes

**Continuous Improvement**

* Evolve existing and add new production KPIs, while tracking the progress across the organization

* Drive initiatives to reduce production incidents, improve service availability, and increase operational efficiency

* Identify automation and optimization opportunities across monitoring, observability, and operational processes

* Contribute to the future vision, growth, and operating model of the Service Reliability Practice as part of the Shared Delivery & Services team.

**YOUR PROFILE**
----------------

* Proven experience in Service Reliability, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Production Operations, Service Management, or a related function within large-scale enterprise environments

* Strong understanding of IT Service Management (ITSM) principles and operational processes

* Expertise in observability, monitoring, service health management, and reliability engineering

* Proven experience establishing and driving strategies, frameworks, and governance models

* Knowledge of availability management, resiliency patterns, operational readiness, and production support models

* Experience defining and managing SLAs, SLOs, SLIs, and error budget frameworks

* Hands-on experience configuring and utilizing monitoring and observability platforms

* Experience with Dynatrace and ideally Splunk

* Practical experience with Dynatrace, Splunk, ServiceNow, Jira, and Confluence

* Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, or similar technologies is advantageous (though not strategic for BJB anymore)

* Ability to analyze service performance data, and production incidents to identify systemic improvement opportunities

* Experience working within Agile Release Trains (ARTs) and scaled agile delivery organizations

* Strong facilitation and stakeholder management skills

* Ability to operate effectively across engineering, operations, risk, compliance, and business functions

* Experience working in globally distributed organizations and multicultural environments

* Strong communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and executive audiences

* Strategic thinker with a hands-on mentality, capable of balancing governance, enablement, and execution

* Self-driven, pragmatic, and passionate about building reliability as a core organizational capability

  

Salary starting from EUR 46'000

  

CBA: XIX Convenio colectivo Estatal de Empresas de Consultoría, Tecnologías de la Información y Estudios de Mercado y de la Opinión Pública.

title: Director of Marketing
description:
**Director of Marketing**

This is a superb opportunity to build a marketing engine for an award-winning Irish business engaged in rapid international expansion. Leading our marketing team and reporting directly to the CEO, you will be responsible for:

  

* Driving new business through increased awareness of IN2 and our services
* Telling the IN2 story across a range of media and channels, including bringing customer and project stories to life
* Building and developing our marketing team into a world-class operation
* Working with our Business Development team to ensure that we always put our best foot forward when it comes to clients and partners

  

**The Company:**

At IN2, we design and engineer exceptional, low carbon building and infrastructure solutions for some of the world’s most ambitious organisations. As such we are at the forefront of the drive to net zero and a sustainable future. The company is headquartered in Ireland with offices throughout Europe, with plans for significant expansion that we want you to be a part of. We deliver outstanding landmark projects across the continent, and a key element of this role is bringing the stories behind those projects to life.

**About you:**

We are looking for a candidate who is capable of leading the charge when it comes to building our marketing function. We need someone who has a passion for content and story-telling, but also a laser-like focus on the commercial realities of a services business. You should be comfortable dealing directly with senior engineers both inside and outside our organisation. You don't have to know anything about building engineering today, but we'll expect you to learn.

**Qualifications and experience:**

  

* At least ten years experience in marketing, ideally within a consulting/professional service environment
* Experience building and leading teams
* Ability and experience translating complex technical material into compelling, human stories and insight
* Experience of the sales process in professional services: bids, proposals, relationships etc
* Strong understanding and experience within demand generation, both paid and organic
* A portfolio of outstanding creative work that you have commissioned or created

  

**Why You’ll Love Being Part of the Team**

At IN2, we’ve traded the stuffy corporate ladder for a flat hierarchy and a culture where your voice actually matters. We’re a diverse, collaborative team that believes the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere.

* **Global Impact, Local Feel:** You’ll get to work on game-changing projects across different countries, supported by our specialist BIM, Sustainability, and Building Physics teams.
* **Constant Growth:** Through IN2 Talks, cross-office collaboration, and a culture of knowledge sharing, you’re always learning something new.
* **Your Best Self:** We prioritise a genuine work-life balance with flexible hours and support for personal circumstances. We’re big on open communication and ensuring our workplace is a bias-free zone where you can truly be yourself.

  

**What’s In It For You?**

We’ve put together a package that looks after your wallet, your career, and your wellbeing.

**The Essentials**

* **Competitive Pay & Bonuses:** A salary that reflects your worth, plus an annual bonus and pension contributions.
* **Annual Leave:** 22 days of annual leave, scaling up to 27 days as you grow with us (plus all those bank holidays!).
* **Flexible Hours:** Work-life balance isn't just a buzzword here—we offer a 37.5-hour working week with flexible hours (8am–6pm), to suit your lifestyle!

  

**Career Progression**

* **Personal Roadmap:** You’ll have a dedicated Personal Development Plan and mentoring from our senior leaders.

  

**Health & Wellbeing**

* **Mind & Body:** Access to our Employee Assistance Program, annual health checks, and various fitness initiatives.
* **Commute Greener:** Take advantage of our Cycle to Work scheme to keep active on your way to the office.

  

**Social & Community**

* **Legendary Events:** From our famous Christmas party weekend to Employee Appreciation Day and regular staff social events.
* **Giving Back:** Get involved with our team-led charity initiatives.
* **International Reach:** Opportunities to work across IN2 offices in London, Dublin, Berlin, Belfast, Athlone, and Madrid.

  

**Eligibility**

Due to regulatory requirements, this role is open to candidates with permanent residency or unrestricted right to work in the UK. Applications requiring visa sponsorship cannot be considered.

title: Head of Growth & Commercial Marketing
description:
**About us**

At Supporting Education Group, we help solve the biggest challenges in education through innovative solutions that empower schools, educators and learners to achieve lasting impact.

Through our portfolio of specialist brands, we support education settings across the UK with recruitment, workforce solutions, training and professional development services. By combining deep sector expertise with innovative thinking, we're helping schools build stronger workforces, improve outcomes and create environments where educators and learners can thrive.

We're ambitious about the role we play in education and equally ambitious about the growth of our business. As we continue to invest in our Recruitment & Supply division, we're looking for a commercially minded marketing leader who can identify growth opportunities, influence strategic decisions and deliver measurable results.

This is an opportunity to shape growth across a market-leading organisation where marketing is expected to drive commercial impact, not simply generate activity.

**About the role**

As our Head of Growth & Commercial Marketing, you’ll turn commercial priorities into **targeted, practical marketing campaigns that generate customer growth, pipeline, revenue and account expansion**.

This is a senior role, but it is also a **hands-on delivery role**. You’ll be expected to identify opportunities, develop campaign ideas and then take ownership of bringing them to life. This will include defining the audience and proposition, shaping messaging and content, selecting channels, coordinating delivery, launching activity and using performance data to continually improve results.

Working closely with sales, commercial and operational teams, you’ll build a clear understanding of where the best opportunities sit across our customer markets. You’ll translate these opportunities into campaigns that support customer acquisition, retention, reactivation, cross-sell and growth within existing accounts.

You won’t simply create the strategy and hand it over. You’ll be comfortable **working directly in platforms such as HubSpot, interrogating CRM and pipeline data, building campaign activity and working with colleagues across marketing and the wider business to get campaigns out into the market**.

You’ll also help create a more experimental approach to growth, testing new propositions, audiences, channels and campaign ideas. You’ll use the results to determine what we scale, improve or stop.

**Key responsibilities will include:**

* Developing and owning the commercial marketing plan across the Recruitment & Supply portfolio.
* Working with sales and commercial leaders to identify priority markets, customer segments, accounts and growth opportunities.
* **Creating and executing integrated marketing campaigns from initial idea through to launch, measurement and optimisation.**
* **Developing clear campaign briefs covering objectives, audiences, propositions, messaging, channels, activity, investment and success measures.**
* Delivering campaigns that support customer acquisition, account-based marketing, market penetration, retention, reactivation, renewal, cross-sell and account expansion.
* **Taking an active role in campaign delivery, including building activity in HubSpot, developing campaign journeys, coordinating content and assets, producing sales enablement materials and managing launch plans.**
* Translating customer needs and commercial priorities into compelling propositions and go-to-market activity.
* Working with key stakeholders to ensure campaigns are delivered effectively and at pace.
* Partnering closely with sales teams to improve lead follow-up, lead quality, conversion and visibility of campaign-generated opportunities.
* Using CRM, campaign, customer and pipeline data to identify opportunities and make informed decisions.

* Testing new ideas and running focused experiments to understand what generates the strongest commercial response.
* Managing budgets and making investment decisions based on performance, conversion and expected return.
* Reporting clearly on campaign performance, pipeline contribution, account growth, revenue influence and return on investment.
* Using HubSpot, automation and AI to deliver campaigns more efficiently and improve targeting, personalisation and conversion.

**About you**

You’ll enjoy moving between strategy and execution and won’t be reliant on a large team or agency to turn your ideas into action.

**We’re particularly interested in hearing from people who can demonstrate:**

* Significant experience in growth marketing, commercial marketing, demand generation or revenue-focused B2B marketing.
* **A strong track record of personally developing and executing campaigns that have generated leads, opportunities, pipeline, revenue or account growth.**
* Experience managing campaigns across multiple channels and through the full campaign lifecycle.
* The ability to turn broad commercial objectives into clear, targeted and measurable marketing activity.
* Experience using CRM and marketing automation platforms to segment audiences, build campaigns and track performance.
* Strong commercial acumen and the ability to prioritise activity based on opportunity, performance and return.
* Experience developing propositions, campaign messaging and go-to-market plans.
* A practical understanding of lead management and how marketing and sales need to work together to improve conversion.
* A test-and-learn mindset, with experience of using campaign results to optimise activity and inform future investment.
* Confidence presenting performance, opportunities and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to coordinate colleagues and partners to deliver activity at pace.
* The ability to work effectively in a fast-moving environment with multiple brands, audiences and commercial priorities.

Experience within recruitment, education, staffing, workforce solutions, managed services or another multi-site service business would be highly advantageous.

Practical experience of HubSpot, marketing automation and AI-enabled marketing tools would also be beneficial.

**Our Benefits:**  

* 28 days holiday and get an extra day for each year you stay with us, up to max 33 days PLUS bank holidays
* Health Cash Plan, once you’ve passed probation, which includes access to a private GP
* From day 1, free life insurance covering up to x4 your salary

By joining us, you will become part of a community that is dedicated to transforming lives and sustaining communities, where your voice is heard, your ideas are valued, and your individuality is celebrated. Together, we will continue to advance our passion for education and build brighter futures for all.

title: Sr. Director, RWD Commercial Strategy & Innovation
description:
**Description**

**Director/Sr. Director/Vice President - RWD Subject Matter Expert (SME)**, RWD Commercial Strategy and Innovation | **Location:** Remote, United States | **Employment Type:** Full Time

**About Norstella**

Norstella is a premier and critical global life sciences data and AI solutions provider dedicated to improving patient access to life-saving therapies. Norstella supports pharmaceutical and biotech companies across the full drug development lifecycle — from pipeline to patient. Our mission is simple: to help our clients bring therapies to market faster and more efficiently, ultimately impacting patient lives.

Norstella unites market-leading brands — Citeline, Evaluate, MMIT, Panalgo, Skipta, and The Dedham Group — and delivers must-have answers and insights, leveraging AI, for critical strategic, clinical, and commercial decision-making. We help our clients:

* Accelerate the drug development cycle
* Assess competition and bring the right drugs to market
* Make data-driven commercial and financial decisions
* Match and recruit patients for clinical trials
* Identify and address barriers to therapies

Norstella serves most pharmaceutical and biotech companies around the world, along with regulators like the FDA and payers. By providing critical proprietary data supporting AI-driven workflows, Norstella helps clients make decisions faster and with greater confidence.

**The Role: RWD Subject Matter Expert**

The RWD Subject Matter Expert (SME) is a senior commercial and strategic leader within the RWD Strategy & Innovation team. This role owns overall opportunity strategy and commercial approach for aligned accounts in close partnership with the RWD Sales and is responsible for ensuring RWD is embedded into Norstella’s core offerings through clear positioning, use-case prioritization, and alignment across Product, Strategy, Sales, and Delivery.

The RWD SME operates at the highest level of the pre-sales cycle: setting the strategic vision for how we pursue and win deals, defining account-level growth roadmaps, and maintaining accountability for commercial outcomes from first engagement through close, renewal, and expansion. This role is a senior decision-making and strategic leadership layer that ensures every deal we pursue is well-positioned, rigorously scoped, competitively differentiated, and set up for successful delivery.

**Why This Role Matters**

The RWD SME is the senior commercial anchor for the RWD practice. By owning account and opportunity strategy, deal economics, and final sign-off prior to SOW execution, this role directly determines the quality, velocity, and long-term growth of Norstella's RWD business. The SME is the connective force between what clients need, what we can credibly deliver, and how we price and position our solutions to win.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Serve as the strategic lead for RWD across key accounts, shaping opportunity strategy, value positioning, and long-term growth in partnership with sales
* Lead client-facing engagements with senior stakeholders across Medical Affairs, HEOR, Clinical, and Commercial functions, translating data and analytics into clear, actionable value
* Define and guide fit-for-purpose RWD solutions, ensuring alignment between client needs, data assets, and analytic approach
* Provide strategic oversight throughout the deal lifecycle, ensuring feasibility, analytical rigor, and strong positioning from initial discovery through execution
* Own or influence deal strategy and economics, including scope, pricing, and overall commercial approach
* Ensure alignment across cross-functional teams (Sales, Strategy, Product, Delivery) to drive cohesive and executable solutions
* Act as a senior decision-maker and escalation point to resolve complexity, manage risk, and maintain momentum across opportunities
* Support broader business unit strategy by embedding RWD into core offerings and driving consistent, differentiated market positioning

**What Success Looks Like**

* Consistent recognition by clients as a trusted senior strategic partner — not just a vendor
* RWD is embedded, differentiated, and commercially visible across assigned Business Units
* A growing, well-managed portfolio of accounts with clear growth roadmaps
* Deals that close with strong scope clarity, appropriate pricing, and a credible handoff to Delivery
* Internal teams (Strategy, Delivery, Analytics, Product) rely on the SME for authoritative deal guidance and clear strategic direction
* Measurable contribution to bookings growth, deal expansion, and renewal rates

**Qualifications**

* 7–12+ years of experience in life sciences industry, healthcare strategy consulting, RWD strategy, HEOR, solutions consulting, or a related field
* Deep expertise in real-world data modalities — open and closed claims, structured and unstructured EMR, lab data, linked datasets, SDOH, and trigger-based data assets
* Demonstrated experience owning commercial strategy and deal economics, including pricing, scope, and contract terms, in a pre-sales or solutions environment
* Track record of building and managing senior-level client relationships across Medical Affairs, HEOR, Clinical, and Commercial functions at pharmaceutical or biotech companies
* Strong analytical foundation with the ability to oversee and assess data feasibility, identify scope risks, and translate data complexity into clear client-facing narratives with the ability to provide high-level guidance to more junior team members
* Executive-level communication skills, including written, verbal, and visual, with experience developing and delivering strategic presentations to senior stakeholders
* Experience operating across a matrixed organization and driving alignment without direct authority
* Comfort with ambiguity, competing priorities, and fast-moving commercial cycles

**Location** Remote, United States

**Benefits**

* Medical and Prescription Drug Benefits
* Health Savings Accounts (HSA) or Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Dental & Vision Benefits
* Basic Life and AD&D Benefits
* 401k Retirement Plan with Company Match
* Company Paid Short & Long-Term Disability
* Paid Parental Leave
* Open Vacation Policy & Company Holidays

Please Note — All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. We do not provide visa sponsorship or transfers. We are not currently accepting candidates who are on an OPT visa.

The expected base salary for this position ranges from $175,000 to $250,000, with an additional 20–25% of base salary in team-based commission, paid monthly and calculated annually. It is not typical for offers to be made at or near the top of the range. title: Associate Director of Digital Strategy
description:
### **Who We Are**

Teal Media is a full-service creative and design agency with a conscience. We believe purposeful design can transform organizations, inspire action, and enable progress. Our clients and nonprofit partners are committed to creating positive social change—and we pour every ounce of our passion and skill into helping them succeed.

We offer a variety of strategic, creative, and technical services, including brand strategy, web design and development, and creative support.

We’re a woman-founded and woman-led firm with a team that reflects a broad range of lived experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. At Teal, we value our people above all else and choose to work with partners and clients who share those values.

**Associate Director of Digital Strategy**
==========================================

Base salary $120,000–$140,000

**Put your digital strategy skills to work for causes worth fighting for.**

The organizations we work with are taking on some of the biggest issues of our time. They need people to pay attention, get involved, and give. We help make that happen.

Teal is a full-service creative agency partnering with nonprofits and mission-driven organizations to build brands, create websites, and turn digital engagement into action. We care deeply about the causes we serve. We ask hard questions, push the thinking, and sweat the details because our clients need work that delivers.

We’re looking for an Associate Director of Digital Strategy who brings that same conviction to their work. Someone who can earn a client’s trust, make a strong strategic call, and get into the platforms when a campaign needs attention. If you care about progressive causes and have the digital chops to help them move forward, we’d love to meet you.

**Why this role matters**
=========================

You’ll lead strategy for a portfolio of complex digital marketing engagements, helping clients connect their ambitions to clear priorities and measurable results. That means understanding their audiences, making smart choices about where to invest, and bringing paid media, email, social, SMS, web, content, SEO, and analytics together around shared goals.

You’ll report to our Senior Director of Digital Strategy and provide senior leadership on client accounts and projects. You’ll also mentor teammates and help grow Teal’s digital marketing practice through proposals, pitches, and stronger client partnerships.

**What you’ll do**
==================

* **Lead the strategy and own the follow-through**. Guide discovery, digital audits, audience research, and planning for complex engagements. Turn what you learn into practical roadmaps with clear goals, responsibilities, and measures of success.
* **Be the partner clients count on**. Build relationships with senior stakeholders, lead workshops and tough conversations, and help teams make decisions. Bring a clear point of view, listen closely, and respectfully challenge assumptions when a better approach will serve the mission.
* **Connect the channels**. Develop integrated strategies that grow audiences, deepen engagement, support advocacy, and raise money. Make recommendations that fit each client’s goals, budget, and capacity.
* **Make the numbers useful**. Establish KPIs, benchmarks, and measurement plans. Translate data and audience insights into clear recommendations, explain the story behind performance, and ensure approved optimizations make it into the work.
* **Stay close to execution**. Move comfortably between the big picture and the details. Review a campaign, troubleshoot a platform issue, or help execute when the work calls for it. We’re a small, agile team, and this role needs someone who is ready to jump in.
* **Make the creative stronger**. Partner with creative leads on campaign concepts, messaging, and ongoing communications. Give useful feedback and make sure the work reflects the client’s brand, reaches the right people, and supports the strategy.
* **Keep delivery on track**. Work with project managers, creatives, developers, and channel specialists to manage scopes, budgets, timelines, and quality. Spot risks early, recommend solutions, and keep clients and teammates informed before a problem becomes a surprise.
* **Help good partnerships grow**. Identify opportunities to expand client relationships where additional services would advance their goals. Work with the Senior Director and business development team on proposals, scopes, pitches, and prospect conversations.
* **Raise the team’s game**. Mentor colleagues, share what’s working across accounts, and improve the tools and frameworks behind our work. Support recruiting and onboarding as needed, and bring useful developments in digital marketing back to the team.
* **Balance great work with a healthy practice**. Meet the role’s billable utilization expectations while making room for approved business development and practice-building priorities. Understand how your decisions affect client outcomes and agency performance.

**What you bring**
==================

* A track record of leading complex, integrated digital marketing engagements, ideally for nonprofits, advocacy organizations, foundations, or other organizations working toward positive change.
* Broad knowledge of paid media, email, social, SMS, web, content strategy, SEO, and analytics, with deep hands-on expertise in at least one area. You can connect the disciplines and work confidently within the platforms you know best.
* The confidence and judgment to advise senior clients, facilitate productive conversations, and build agreement among people with competing priorities.
* Strong analytical instincts. You can connect performance data, audience behavior, and qualitative research to a recommendation people can act on.
* Clear, persuasive writing and presentation skills. You can explain what you recommend, why it matters, and how you’ll know it worked.
* Experience leading work across disciplines and helping colleagues grow, whether or not they report to you. You give clear direction, welcome feedback, and follow through.
* Sound agency judgment around scope, budgets, utilization, and competing priorities. You know when to dig deeper, when to make the call, and when to raise a concern.
* A real connection to the work. **You’re energized by progressive, mission-driven clients** and take their trust, resources, and results seriously.

**What we offer**
=================

Work you can care about. Colleagues who care about the craft. And benefits that support a full life beyond your next deadline.

Base salary of $120,000–$140,000. Where you land depends on your experience and skills.

Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage begin the first of the month after you join.

**Health coverage that puts you first**
---------------------------------------

* $0 premiums for employee-only coverage on our high-deductible health plan, plus an employer contribution to your Health Savings Account. Your HSA is yours to keep and use for eligible health expenses now or later.
* A generous contribution toward family coverage, plus a choice of medical plans, including $1,000-deductible and $0-deductible options. We contribute toward premiums on every plan.
* Free counseling sessions, virtual therapy, and 24/7 virtual care.

**Dental and vision covered**
-----------------------------

* $0 premiums for employee-only coverage on our base dental and vision plans, with buy-up options that include orthodontia and larger allowances for glasses and contacts.

**Additional support at no cost to you**
----------------------------------------

* Basic life and AD&D insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability coverage, all 100% employer-paid.

**Time to recharge**
--------------------

* 10+ paid company holidays each year, starting on day one, plus a few bonus days off when we can.
* Flexible Time Off after three months. We encourage new teammates to take three weeks of vacation in their first year.

**Investing in your future**
----------------------------

* After three months, contribute 5% of your pay to your 401(k), and we’ll add 4%. The employer match is fully vested immediately.

**Support for growing families**
--------------------------------

* After three months, new parents receive up to 12 weeks of paid leave at full pay, up to $3,500 per week, to bond with their new addition.

**Location**
============

We are a fully remote team! So any US-based location works for us.

**Let’s make something happen**
===============================

Bring us your experience, your perspective, and your curiosity. We’d love to hear how you’ve helped an organization turn a digital strategy into results.

Teal Media is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. If you need an accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know.

### **Equal Opportunity Statement**

If your experience doesn’t exactly match the qualifications listed, but you believe you’d thrive in this role, we’d love to hear from you. Please apply and tell us why you’re the right person for the job.

We strongly encourage individuals from historically marginalized communities to apply—including Black and Indigenous people, people of color, immigrants, women, LGBTQIA+ individuals, people with disabilities, neurodiverse individuals, and those who have been system-impacted.

Teal Media is an equal opportunity employer that values a diverse workforce and inclusive culture. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, marital status, disability, and veteran status. We are not offering US visa sponsorship at this time.

title: Head of New Verticals Business Planning and Performance
description:
**Our Global Structure**

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

**The Team**

Deliveroo is on a mission to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders.

Our Grocery & Retail team manages Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail businesses. We work closely with our partners and cross-functional teams to drive growth, strengthen the customer proposition and improve business performance.

As the scale and complexity of Grocery & Retail continues to grow, the Strategy & Performance function plays a central role in setting market strategy, leading business planning, embedding strong performance management and ensuring we continue to improve the customer experience.

**The Role**

The Head of Strategy & Performance, New Verticals - Middle East is responsible for setting the strategic direction of Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail business and ensuring we translate that strategy into measurable growth and performance.

This is a high-impact leadership role with significant exposure to senior local and global stakeholders, sitting at the centre of some of the most important decisions shaping the future of Grocery & Retail in the Middle East. You will work closely with the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team across strategy, business planning, performance, customer value proposition and high-priority cross-functional initiatives.

You will lead two core functions: Strategy & Performance and Category Management, setting their direction, building strong teams and bringing together data, customer insight and commercial context to determine where we should focus, what needs to change and how we deliver against our ambitions. Through Category Management, you will shape the customer proposition across key levers including conversion, selection, catalogue quality, pricing, promotions and merchandising, ensuring priorities translate into tangible improvements across the customer journey.

The role combines big-picture strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will need to be equally comfortable defining long-term priorities, diagnosing why the business is performing the way it is, influencing senior stakeholders and getting into the details to unblock complex initiatives.

You will directly manage the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager, with the wider Category Management team also sitting within your organisation.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* **Own Grocery & Retail strategy and planning:** Set the strategic direction for Grocery and non-food Retail, lead annual and quarterly planning, identify and size the biggest growth opportunities, and partner closely with Finance to translate strategic priorities into financial plans, business cases and clear targets.
* **Drive business performance:** Own the overall performance framework for Grocery & Retail, ensuring leadership understands what is driving performance and where action is required. Set the direction for WBRs, MBRs and performance diagnostics, and build a strong culture of accountability and follow-through.
* **Shape the customer proposition and Category Management agenda:** Own the overarching CVP strategy and set the direction for Category Management across key levers including selection, availability, pricing, promotions, merchandising, catalogue quality and conversion. Ensure priorities are grounded in customer behaviour, commercial performance and competitor insights.
* **Lead high-impact strategic initiatives:** Take ownership of complex, cross-functional opportunities and problems that do not naturally sit within one team, from initial diagnosis and strategic direction through to alignment, delivery and handover into BAU.
* **Lead and develop high-performing teams:** Lead the Strategy & Performance and Category Management functions, directly managing the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager. Set clear priorities, coach and develop the team, and build the capabilities, tools and operating models needed for both functions to scale effectively.
* **Influence senior stakeholders and shape decisions:** Act as a strategic partner to the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team, representing Grocery & Retail in key local and central discussions and shaping decisions on the business's most important strategic priorities.

**Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in Strategy & Operations, strategy, consulting, investment banking, commercial, growth or business operations, ideally in a high-growth technology, marketplace or startup environment; experience in on-demand delivery, Grocery, Retail or digital category management is a strong advantage.
* Strong commercial and analytical judgement, with the ability to understand business performance, diagnose root causes and make clear recommendations grounded in data and commercial context.
* Strong ability to structure ambiguity, taking broad or loosely defined business problems, framing the problem clearly, identifying the right questions and translating them into a practical strategy and execution plan.

title: Director of AI Experience Design
description:
**About OpenLoop**
------------------

OpenLoop was co-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go-to-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states.

We are the digital health infrastructure powering modern medicine. Healthcare and non-healthcare brands use our white-label platform to launch, scale and run virtual and hybrid care without the operational complexity. We bring together one of the largest telehealth clinician networks in the country, nationwide payer coverage, integrated pharmacy and lab partners, EHR connectivity, 24/7 patient support and full revenue cycle management. Our partners put their brand on the front end, and everything behind it runs on us. We serve more than 3 million patients a year and power over 1 million visits a month.

**About the Role**
------------------

As **Director of AI Experience Design** at OpenLoop Health, you'll lead design across everything we build: patient and client-facing experiences, our White-Label platform and Launchpad, AI agents and copilots, and the operational platforms our teams use every day.

You'll set a multi-year design vision, grow and lead the team, and own the system our products are built on. That system won't only guide human designers. It becomes the contract AI follows, precise enough that AI tools can build UI that meets our bar. You'll also help designers, engineers, and PMs use AI effectively and at scale, so the team can do more without lowering the bar on quality.

You'll treat design like a business: own the outcomes, make focused bets, and iterate based on customer truth and data. This is a hands-on leadership role at the intersection of strategy and execution.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Set the design vision and strategy across patient, client, and internal products, and turn bold ideas into outcomes patients, clients, and the business can measure.
* Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of designers. Establish clear career paths, strong critique, and a culture with a high bar for craft.
* Own the design system as the source of truth, not a side artifact. That covers tokens, components, information hierarchy, and interaction principles, with theming across the many client brands our White-Label platform supports.
* Make the system AI-ready. Ship standards as code (tokens, patterns, and components wired into the engineering pipeline) so the correct, accessible, compliant pattern is the default for people and AI coding agents alike.
* Measure the system like a product, using adoption in code, pattern reuse, override rates, and first-pass quality, and retire patterns the data shows are failing.
* Help the Product & Tech org use AI effectively and at scale, with the workflows, tools, and standards that let the team ship more without sacrificing quality.
* Set the standard for how AI shows up in our products, across voice, chat, and autonomous agents. That covers trust patterns like transparency, citations, confidence, error recovery, escalation, and human handoff in a regulated healthcare setting.
* Ground decisions in research. Run discovery and usability testing with patients, clinicians, and clients, and prototype in code with real data to validate ideas before they scale.
* Audit existing and acquired surfaces, such as Hey Revia and Season Health, and drive convergence toward a single coherent experience.
* Partner with Product and Engineering leaders on problem definition, roadmap, and scoping.
* Own design KPIs and instrument the experience to quantify impact. Represent Design in executive forums with clear narratives, tradeoffs, and results.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 10+ years in product design, with 3+ years leading teams directly. B2B or B2B2C SaaS experience preferred.
* A portfolio showing end-to-end systems thinking, exceptional craft, and shipped work at scale across web and mobile.
* A track record of designing and shipping AI-powered or agentic experiences in production, and of changing how teams and AI tools actually build.
* Proven ability to recruit, develop, and retain great design talent.
* Inspired by products where systematic design creates clarity, and you know what separates great product experiences from good ones.
* Meticulous and opinionated, able to hold the line on standards while moving fast.
* Comfortable being both hands-on (Figma, tokens, specs, prototyping in code with tools like Claude Code) and strategic (principles, governance, cross-team alignment).
* A strong command of accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and of designing for trust in high-stakes settings.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, able to align executives around crisp narratives and metrics.
* Healthcare or other regulated-industry experience is a plus.

**Our Benefits**
----------------

In addition, for salaried positions you would also be eligible for:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision plans
* Flexible Spending/Health Savings Accounts
* Flexible PTO
* 401(k) + Company Match
* Life Insurance, Pet insurance, and more

**Our Company**
---------------

We have a relatively flat organizational structure here at OpenLoop. Everyone is encouraged to bring ideas to the table and make things happen. This fits in well with our core values of Autonomy, Competence and Belonging, as we want everyone to feel empowered and supported to do their best work.

Sound like a good fit? We’d love to meet you.

title: Senior Director, Data Center Design & Engineering – AI Data Centers
description:
CleanSpark (Nasdaq: CLSK), is a market-leading data center developer with a proven track record of success. We control a portfolio of more than 1.8 GW of power, land, and data centers across the United States powered by globally competitive energy prices. Sitting at the intersection of Bitcoin, energy, operational excellence, and capital stewardship, we optimize our infrastructure to deliver superior returns to our shareholders. Monetizing low-cost, high reliability energy by producing a global emerging critical resource – compute – positions us to prosper in an ever-changing world.

Visit our website at **www.cleanspark.com**.

**Job Overview**

The Senior Director, Data Center Design & Engineering – AI Data Centers serves as CleanSpark’s owner-side engineering authority, setting standards and technical direction for power, cooling, resilience, and facility performance from design through commissioning and operational handover. This role partners across teams to deliver reliable, buildable facilities and strengthen CleanSpark’s in-house engineering capabilities.

Reporting to the VP, Projects, the Senior Director provides technical leadership to the Director, Data Center Design, who manages external consultants and design deliverables. The Senior Director owns engineering standards, system architecture, and technical decisions, partnering with project and construction leadership on matters affecting cost, schedule, or contractual commitments.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Own and maintain CleanSpark’s AI data center engineering standards, Basis of Design (BoD), and design criteria across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, controls, telecom, and site infrastructure disciplines
* Define and approve system architecture for medium-voltage and low-voltage electrical distribution, generation and backup power, UPS, and mechanical cooling (air and liquid) for high-density AI/HPC loads, including redundancy and resilience targets (e.g., N, N+1, 2N) and associated trade-offs
* Lead engineering interfaces with utilities and substation owners: load studies, interconnection requirements, substation and switchyard design, protection and coordination, metering, and energization sequencing in support of path-to-power planning
* Provide technical direction to the Director, Data Center Design and external design consultants; review and approve technical studies, calculations, single-line diagrams, equipment selections, and design deliverables at each stage gate
* Lead constructability, value engineering, and design-for-schedule reviews with Construction and Pre-Construction; resolve technical issues, RFIs, and design conflicts that exceed consultant or project-team authority
* Own the owner-side commissioning program: define commissioning scope and levels, approve commissioning agents and test scripts, witness integrated systems testing, and sign off on energization and turnover readiness
* Lead operational readiness from an engineering standpoint: handover documentation, as-builts, O&M requirements, spare parts and maintainability criteria, and alignment of design intent with Operations’ requirements
* Evaluate and recommend equipment vendors, long-lead procurement specifications, and standard equipment platforms; support procurement with technical bid evaluations and scopes of work
* Assess engineering risk across the portfolio; identify design, power, cooling, and integration risks early and drive mitigation into standards and project plans
* Support tenant and customer technical requirements, including design review responses, change evaluations, and technical representation in customer and partner forums
* Drive standardization and repeatability across sites so designs scale across the portfolio with predictable cost, schedule, and performance
* Build and mentor the in-house engineering team; define roles, technical competencies, and development paths as the organization grows
* Provide clear technical recommendations and updates to project and executive leadership

This role requires professionalism, respect, strong communication, and the ability to work well with others in a team-oriented, inclusive environment.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline
* 15+ years of progressive experience in the design and engineering of data center, mission-critical, or large-scale power and industrial facilities, including at least 5 years in a senior technical leadership role
* Deep working knowledge of data center electrical infrastructure (MV/LV distribution, generation, UPS, protection and coordination) and mechanical infrastructure (chilled water, air and liquid cooling, heat rejection) for high-density compute
* Demonstrated experience defining redundancy and resilience topologies and translating availability targets into design criteria
* Hands-on experience with utility interconnection, substation design, and energization planning for large loads
* Experience leading commissioning (Levels 1–5 / integrated systems testing) and facility turnover on mission-critical projects
* Proven ability to lead engineering consultants, contractors, and internal technical staff, and to make and defend technical decisions with executives, customers, and partners
* Strong constructability judgment and experience partnering with construction teams through design, procurement, and field execution
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional Engineer (PE) license strongly preferred
* Experience with AI, HPC, or hyperscale data center design, including liquid-cooled and high-density rack deployments
* Owner-side experience with a hyperscaler, colocation provider, or large infrastructure developer
* Experience developing and governing engineering standards or Basis of Design programs across multiple sites
* Familiarity with Uptime Institute Tier concepts, ASHRAE TC 9.9 guidelines, NEC/NFPA 70 and NFPA 70E, IEEE power system standards, and applicable energy codes
* Master’s degree in engineering or an MBA
* Experience in a fast-growth owner organization building in-house technical capability

This position may involve duties that require operation of a company vehicle or travel between job sites. As such, candidates must be insurable under CleanSpark's vehicle insurance policy.

title: Technical Architect – SAP S/4HANA, ABAP & BTP
description:
### **Technical Problem Solver | Solution Navigator | Trusted Advisor**

**Location**: Remote
