### **About the Role**

Bramasol is seeking an experienced SAP Technical Architect with strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA, ABAP, and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) to help customers translate complex business challenges into practical, scalable, and sustainable SAP solutions.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical knowledge with business understanding, curiosity, sound judgment, and strong consulting skills. This individual understands not only how SAP technologies work, but when and why to apply them to achieve the best business outcomes.

This is a hands-on, client-facing technical leadership role focused on bridging business and technology. The Technical Architect will evaluate requirements, explore alternative approaches, and recommend appropriate solutions leveraging standard SAP functionality, ABAP development, SAP BTP services, integrations, extensions, automation, and emerging technologies.

We are looking for a natural problem solver who asks thoughtful questions, challenges assumptions constructively, and approaches complex challenges with a “let’s figure out how” mindset, rather than simply explaining why something cannot be done.

### **Key Responsibilities**

### **Business Understanding & Technical Problem Solving**

* Engage with business stakeholders and functional teams to understand business objectives, challenges, and underlying requirements.
* Ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and explore alternative approaches to solving business problems.
* Translate business requirements into practical SAP technical solution options, clearly communicating trade-offs, risks, costs, and long-term implications.
* Evaluate when to leverage standard SAP functionality, ABAP, SAP BTP, integrations, extensions, automation, or other technologies.
* Recommend solutions that balance business value, technical feasibility, implementation effort, and long-term maintainability.

### **Technical Architecture & Solution Design**

* Design scalable, secure, and supportable technical solutions across SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, Public Edition, and hybrid landscapes.
* Apply SAP Clean Core principles when evaluating standard capabilities, ABAP Cloud, in-app and side-by-side extensibility, APIs, and integration approaches.
* Provide architectural guidance across SAP BTP services, including Integration Suite, API Management, and relevant development and automation capabilities.
* Evaluate technical dependencies, data flows, integration patterns, security considerations, performance requirements, and operational supportability.

* Establish and promote technical standards, reusable patterns, and development best practices.

### **Technical Leadership & Delivery Accountability**

* Provide technical leadership across SAP implementations, migrations, integrations, enhancements, and transformation initiatives.
* Take ownership of technical architecture decisions and remain engaged throughout development, testing, deployment, and stabilization to ensure successful outcomes.
* Guide and mentor ABAP developers, integration specialists, BTP consultants, and other technical team members.
* Review technical designs, challenge proposed approaches, and assist in resolving complex technical issues.
* Collaborate with project managers, functional leads, and other architects to identify risks, manage dependencies, and drive decisions to closure.
* Proactively communicate technical concerns, recommend solutions, and follow through on commitments.

### **Customer Consulting & Collaboration**

* Build trusted customer relationships through technical credibility, clear communication, responsiveness, and a commitment to customer success.
* Translate complex technical concepts into understandable business language to support informed decision-making.
* Work collaboratively across functional and technical disciplines to develop solutions that address customer needs.
* Demonstrate ownership, professional judgment, and accountability when navigating challenging customer situations.
* Maintain a solutions-oriented approach, exploring possibilities and practical alternatives when faced with technical or business constraints.

### **Innovation & Business Development**

* Stay current with SAP S/4HANA, BTP, ABAP Cloud, RAP, Fiori, Integration Suite, and emerging SAP technologies.
* Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI-enabled tools, and modern SAP capabilities to improve customer outcomes.
* Contribute to Bramasol’s technical knowledge, reusable solutions, accelerators, and delivery practices.
* Support pre-sales activities, including technical discovery, architecture discussions, solution estimates, and proposal development.

### **Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Extensive experience in SAP technical consulting, solution architecture, or technical leadership within complex enterprise environments.
* Strong foundation in SAP ABAP development, including object-oriented ABAP, enhancements, interfaces, APIs, and modern development approaches.
* Solid understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture, extensibility, integration technologies, and technical design principles.
* Practical experience with SAP BTP and modern SAP integration approaches, particularly Integration Suite.
* Familiarity with SAP Clean Core principles, ABAP Cloud, RAP, CDS, OData, and SAP Fiori development approaches.
* Demonstrated experience defining technical solutions and guiding development teams through implementation.
* Ability to evaluate competing technical approaches and recommend solutions based on business value, architectural suitability, and long-term supportability.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated accountability for technical decisions, delivery commitments, and successful customer outcomes.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Architecture experience across multiple full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementations or transformation initiatives.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition and/or Public Edition.
* Working knowledge of SAP Finance (FI/CO), Sales and Distribution (SD), or other enterprise business processes.
* Experience with event-driven architecture, API Management, SAP BTP extension services, and automation.
* Experience supporting technical pre-sales, solution estimation, and customer advisory engagements.
* SAP certifications in relevant S/4HANA, ABAP, BTP, or Integration Suite technologies.

### **What We’re Looking For**

**Beyond technical expertise, we value consultants who demonstrate:**

* **Curiosity**: A genuine desire to understand business challenges, ask meaningful questions, and explore new possibilities.
* **Ownership and accountability**: A willingness to take responsibility, identify risks early, and follow through until issues are resolved.
* **Collaboration**: The ability to work effectively with customers, functional consultants, developers, and other stakeholders.
* **Practical problem-solving**: The judgment to recognize constraints while finding creative, achievable ways forward.
* **Customer focus**: A commitment to responsiveness, clear communication, professionalism, and earning customer trust.
* **Continuous learning**: An interest in emerging technologies, evolving SAP capabilities, and improving how solutions are delivered.

### **The Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a business-oriented technical architect, natural problem solver, and trusted consultant who can move comfortably between business conversations, architectural decisions, and detailed technical discussions.

They understand the SAP technology ecosystem well enough to determine not simply how to build something, but whether it should be built, where it belongs, and which approach creates the greatest long-term value for the customer.

Most importantly, they combine technical expertise with curiosity, collaboration, sound judgment, and the accountability to see solutions through to successful delivery.

**About PRG**

Production Resource Group (PRG) unites exceptional people and deep production expertise to bring ambitious creative visions to life. As a global production partner across Music & Live TV, Corporate Events & Brand Experiences, TV & Film, Broadway and Sports, we deliver more than 5,000 events a year from 33 locations.

Our teams cover lighting, audio, video, LED, camera, rigging, scenic, automation, broadcast and crew, so wherever you start at PRG, you’ll work alongside specialists in every production discipline. Projects range from a single rental to fully integrated productions, and with a presence across five continents, there’s plenty of room to grow.

At PRG, our people make it possible. Whatever your role, your work shows up in what audiences experience on stage, on screen and beyond.  
  
**Main purpose of the job:** The primary role is to own the full service cycle of the company's LED screen inventory — receiving returned kit, inspecting and sorting it, diagnosing and repairing faults to component level where practical, and prepping and deploying serviceable LED product for upcoming events. The role ensures all LED equipment leaves the warehouse fully tested, correctly configured and within the scheduled time slots, and that the LED fleet is kept at maximum availability with minimal downtime.

  
Qualifications:

### **Experience and technical knowledge**

* Proven experience in LED screen service, repair or technical support, ideally within the live events, rental or staging industry.
* Sound working knowledge of LED video wall systems, including panels, modules, receiving cards, power supplies, data and power distribution, and mapping.
* Hands-on experience with LED processing and configuration software (e.g. Brompton Tessera, NovaStar NovaLCT, Colorlight or equivalent).
* Competent in fault-finding to component level using a multimeter and standard diagnostic tools.
* Good soldering skills, including SMD rework, with an understanding of ESD-safe working practices.
* Familiarity with LED calibration, colour matching and firmware management.
* Understanding of video signal flow and associated equipment (switchers, scalers, media servers, fibre and copper signal transport) is an advantage.
* Manufacturer certification on major LED product lines (e.g. ROE Visual, Absen, INFiLED or equivalent) is desirable.
* Previous experience within a warehouse and equipment rental environment.
* An understanding of stock control and equipment rental software, and good IT skills.
* A good understanding of:
  + Electrical safety at work
  + PAT testing
  + Safe working practices, including ESD control
  + Safe lifting and handling of heavy, fragile equipment

Responsibilities:

**Summary of principal duties and responsibilities**
----------------------------------------------------

### **Receiving and sorting returned kit**

* Receive LED equipment returning from site, checking all items in against the equipment rental software, including bar codes, and reporting any missing or damaged items to the Video Manager.
* Inspect, clean and sort returned LED panels, modules, processors, receiving cards, power supplies, cabling, frames and rigging hardware into serviceable, faulty and write-off categories.
* Quarantine and clearly label all faulty or damaged items so they are not re-issued before repair.
* Log damage reports and site fault notes from returning crews, following up with project teams where information is incomplete.

### **Diagnosis and repair**

* Own the LED repair function, diagnosing and repairing faults on LED panels and associated equipment in line with manufacturer guidance and the Company's standards and procedures.
* Carry out module, receiving card, hub board, power supply and data/power connector replacement, and component-level repair (including SMD/LED pixel replacement and soldering) where practical.
* Perform calibration, colour and brightness matching, and firmware updates on panels, modules and processors (e.g. Brompton, NovaStar, Colorlight or equivalent) so replacement parts blend seamlessly with existing stock.
* Burn-in test and quality check all repaired items before returning them to serviceable stock.
* Maintain accurate service history for every asset on the equipment rental software, recording faults found, parts used, repair time and outcome.
* Identify recurring faults or problem batches and report trends to the Video Manager, recommending corrective action or warranty claims.
* Liaise with manufacturers and suppliers on warranty returns, RMAs, technical support and the purchase of spare parts.
* Manage the LED spares inventory, monitoring stock levels of modules, cards, PSUs, cables and consumables and raising requirements in good time.

### **Prep and deployment**

* Prep LED equipment for forthcoming jobs in line with pick lists and project requirements, ensuring the correct product, quantities, processing, spares and accessories are allocated.
* Build and test LED screen configurations in the warehouse where required, confirming mapping, processor configuration and signal flow before dispatch.
* Ensure all equipment and flight case tour labels are marked up correctly for specific jobs.
* Ensure an appropriate on-site spares kit (modules, cards, PSUs, cables) is prepared and sent with each LED deployment.
* Inform the Video Manager of any shortages or issues with equipment or consumables for forthcoming orders.
* Provide technical briefings and handover notes to site crews where required, and offer remote troubleshooting support to crews on site.
* Where required, attend site to support LED installations, fault-finding or repairs.

### **General warehouse and compliance**

* Prepare and carry out portable appliance testing (PAT testing) where necessary, ensuring all information is logged.
* Assist in the asset entry and bar coding of all new LED equipment received on the equipment rental software system.
* Assist in the undertaking of stock cycle counts with operational departments when scheduled.
* Assist with the loading and unloading of vehicles in a safe manner as directed by the Operations Director.
* Ensure the LED service bench and warehouse areas are kept tidy, organised and ESD-safe at all times.
* Keep up to date with the latest LED products, processing and technology, undertaking manufacturer training when necessary to ensure the correct handling and repair of equipment.
* Report any health and safety issues to the Video Manager or Operations Director.
* Represent the company in a positive and professional manner at all times.
* Ensure the Company's quality standards, policies, rules, procedures and obligations are met and observed at all times.
* Undertake training as required to assist with personal development within the role.
* Fulfil any other reasonable task required by the company.

The above list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be exhaustive. Employees are expected to adopt additional tasks when required. These tasks will be in keeping with the general profile of the role.

**Description**

The Director, Media Strategy is a key role within Evolvics, the integrated media team of Syneos Health Communications. Our Media Strategy team sets the direction for every engagement: what we are solving and for which audiences; where a client’s investment should go, and why; and how the channel mix reaches the right audiences. Strategy not only kicks off the planning process, owning the thinking and steering what is bought and run, but also collaborates with Media Comms and Planning and Media Activation teams once campaigns are live to identify optimizations and actionable insights that shape future planning. In this role, you will be the blueprint developer for pharmaceutical and healthcare brands reaching HCPs, APPs, payers, patients and caregivers. You will partner closely with Group Media Leads and bring in channel, planning and data expertise from day one, so the strategy is grounded, measurable and tied to client business goals. This role also requires close collaboration with internal partner agency Strategy leads to deliver an integrated campaign strategy spanning media and creative/content. You will also participate in and lead new business pitches, shaping the strategic media answer to RFPs and new opportunities. This role reports into the VP of Media Strategy.

* Define the target audience, the audience journey and how the channel mix reaches them
* Set the strategic posture, channel engagement-category mix and channel roles that shape the media approach, and build allocation scenarios

* Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 8+ years of progressively senior experience in media strategy or integrated, multichannel media planning, with a focus on digital media

* Ability to explain complex media thinking in a way that non-media audiences understand
* Strong analytical abilities and quantitative skills; comfortable working with audience, market and performance data alongside analytics partners
* Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a matrixed team

title: Director of Energy Storage Modeling and Design
description:
### **ROLE OVERVIEW**

Pivot Energy is seeking a motivated individual to join our Technical Operations team and lead the company’s Energy Storage modeling and design. The role covers market analysis, technical vendor evaluation, pricing, modeling, sizing, and design recommendations for our storage (DC-coupled with PV solar and standalone storage) project pipeline. This role combines aspects of engineering, collaboration with finance, operations, and policy teams with a goal of deploying and optimizing our storage pipeline.

The Director will be responsible for technical analysis of all solar- plus-storage (DC-coupled) and standalone energy storage market opportunities, including optimal system sizing. The Director will work with the market strategy, policy, and finance teams on revenue modeling and financial analysis, and with Estimation, Procurement, and Commercial Operations to optimize CAPEX and OPEX. The role also works regularly with project development leads and cross-team leads in Project Development Origination, Grid Interconnection, Engineering, Finance, Delivery, O&M, and Asset Management.The Director will have the opportunity to identify and vet potential areas of new energy storage business development, such as new geographies, programs, incentives, or procurements.

This is an opportunity to join a small team in a fast-growing market at an exciting and expanding company. This position offers significant growth potential at a B Corporation with operations across the USA.

### **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop and maintain MATLAB and Excel based revenue projections for solar plus storage and standalone storage projects by maintaining and / or creating new custom tools or using third-party applications
* Use internal Excel-based financial models, determine the cost and overall value of distribution-scale solar plus storage, and standalone storage projects
* Train internal personnel use energy modeling tools (MATLAB or third-party) with a goal of scaling Pivot’s ability to model storage projects and markets.
* Train, teach, guide, and collaborate with external personnel that will review our energy models, inputs, assumptions, equations, and code.
* Work with other Pivot teams on detailed modeling and design and on external quoting of storge model inputs including CAPEX and OPEX
* Support internal opportunity leads from the Commercial team to define project value and pricing terms to developer partners and for utility RFPs through market and project level modeling and design assumptions
* Work with key hardware and software vendors on technical evaluation, pipeline discussions, modeling assumptions, design, pricing, and equipment specifications to optimize project-level design
* Provide design direction including sizing and equipment selection to the Engineering team for project-level design and interconnection applications.
* Support the Market Strategy team in vetting potential new markets through quantitative analysis of sample projects
* Advance individual and team BESS knowledge through structured training, self-directed learning, and educational opportunities across Pivot.
* Build, manage and guide a small team of BESS experts consisting of engineering, analytics, modeling, and other expertise necessary to guide sound market and project decisions related to BESS.
* Support team members’ career growth by helping them think through the market drivers affecting BESS.
* Regularly document and share key insights from energy storage analysis process with relevant internal teams
* Track opportunities and analysis requests in Pivot’s CRM tools

### **REQUIRED COMPETENCIES**

Primary qualifications include demonstrated abilities to work collaboratively within a team, work collaboratively in cross team formats with other team leads, creatively solve quantitative problems, prioritize and manage a mix of short- and long-term deadlines, and professionally represent Pivot Energy externally. Experience in renewables and/or energy storage is required. The Director of Energy Storage Modeling and Design must be able to think critically and work with experienced renewables professionals to decipher the needs of a project/portfolio and find the best solutions in each scenario.

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (preferably Electrical Engineering with a focus on power system and energy system)
* Minimum 5 years of experience in the energy storage industry and storage project development
* Experience in the solar industry and solar project development
* Quantitative & qualitative problem-solving skills and strong communication skills
* Knowledge of renewable energy and project finance concepts
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple critical deadlines
* Passion for learning new things through self-directed study and structured settings
* High degree of proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel
* Willingness to work in databases such as Salesforce

### **PREFERRED COMPETENCIES**

* Master’s degree in a relevant field
* At least 10 years of experience in the renewable energy industry
* Experience in energy trading, wholesale energy markets, or other energy economics disciplines
* Experience with Ascend Analytics, Fractal or similar energy modeling software
* Ability to create and modify energy models and finance models using MATLAB or a similar tool.

$160,000 - $190,000 a year

### **COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

The base salary range for this position is $160,000-$190,000 depending on relevant experience, along with eligibility for the company’s substantial bonus plan, with a target bonus of 30% of annual salary (prorated in the first year based on start date).

  

Pivot Energy is dedicated to providing a great work experience for all employees, placing an emphasis on company culture and a focus on our people. To that end, Pivot offers an outstanding benefits package that includes:

* Excellent health/dental/vision insurance benefits with up to 100% of premiums covered by the company
* Four weeks of vacation in year 1, with increasing vacation accrual rates based on work anniversary date
* Company paid life insurance and short- & long-term disability coverage
* Generous parental leave
* 401(k) matching (after vesting period)
* Work from home stipend for new employees
* Public transit reimbursement
* PTO for volunteering in the community
* Charitable donation matching up to $500/year
* Professional development and educational reimbursements

A complete list of all the benefits Pivot offers may be provided upon request.

Pivot Energy is a national renewable energy provider that develops, finances, builds, owns, and manages solar and energy storage projects that help decarbonize our nation’s electricity, increase equitable access to clean energy for local communities, and provide real cost-savings to American businesses and

families.

We are fiercely dedicated to accelerating the rapid transition taking place in the energy industry to a more decentralized and cleaner approach to power generation. We are committed to positively contributing to the local communities and people we serve with more than clean energy. We believe global warming poses an existential threat to our planet and that we have a responsibility to help mitigate the threat. As a Certified B Corporation and one of **Denver’s “Best Places to Work”****,** we believe that company success is driven by a healthy environment, thriving society, and workplace where all individuals are respected. At Pivot, we are proactively developing and maintaining an inclusive culture, rooted in mutual respect, that supports a workforce of different generations, races, gender identities, sexual orientations, ability statuses, religions, and cultures to work collaboratively together for greater impact. * Work cross-functionally to evaluate new projects, assign quality resources to core teams and ensure resourcing aligns with company priorities, monitor progress, identify and resolve technical issues, and manage escalations.
* Drive and evaluate project and department progress, technical development plans, and results.
* Responsible for driving strategic decision-making based on quality strategy, identifying, and addressing areas of risk.
* Maintains expertise in current and emerging GMP, QSR, Sterilization, regulatory compliance standards, including but not limited to ISO13485, ISO 9001, IEC 62304, ISO 60601, ISO 14971, 21CFR Part 820, and international standards.
* Acts as Tandem representative in FDA and other regulatory inspections; provides direct interaction with officials during audits, inspections, and inquiries.

The starting base pay range for this position is **$110 to $116** per hour. Base pay will vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and may also fluctuate depending on candidate’s location and the overall job market.

**SPONSORSHIP:** Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:**  
At Tandem, we believe joy fuels excellence. That's why we've built a workplace that celebrates your achievements and supports your well-being. Our team thrives on pushing boundaries and fostering growth, all while maintaining a spirit of fun and camaraderie. This is just one of the ways we stay awesome! title: Sr. Director, Sourcing & Procurement – General Contractors, Design Consultants, Substation EPC & Commissioning
description:
**Job Type:** Full-time **| Location:** San Francisco **| Department:** Procurement **| Reporting to:** VP, Data Center Procurement **|****Work Location Type:** #hybrid

The Senior Director, Sourcing & Procurement will own the end-to-end sourcing, contracting, and commercial
  
management strategy for General Contractor (GC), Architecture/Engineering (AE) design consultant, Substation EPC, and Commissioning (Cx) agent services supporting the company's U.S. hyperscale and AI-infrastructure data center construction program. This role is the primary procurement authority across the pre-construction, GC selection, sub trade selection, substation EPC, and commissioning phases of new-build and expansion projects, partnering closely with Construction, Engineering, Development, Legal, and Finance to secure capacity, control cost and schedule risk, and drive consistent, defensible contracting outcomes across a fast-growing portfolio of data center campuses.

  
  

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

  

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

  

Sourcing & Contracting Strategy

* Develop and execute global sourcing strategy for General Contractor, sub trades, Design-Build, and CMAR partners across shell/core, fit-out, and EPC substation scopes for U.S. data center builds.
* Lead procurement of AE/design consultant services (civil, structural, MEP, electrical distribution, low-voltage) and third-party Commissioning (Cx) agents across all project phases (Cx, IST, and turnover).
* Structure and negotiate contracts under GMP, lump sum, CMAR, Design-Build, and Progressive Design-Build models, tailoring commercial structure to project risk profile, schedule urgency, and market capacity.
* Build and maintain a qualified bench of regional and national GC, MEP, AE, and Cx partners to secure capacity ahead of an aggressive, multi-site construction pipeline.

Substation EPC

* Lead sourcing and contracting of Substation EPC scope (utility-interconnect and on-site substations), including transformers, switchgear, protection and controls, and interconnection-related civil/electrical works.
* Coordinate substation EPC procurement timelines with utility interconnection studies, HV transformer lead times, and GC construction sequencing to protect energization milestones.
* Negotiate substation EPC contracts and manage EPC contractor performance across design, procurement, and construction phases, including interface management with the GC and utility.

Cost, Risk & Schedule Management

* Own construction cost negotiations and benchmarking across GC/EPC scopes, including GMP validation, change order governance, and open-book cost reconciliation.
* Partner with Legal and Risk on contract terms covering liquidated damages, bonding/insurance, indemnification, OFCI/CFCI/ODCI scope delineation, and warranty obligations.
* Monitor project schedules jointly with Construction Management to identify sourcing risk (labor, equipment, long-lead materials) and proactively mitigate GC/Cx-driven schedule slippage.

title: Director of Brand Design
description:
**About Cardiff**

Cardiff lends to small businesses. Since 2004 we've funded more than $12 billion across the country, to businesses in logistics, healthcare, construction, professional services, and plenty in between. We're building our own underwriting technology, and we still answer the phone; our customers need capital fast, and they want a straight answer from a person who can actually help.

**Location:** San Diego, CA or Remote (U.S.)

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Department:** Product and Design/Marketing

**Reports to:** CMO

**Why This Role Matters**

Our customers are small business owners who need capital quickly and clearly. Every screen, form, and message they see shapes whether they trust us enough to apply, finish, and come back. As Director of Brand Design, you'll set the standard for how Cardiff looks, feels, and works across our product, our brand, and every customer touchpoint, and you'll build the team and design system that keep that standard high as we grow.

**What You'll Own**

  

* Set the design vision and strategy for Cardiff's customer-facing products, internal tools, and brand, in partnership with Engineering, Marketing, and leadership
* Lead end-to-end product design for the borrower journey, from first visit and application through underwriting, funding, and repeat borrowing
* Design internal tools for our underwriting, funding, sales, and servicing teams so they can move faster with fewer errors
* Build and maintain a scalable design system in Figma, with documented components, patterns, and accessibility standards that engineering can ship from directly
* Own brand and visual identity across web, paid media, email, direct mail, and sales materials, partnering closely with Marketing on campaign creative
* Ground design decisions in evidence through customer research, usability testing, funnel analytics, and split testing, with clear metrics tied to conversion and customer experience
* Ensure designs meet accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA) and the disclosure and compliance requirements of a regulated lending business
* Hire, lead, and develop the design team, running a predictable cadence of critique, delivery, and accountability
* Use AI tools throughout the design process, from research synthesis to prototyping, and help the team do the same

**What We're Looking For**

* **Experience:** 8+ years of product design experience, with at least 3 years leading designers and owning design outcomes for a digital product at a growth-stage company. Experience in fintech, lending, or financial services is a strong plus.
* **Product Design Craft:** A portfolio that shows strong interaction design, visual design, and information architecture on complex, multi-step flows such as applications, onboarding, or dashboards.
* **Design Systems:** Hands-on experience building and scaling a design system, and working closely with engineers to implement it in code.
* **Tools:** Expert-level Figma skills, fluency with prototyping and AI-assisted design tools, and a working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and how front-end code gets built.
* **Research and Data:** Comfort running user research and usability tests, and reading product analytics to find friction and measure the impact of design changes.
* **Leadership Style:** Hands-on, execution-focused leader with strong cross-functional communication skills; able to give clear feedback, make decisions with incomplete information, and explain design choices to non-designers. **Must have experience managing at least 4 direct reports.**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Industry Perspective:** Experience designing for small business owners, B2B customers, or regulated, high-trust products such as lending, payments, or banking.
* **Conversion Design:** A track record of improving funnel conversion, application completion, or activation through measured design changes.
* **Brand Leadership:** Experience leading a brand refresh or building a visual identity system that works across product and marketing channels.
* **Content Design:** Skill at writing and shaping clear product copy, especially for financial terms, disclosures, and error states.
* **Organizational Scale:** Experience building a design function at an early or growth-stage company, including hiring, career leveling, and managing freelance and agency partners.

**This Role May Not Be a Fit If You**

* Want a strategy or advisory seat rather than hands-on ownership of the work that ships
* Have been out of the tools long enough that you'd need someone else to build the file or the prototype
* Prefer structured corporate environments with clear lanes and layers between you and the business
* Solve problems offline and come back with polished results, instead of sharing work early and communicating while you work
* Use AI tools to assist your old workflow, rather than having rebuilt your workflow around them

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Base salary range: $195,000+
* Performance bonus of up to 20% of base, tied to delivery and business outcomes
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Flexible PTO and observed holidays
* Remote-first, with support for your home-office setup
* Direct access to leadership and to the problems that matter

Governance & Compliance is the core of Vanta. It covers the frameworks, controls, policies, audits, and org structures that thousands of companies use to run their security programs. **What you'll be doing**

The mission of Shorthand is to create a beautifully informed world. To do that, we need to simplify professional visual storytelling for the web, otherwise it will remain prohibitively complex for iconic brands and institutions to elegantly inform and inspire their discerning audiences.

Our Account Managers are a big part of the Shorthand magic.

This role owns the commercial relationship for a Book of Business of existing customers across North America. That means taking responsibility for delivering expansion revenue from new use cases, adjacent teams, additional business units and different geographies, as well as owning the commercial aspects of renewals.

You will partner closely with the Customer Success team who own gross revenue retention and are responsible for earning the renewal over the subscription period through editorial strategy, onboarding, product adoption and generally ensuring the customer achieves their business objectives with our product. You'll plan accounts together, raise risks and opportunities early, and show up to customers as one team.

You'll join our Sales team and report to the Head of Sales.

**In this role you'll:**

* Own the commercial relationship for your Book of Business.
* Grow your accounts through upsell, cross-sell and expansion into new teams, brands, regions and business units.
* Own commercial negotiations with senior stakeholders and procurement, including multi-year agreements and pricing.
* Partner closely with Customer Success, who earn the renewal over the subscription period while you close the renewal — you lead commercial renewal discussions.
* Act urgently upon signals from Customer Success and customer health tools to protect existing revenue, win expansion revenue, and strengthen the commercial relationship.
* Build and execute strategic account plans for your largest and highest-potential customers, aligned to their goals and Shorthand's growth objectives.
* Develop multi-threaded executive relationships across business and technical stakeholders, so every account has senior sponsorship and no single point of failure.
* Partner closely with Customer Success on account health, adoption, onboarding of new teams and risk mitigation
* Run executive and quarterly business reviews with Customer Success that demonstrate value delivered and set the agenda for growth.
* Develop tailored proposals, business cases and presentations that connect Shorthand to measurable customer outcomes.
* Forecast renewal and expansion revenue accurately, including expected close date, projected deal size and probability.
* Act as the voice of the customer, sharing feedback with Customer Success, Sales, Channel Partners, Growth, Marketing, Product and Engineering to shape our roadmap and go-to-market.

  

**We are looking for someone who:**

* Has a proven track record of retaining and growing a Book of Business in enterprise or mid-market SaaS, with measurable results against renewal, NRR and expansion targets.
* Treats their Book of Business like their own business, balancing retention and growth with discipline and commercial judgement.
* Is skilled at uncovering new buying centers within existing customers and turning strong relationships into expansion revenue.
* Builds trusted, long-term relationships with senior stakeholders across marketing, content, communications, editorial, digital and web platform teams.
* Works naturally in partnership with Customer Success, sharing ownership of the customer and knowing when to lead and when to support.
* Has experience selling or managing CMS, digital publishing, martech, DXP or related technology solutions in enterprise organizations.
* Is technically credible and confident discussing CMS workflows, integrations and implementation considerations with customer web and platform teams.
* Is data-driven, using account health and usage insight to prioritize effort and forecast accurately.
* Is a confident negotiator who can manage complex renewals, multi-year agreements and procurement processes.
* Communicates exceptionally well in both written and verbal formats, and can simplify complex concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Learns quickly, prioritizes effectively and maintains high attention to detail across a portfolio of accounts.
* Thrives working remotely and collaboratively across distributed teams and time zones.

  

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 5+ years in B2B SaaS account management or sales, including 3+ years owning a Book of Business with retention and expansion targets.
* Significant experience working with CEOs, CMOs, VPs and Directors of Marketing, Content, Communications, Editorial and related functions.
* A track record of hitting or exceeding gross and net revenue retention targets.
* Experience managing renewals and expansion deals with enterprise procurement and legal teams.
* Experience within organizations using WordPress, Adobe Experience Manager, Sitecore, Contentful, Optimizely, Drupal or similar CMS/DXP platforms.
* Experience running executive or quarterly business reviews with senior customer stakeholders.
* Proven ability to sell collaboratively across Customer Success, Product, Marketing and channel partners.
* Comfort with CRM and account health tooling, and experience using AI to work more productively.
* Technical aptitude or a background in technology is highly regarded.

  

**Personality Attributes**

* You are a proactive self-starter who doesn't need to be told what to do and is resourceful in finding solutions.
* You are collaborative, consultative and not afraid to get your hands dirty.
* You care deeply about customer outcomes and see renewals as the result of value delivered.
* You thrive in a fast-paced environment and possess a high level of curiosity.
* You are goal-oriented, resilient and motivated by achieving outstanding results.
* You are a supportive and proactive team player.
* You love working remotely.
* You are tech-savvy and excited to become an expert in the Shorthand platform.

  

**Why work for us**

We offer:

* Fully remote working, flexible hours and a co-working allowance if you'd like one.
* True autonomy, with the freedom to own and grow your Book of Business.
* The opportunity to shape how we retain and grow our customer base as we continue to scale across North America.
* A category-defining product trusted by leading global brands, publishers, universities and not-for-profits.
* The opportunity to work in a growing SaaS company that's still small enough for you to make a real impact.
* A home office allowance, laptop and any peripherals you need to do your best work.
* An Employee Share Option Plan for all team members.
* A Health & Wellness Allowance together with access to coaching and counselling services.
* A 401(k) plan and 100% employer-paid healthcare premiums for US-based team members.
* Paid parental leave if you're growing your tribe.
* A proudly carbon-neutral organisation, taking climate action with Trace as part of our broader sustainability strategy.
* A base salary range of US$90,000–110,000, plus bonuses. Actual compensation will depend on your skills, experience and local market benchmarks.

  

**Shorthand's interview process**

We value direct communication and want to be transparent about how we hire.

Our process includes:

* An initial Zoom conversation with the hiring manager.

* A mock discovery call and brief platform demo with a member of the Sales team (approximately 2 hours prep).

* Panel interview with members of the global team, including our CEO.

* Reference and background checks before a formal offer is made.

Our workplace is 100% distributed and all interviews are conducted virtually. Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process. Please submit PDF versions of documents in your application.

title: Director, Externally Sponsored Research
description:
At Insmed, every moment and every patient counts — and so does every person who joins in. As a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the lives of patients with serious and rare diseases, you’ll be part of a community that prioritizes the human experience, celebrates curiosity, and values every person’s contributions to meaningful progress. That commitment has earned us recognition from leading workplace and culture organizations, including Science's Top Employers, Great Place To Work® in the U.S., and Fortune's Best Workplaces in BioPharma.

  
  

For patients, for each other, and for the future of science, we’re in. Are you?

  
  

**About the Role:**

We’re looking for a Director, Externally Sponsored Research on the Medical Services team to help us expand what’s possible for patients with serious diseases. Reporting to the Senior Director, Medical Services, you’ll own the end-to-end External Research capability, from development of ESR tactics, proposal intake and review, contracting, execution, budget and invoice management and study close-out, ensuring all activity is conducted compliantly and in alignment with Insmed's scientific and business priorities. You will be a strategic partner to the Integrated Evidence Teams (IET) and responsible for strategic governance of Insmed Medical Affairs Research Review Committee (IMARRC), working cross-functionally with Medical Strategy, Clinical Development, Research, HEOR, Regulatory, and Legal to shape the Areas of Interest (AOI) and evidence generation strategy.

**What You'll Do:**

In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to serve as the point of accountability for strategic portfolio management and performance, budget stewardship, audit readiness, and continuous improvement, and be responsible for troubleshooting complex operational and scientific challenges as they arise, partnering closely with Medical Strategy, Legal, Compliance and the Integrated Evidence Teams (IETs), as applicable. You’ll also:

  
  

* Translate IET - identified evidence needs into actionable External Research strategy and works cross-functionally to pressure-test incoming study concepts against strategic priorities before they advance to IMARRC review, ensuring the Externally Sponsored Research portfolio is scientifically differentiated, non-duplicative, and directly responsive to the identified evidence gaps. This role serves as a partner to the Insmed Medical Affairs Research Review Committee (IMARRC) Chair, manage the overall process and governance for IMARRC, ensuring robust, efficient, and compliant review of all new proposals and protocols. Critically review and track all new proposals received, ensuring readiness for IMARRC review including completion of debarment check and initial review. Guide committee process, resolve escalated issues, and ensure consistency of historical committee decisions across reviews. Partner with Medical Directors pre/post meetings and oversee the full review workflow, including meeting minutes, requests for additional information, post-meeting approvals, portal voting, and compliant stakeholder/investigator communications.
* Manage IIR, Collaborative Research, and Quality Improvement contracting and FMV processes. Partner with Global and affiliate Legal teams to ensure contract integrity, lead negotiation of complex or high-value agreements, and ensure consistent, accurate, and defensible FMV methodology across the portfolio, including required compliance checks (OIG, FDA Debarment List, etc.).
* Own accountability for study start-up tracking, maintenance, and close-out across all IMARRC-approved projects. Ensure accurate and timely budget tracking, accruals, forecasting and annual planning procedures.
* Collaborate with Tech Ops/Supply Chain to ensure accurate forecasting and planning of investigational product needs, including shipping, tracking, expiry management, and temperature excursions.
* Maintain accurate tracking of study timelines and planned/actual publications, ensuring draft publications move through compliant review with internal/investigator feedback, and that publication updates are appropriately captured in the appropriate databases. Collaborate with the publications team to ensure tracking and management of collaborative research projects and associated publications.
* Manage the Grants portal (and related systems) including implementation and improvements, partnering cross-functionally to modernize infrastructure. Develop and track key metrics (e.g., cycle time, AOI alignment accuracy, information extraction accuracy) to measure External Research performance and drive continuous improvement.
* Support enhancements to the External Research SOP(s), driving regular updates to improve process clarity and organizational effectiveness. Ensure compliance with SOPs across all activities, proactively identify and escalate issues or risks, and maintain full audit readiness, including up-to-date files and notes to file.
* Continuously evolve Insmed's approach to external research to improve the external investigator experience, operational efficiency, and responsiveness to industry trends and regulatory expectations. Create and evolve strategy for external research capabilities.
* Support brand planning related to externally sponsored research.
  

  

**Who You Are:**

**Basic Qualifications**

You meet one of the following minimum education and experience requirements:

* Advanced degree and 5 years of experience in biotech/pharmaceutical field; OR
* Master's degree and 8 years of experience in biotech/pharmaceutical field; OR
* Bachelor's degree and 12 years of experience in biotech/pharmaceutical field
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

In addition to meeting the basic qualifications above, you will also possess some or all of the following:

* Advanced Degree (e.g., MPH, MS, PharmD, PhD, MD, NP-C) or equivalent along with 10+ years of relevant work experience in the pharmaceutical/biotech industry and 8+ years of active work experience in Clinical Research and/or Medical Affairs, including direct experience with Externally Sponsored Collaborative Research, Investigator-Initiated Research, and Quality Improvement Projects.
* Demonstrates advanced knowledge of clinical trial operations and processes.
* Strong scientific and therapeutic area acumen in the area of Pulmonology, sufficient to critically evaluate the scientific merit, design, and feasibility of research study concepts and protocols, and engage credibly as a scientific peer with investigators, Medical Directors, and IET/HEOR colleagues; working knowledge of clinical trial design, and the scientific publication process preferred.
* Demonstrates ability to lead, and influence, without formal authority, including cross-functional partners, extended team members, and external vendors; prior people management experience a plus but not required.
* Demonstrates experience supporting or driving governance for cross-functional committees (e.g., scientific/research review committees) is strongly preferred.
* Proven track record of developing and executing External Research or grants strategy in a regulated, compliance-driven environment.
* Strong financial acumen, including budget ownership, forecasting, accruals, and Fair Market Value (FMV) principles.
* Excellent record of success in a fast-paced, dynamic environment; self-motivated and able to operate with limited supervision while providing clear direction to others.
* Strong foresight for areas of growth, improvement, refinement, and potential risk, with the judgment to escalate appropriately.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership and executive committees and ability to effectively lead, motivate, and ensure compliance across a department and with external vendors and investigators.
  

**Where You’ll Work**

This is a fully remote role. It can be performed effectively from anywhere while staying connected to your Insmed team and community. Occasional travel for team meetings or events will be expected.

  

**Travel Requirements**

This role requires occasional domestic/global] travel (approximately 10%)

title: Digital Merchandising Lead, Vacation Rentals
description:
Description:

**About Us**

Dream Resorts is a hospitality brand dedicated to delivering exceptional vacation rental and property management experiences for guests and homeowners alike. Through its premier brands, Maui Resort Rentals in Hawai‘i and Beachview Rentals in Newport Beach, California, we manage a high quality portfolio of vacation homes in some of the world’s most sought after destinations, offering something for every type of traveler. Our culture is rooted in teamwork, respect, and a shared passion for hospitality, supported by competitive benefits and a workplace that empowers growth.

This commitment to our people has earned recognition across the Dream Resorts family of brands. Subsidiaries of Dream Resorts have been recognized across multiple prestigious workplace awards, including Hawaii Business Magazine’s 2026 Best Places to Work, where Dream Resorts was also honored for fostering a family friendly workplace, Outside Magazine’s Best Places to Work, the Inc. 5000 Best Places to Work, and Hawaii Pacific Business News’ Best Places to Work.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a Digital Merchandising Lead, Vacation Rentals to own the creation, maintenance, and performance of listings for more than 400 vacation rental properties in Maui and Newport Beach. This person will keep those listings accurate, compelling, and consistent across our direct booking websites, Airbnb, Vrbo, Expedia, and Booking.com, and will be accountable for how our properties are presented to guests.

You will set photography standards, direct our in-house photographers and outside vendors, select and arrange photos, and write copy that sells each property. You will also build and update listings yourself in our platform as an ongoing, hands-on part of the role. Using guest feedback, booking data, and your own judgment, you will find the listings with the most room to improve, make the changes, and measure the results.

This role suits someone with strong commercial instincts who understands what makes people buy and knows how to turn that understanding into copy and presentation decisions. We welcome backgrounds in e-commerce, sales, and marketing, and weigh ability, learning speed, and commercial judgment more heavily than vacation rental experience.

*This is a remote work opportunity in the following approved states only:**CA, HI, AZ, OR, UT, IL, TN, AR, FL, CO*

Requirements:

**Listing Management & Accuracy**

* Build listings for new properties on our websites and online travel agencies (OTAs) in time for each property's launch
* Keep listing details accurate and consistent across all platforms, including amenities and descriptions
* Audit listings on a regular schedule and correct errors, gaps, and inconsistencies
* Work with reservations and technical teams to resolve listing, property management system, and channel integration issues
* Use AI tools to improve listing quality and reduce repetitive work

**Listing Presentation & Performance**

* Select and arrange photos to highlight each property's strongest selling points and give guests a reason to book
* Set photo standards, brief our in-house photographers, source outside vendors as needed, and review their work
* Manage photography schedules and deliverables, and prioritize reshoots for the properties with the most to gain
* Write, edit, and test titles and descriptions that bring out each property's selling points
* Track listing performance across the portfolio, including search ranking, click-through rate, conversion, occupancy, and review scores
* Use guest reviews and feedback to identify underperforming listings, prioritize improvements, and assess results
* Report on listing improvements and their impact on bookings

**Partnership & Communication**

* Maintain relationships with OTA account representatives and make use of their programs, insights, and tools
* Coordinate promotional opportunities with channel partners, within pricing set by revenue management
* Partner with revenue management, marketing, and operations so listings reflect current property conditions and amenities
* Stay current on platform updates, policy changes, and new features, and adjust our listings accordingly

**Skills & Competencies**

* Persuasive, clear copywriting grounded in an understanding of why people buy
* Commercial judgment: weighs effort against likely booking impact when deciding what to work on
* Exceptional attention to detail, balanced with the judgment to prioritize and meet deadlines
* Visual judgment for photography, composition, and photo sequencing
* Learns unfamiliar platforms quickly and works independently
* Ability to give photographers and vendors clear direction and candid feedback while maintaining strong working relationships
* Uses data to make decisions and evaluate results

**Relationships & Reporting**

* Reports to: Director of Marketing & Revenue Management
* Direct reports: None
* Works closely with: in-house photographers, vendors, revenue management, reservations, marketing, technical team, and property operations
* External partners: OTA account representatives and photography vendors

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in e-commerce merchandising, online marketplace or listing management, digital marketing, copywriting, or a related role where your work directly drove online sales or bookings
* 2+ years of experience directing creative work (photographers, designers, or writers) or managing outside vendors
* Residence in one of the approved hiring states
* Ability to travel one to four weeks per year for onsite meetings or conferences
* Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated workspace

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience selling products online through e-commerce, marketplaces, or direct response marketing
* Experience with Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, Expedia, or similar host and partner tools
* Experience with a property management system or channel manager
* Photo editing skills in Lightroom, Photoshop, or similar software
* Experience with A/B testing or conversion rate optimization
* Experience building AI-powered workflows, integrations, or tools, with enthusiasm for pushing what AI can do in day-to-day work
* Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience

**Compensation & Benefits:**

Salary Range: $95,000 - $110,000 per year

Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance (100% employer-paid option for employees and dependents)

401(k) with up to 5% company match

Employer-paid Life/AD&D

Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)

Paid Sick Leave

Remote - must reside in CA, HI, AZ, OR, UT, IL, TN, AR, FL or CO

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. Ever since our first credit card customer in 1994, Capital One has recognized that technology and data can enable even large companies to be innovative and personalized. As one of the first large enterprises to go all-in on the public cloud, Capital One built cloud and data management tools that didn’t exist in the marketplace to operate at scale. **About Servier**

  

Servier Pharmaceuticals is an independent, commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company built to think differently about what long-term impact can look like in healthcare. Launched in 2018 and backed by the strength and stability of the Servier Group, our foundation-governed model gives us the freedom to invest for the future, move with purpose, and stay focused on where patients need us most.

  

In less than a decade, we have grown from a small U.S. presence into a rapidly expanding, multi-billion-dollar organization with an award-winning culture, six commercial products, and a portfolio strengthened through bold strategic investments and innovation. Our teams are helping advance important new treatment options for patients facing serious diseases with high unmet need, particularly in rare oncology and neurology.

  

Our ambition is clear: to build a leading U.S. biopharmaceutical company known for scientific excellence, operational strength, and deep commitment to patients. Just as important is how we build it. We are creating a culture that values entrepreneurship, collaboration, accountability, and the belief that individuals at every level can shape the future of the company.

  

For people who want more than a job — who want the opportunity to build, lead, grow, and make a measurable impact — Servier offers the chance to be part of a company with purpose, momentum, and the ability to help define what comes next for patients and for our industry.

We are seeking top tier candidates to join our team as it strives to achieve its vision of developing innovative medications to transform the lives of patients. * Monitors operating costs consistent with territory budget guidance
* Complies with all laws, regulations, policies and SOPs that govern the conduct of Servier activities
* Engage in effective, fair-balanced clinical dialogue with customers, utilizing approved corporate, promotional and other resources to facilitate customer engagements in an appropriate and compliant manner
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with our co-promotion partner in the territory and with all customers in assigned geography
* Prepare robust account and territory business plans, to utilize routinely in planning with other commercial team members and to guide activity
* Represent Servier positively and professionally at company meetings, conferences and other functions
* Develop strong internal and external relationships to enable appropriate, compliant business partnerships
* Achieve or exceed sales forecasts and targets, within budget
* Understand the regulatory environment and comply with all legal, regulatory and compliance requirements
* Perform ad-hoc projects to support the business as requested
* Other duties as required or directed by the Regional Sales Director

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience, Scientific Degree a plus.

* 5+ years of strong results-oriented biotech/pharmaceutical, lab, or medical devices sales experience

* Candidates must demonstrate a consistent track record of success as a top sales performer.
* Complex sales model experience required.
* Experience launching a new product is a plus.

**Location:** Remote  
**Reports to:** Director of Marketing  
**Company:** Truly Free Home  
**Salary:** $80,000 - 100,000

**Role Overview:**

We’re looking for a **performance-obsessed Direct Response Copywriter** who understands that great copy doesn’t just sound good—it converts.

This role sits at the intersection of **creative strategy and revenue growth**, owning the messaging that drives customer acquisition, retention, and LTV across our DTC channels. You’ll write high-converting copy for paid media, email/SMS, landing pages, and funnels—while continuously testing, iterating, and optimizing based on performance data.

If you think in hooks, obsess over CTRs and CVRs, and love turning insights into scalable creative—this role is for you.

**What You’ll Own:**  
***Direct Response Copy (Core Focus):***

* Write and optimize conversion-driven copy across:
  + Paid social ads (Meta, TikTok, YouTube)

* + Email & SMS campaigns and flows
  + Landing pages and product detail pages
  + Advertorials and funnels

* Develop high-performing hooks, angles, and messaging frameworks
* Partner with creative and media teams to concept and iterate ad creative
* Continuously test variations (headlines, offers, positioning) to improve KPIs
* Analyze performance data and translate insights into new copy directions

  

***Testing & Optimization:***

* Own copy testing roadmap and iteration cycles
* Identify winning messaging and scale it across channels
* Balance speed and quality—shipping frequently while improving performance

  

***Blog & SEO Support:***

* Write or support blog content aligned with SEO and brand goals
* Translate product and customer insights into educational, conversion-aware content
* Collaborate with SEO or content teams to maintain consistency in voice and messaging

  

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Your copy directly improves conversion rates, CTR, and CAC efficiency
* You consistently generate new winning angles and hooks
* You contribute to scalable creative that drives measurable revenue growth
* You operate with a test learn iterate mindset, not “one-and-done” writing

  

**What You Bring:**

* 3+ years of direct response copywriting experience (DTC or performance marketing preferred)
* Proven track record of writing copy that drives measurable results
* Deep understanding of:

* + Customer psychology and buyer intent
  + Offers, hooks, and urgency
  + Paid social and lifecycle marketing ecosystems

* Experience working closely with paid media, creative, or growth teams
* Comfort using data to inform decisions (you don’t need to be an analyst, but you use performance insights)

  

**Bonus Points:**

* Experience in DTC, CPG, or subscription businesses
* Familiarity with platforms like Klaviyo, Meta Ads, or TikTok Ads
* Exposure to SEO or long-form content strategy

  

**How You Work:**

* You think like a marketer, not just a writer
* You move fast and iterate faster
* You care about performance over opinions
* You’re constantly studying what’s working in the market—and applying it

  

**Why This Role is Different:**  
This isn’t a traditional copywriting role. You won’t be writing in a vacuum—you’ll be:

* Directly tied to revenue and growth
* Collaborating with a performance-driven team
* Shipping work that gets tested, measured, and scaled

title: Manager, Digital Marketing
description:
At SCORE, our mission is to foster vibrant small business communities through mentoring and education. Through its network of volunteers, education, and resources, SCORE empowers small business owners to sustain successful businesses at any stage of their small business journey

  

We're seeking a **Digital Marketing Manager** to help expand SCORE’s national reach, strengthen audience engagement, and connect more entrepreneurs with the ongoing support needed to succeed.

  

**About the Role**

  

The Manager, Digital Marketing leads SCORE’s national digital marketing strategy to increase brand awareness, engage key audiences, and connect more entrepreneurs with SCORE’s mentoring and educational resources. This role oversees national social media, email marketing, paid advertising, marketing automation, and digital performance analytics to drive measurable audience growth, engagement, and conversion.

  

Through data-driven decision-making and cross-functional collaboration, the Manager, Digital Marketing strengthens SCORE’s digital presence and advances organizational marketing priorities. The role partners closely with the Field Marketing Manager to align national digital strategies with chapter needs, maintain consistent standards across digital channels, and equip chapters with the tools and guidance needed to support local marketing efforts.

The ideal candidate is an experienced digital marketer who knows how to capture ideas and turn them into bold, measurable results. This person is comfortable working within a nationwide network of volunteers and thrives on connecting with audiences and inspiring action.

**This is a full-time, non-exempt, remote position with a required schedule of Monday-Friday from 9:00 am - 5:00 pm Eastern.** Applicants should reside in one of the following states: AZ, CA, DC, FL, IL, LA, MD, MI, NC, NY, OH, OK, PA, TX, VA

**Salary Range: $98,555 - $102,000**

At SCORE, we recognize that our employees are essential to advancing our mission. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package including:

  

* Competitive salary
* 100% employer-paid medical eligible for employees
* 401(k) retirement savings plan
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Paid holidays and two floating holidays
* Paid Parental Leave
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Remote work environment
* Professional development opportunities

  

**No phone or email inquiries will be accepted regarding this position.**

**Responsibilities:**

**National Digital Marketing Strategy**

* Develop and execute national digital marketing strategies aligned with organizational goals, audience needs, and annual marketing priorities.
* Establish channel strategies, objectives, key performance indicators, and measurement frameworks for national digital marketing initiatives.
* Manage national digital marketing campaigns that increase awareness of SCORE, promote mentoring and educational resources, and support organizational priorities, including volunteer recruitment and fundraising.
* Identify opportunities to improve audience acquisition, engagement, retention, and conversion across digital channels.
* Monitor digital marketing trends, emerging platforms, and evolving audience behaviors to inform strategy and identify opportunities for innovation.
* Collaborate with the Senior Director, Marketing & Communications and other marketing team members to ensure digital initiatives support integrated marketing campaigns and organizational objectives.
* Contribute to annual marketing planning, budgeting, and performance reviews for national digital marketing initiatives.
* Support the development and implementation of marketing policies, standards, and processes related to digital channels.
* Provide digital marketing expertise and recommendations to support organizational priorities and cross-functional initiatives.

  

**Email Marketing & Marketing Automation**

* Lead national email marketing strategy, including audience segmentation, campaign planning, lifecycle communications, and performance optimization.
* Oversee the administration, configuration, and effective use of SCORE’s national email marketing and marketing automation platforms.
* Develop and optimize automated email journeys that guide audiences toward relevant SCORE resources, including mentoring, workshops, educational content, volunteer opportunities, and fundraising initiatives.
* Establish email marketing standards and best practices for audience targeting, personalization, deliverability, accessibility, and performance measurement.
* Analyze email engagement and conversion data to identify opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness and audience experience.
* Partner with the Field Marketing Manager to ensure email marketing tools, workflows, guidance, and resources support chapter needs and align with national standards.
* Collaborate with other marketing team members to coordinate email communications within integrated campaigns and maintain a cohesive audience experience.

  

**National Social Media & Digital Community Engagement**

* Develop and execute SCORE’s national social media strategy to increase brand awareness, audience engagement, and visibility of SCORE’s mentoring and educational resources.
* Oversee national social media content planning, publishing, community engagement, and performance analysis across relevant platforms.
* Establish national social media standards, best practices, and guidance that promote brand consistency, accessibility, and effective audience engagement.
* Monitor platform performance, audience behavior, and emerging social media trends to inform content strategy and channel optimization.
* Identify opportunities to amplify SCORE’s impact through success stories, mentor and volunteer spotlights, educational content, and integrated marketing campaigns.
* Partner with the Field Marketing Manager to align national and chapter social media efforts, support consistent standards, and identify opportunities to amplify relevant local content.
* Monitor social media practices and emerging platform considerations to help maintain effective, responsible, and consistent national digital engagement.

  

**Digital Advertising & Audience Growth**

* Develop and manage national digital advertising strategies across relevant paid media channels to increase awareness, reach priority audiences, and drive engagement with SCORE resources.
* Plan, execute, monitor, and optimize digital advertising campaigns based on established objectives, audience insights, and performance data.
* Manage campaign targeting, budgets, creative testing, landing page alignment, and conversion tracking to improve effectiveness and cost efficiency.
* Support integrated campaigns promoting SCORE mentoring, workshops, educational resources, volunteer opportunities, and fundraising initiatives.
* Use audience insights and campaign results to identify opportunities to improve acquisition, engagement, and conversion.
* Coordinate with the Field Marketing Manager on advertising guidance, resources, and approaches that may support chapter-level marketing efforts.

  

**Analytics, Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish and maintain reporting frameworks to measure the performance and impact of national digital marketing channels and campaigns.
* Analyze data from email, social media, paid advertising, web analytics, and other relevant platforms to evaluate results and identify actionable insights.
* Translate performance data into recommendations that improve audience engagement, campaign effectiveness, channel performance, and resource allocation.
* Monitor key performance indicators and communicate results, trends, opportunities, and risks to the Senior Director, Marketing & Communications.
* Ensure appropriate tracking, tagging, and measurement practices are implemented across digital campaigns in collaboration with relevant internal stakeholders and vendors.
* Use testing, experimentation, and ongoing optimization to improve digital marketing outcomes.
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve reporting, and strengthen the use of data in marketing decisions.

  

**Collaboration & Vendor Management**

* Collaborate with the Brand & Campaigns Manager, Communications Manager, Field Marketing Manager, and other stakeholders to execute integrated marketing initiatives and maintain a coordinated audience experience.
* Partner with the Field Marketing Manager to clarify channel responsibilities, align national and chapter marketing practices, and provide guidance that helps chapters apply digital marketing best practices.
* Manage digital marketing vendors, agencies, and contractors, including project requirements, deliverables, timelines, performance, and budgets.
* Coordinate cross-functional digital marketing projects to ensure work is delivered efficiently, on schedule, and in alignment with organizational priorities.
* Document processes, establish best practices, and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and collaboration.
* Stay informed about digital marketing tools, technologies, and platform capabilities that may improve SCORE’s marketing effectiveness.

  

**Revenue Growth, Lead Generation & Conversion**

* Develop and execute digital marketing strategies that support SCORE’s revenue-generation goals, including donor acquisition and retention, fundraising campaigns, workshop registrations, and other revenue-generating initiatives.
* Partner with the Senior Director, Marketing & Communications and relevant organizational stakeholders to identify priority audiences, develop acquisition strategies, and move prospective supporters and customers through measurable conversion journeys.
* Build and optimize digital campaigns, email journeys, landing pages, and calls to action that encourage audiences to take meaningful actions, including making donations, registering for workshops, and engaging with SCORE’s programs and initiatives.
* Develop audience segmentation and nurturing strategies that strengthen relationships with prospective and existing donors, workshop participants, and other key audiences.
* Use digital advertising, email marketing, marketing automation, and audience insights to identify opportunities to increase donor acquisition, repeat giving, workshop registrations, and other measurable revenue outcomes.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of revenue-focused campaigns by monitoring conversion rates, cost per acquisition, donation performance, registration volume, and return on advertising investment, as applicable.
* Identify opportunities to improve the digital experience and reduce barriers to conversion across SCORE’s website, donation pages, registration experiences, and other digital touchpoints.
* Collaborate with relevant teams to ensure digital marketing campaigns support broader fundraising, partnership, and organizational revenue priorities.
* Approximately 10% travel.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

  

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Five or more years of progressive experience in digital marketing, including responsibility for developing, executing, and optimizing digital marketing strategies and campaigns.
* Proven ability to manage email marketing, social media, paid advertising, and digital analytics.
* Proficiency with email marketing platforms and marketing automation, including audience segmentation, automated journeys, and campaign performance optimization.
* Strong analytical skills, including the ability to use web analytics and digital reporting tools to evaluate performance and inform strategic decisions.
* Experience managing digital marketing vendors, agencies, or contractors.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

  
  

The Senior Marketing Manager, BiTE® Portfolio Marketing & Operations, will help shape how Amgen commercializes and supports successful implementation of the portfolio across healthcare settings. In this dual Senior Marketing Manager and Field Operations lead role, you will support portfolio-level marketing strategy and execution across Amgen’s approved and anticipated BiTE® therapies, including IMDELLTRA, BLINCYTO, and prostate cancer asset. You will help expand the BiTE® Operationalization Capability, an important part of the Oncology Business Unit’s long-term strategy, by connecting brand priorities and strategies, healthcare stakeholder needs, and field insights to practical, scalable marketing and enablement solutions.

  
  

Reporting to the OBU Director of Strategy, Operations and Planning, the successful candidate will work across brand marketing, the BiTE® Operationalization Team (BOT), field leadership, training, and other cross-functional partners. This role offers the opportunity to shape BiTE® operationalization portfolio strategy and see it through to execution: setting direction, translating priorities into plans and resources, coordinating review and deployment, and using marketing research, analytics and field feedback to improve what comes next. The successful candidate brings pharmaceutical marketing experience, strong cross-functional leadership, and the ability to turn strategy into clear, effective execution in a complex, matrixed environment. This position will serve as a key connector between brand-created marketing strategy and field execution. The candidate would be tasked with translating brand priorities, customer insights, customer educational needs, and field insights into coordinated marketing initiatives and scalable resources. The role will help coordinate alignment across BiTE® therapies while addressing the distinct operational education considerations associated with each product.
